articleTitle: H∞ Filtering for Nonlinear Networked Control Systems with Mixed Random Delays and Packet Dropouts
abstract: In this paper, the problem of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filter design is investigated for a class of nonlinear networked control systems on the basis of the interval type-2 fuzzy set theory. First, mixed random delay and packet dropouts are taken into consideration in the filter design process. And the membership functions and number of fuzzy rules of the filter are different from the plant. Second, the fuzzy filtering error system is built based on interval type-2 fuzzy model. Then, by using Lyapunov function, stability judgment theory, Wirtinger inequality and linear matrix inequality, the filter stability condition is given. Finally, simulation example is provided to show the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Improved-ORB-based SLAM Using RGB-D Data
abstract: RGB-D cameras have become a popular sensor for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) because they can provide RGB and depth information at the same time. The spatial location of feature points of SLAM is obtained by its corresponding depth information from RGB-D sensors. However, the depth information of the feature at the edge of the object is very noisy, and the measurement is often inaccurate. At the same time, there is poor real-time performance, low accuracy, and much difficulties of dense construction in ORB-based Visual SLAM (visual SLAM, VSLAM). Therefore, an improved ORB features based SLAM framework with corresponding method using RGB-D data is proposed in this paper. We extract and match features with improved ORB. Then the local map is used to perform local optimization for pose estimation, and an efficient key frame screening method is designed. The proposed method effectively reduces errors, enhances robustness, and builds a dense map of the environment.

articleTitle: Finite-time Synchronization of Complex Dynamic Networks with Nonlinear Uncertainty and Output Coupling
abstract: In this paper, the problem of finite-time synchronization is investigated for a class of complex dynamic networks with nonlinear uncertainty and output coupling. For this case, two control strategies of output feedback control and adaptive control are adopted respectively. By using the Lyapunov stability theorem, sufficient conditions for finite-time synchronization of complex dynamic networks are obtained, and it is proved that the error dynamic system can reach the equilibrium point in finite time theoretically. Finally, the validity of the conclusion is proved by numerical simulations.

Author Keywords: Output Feedback Control and Output Coupling

articleTitle: Distributed event-triggered synchronization of general networked systems with directed topology
abstract: This paper studies the synchronization problem of complex networks with identical nonlinear nodes via distributed event-triggered control. The triggered times are determined by a pre-given function which keeps the error small enough. A general detailed-balanced graph is considered to solving the problem of asymmetric coupling matrix. Lyapunov stability theory is utilized to prove that under several conditions the nonlinear systems can achieve completely synchronization. A centralized lower bound of the interval between any two triggered times is also found to avoid undesirable Zeno phenomenon. Examples and numerical simulation are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Object Tracking Via Context Information And Correlation Filer Learning
abstract: A novel object tracking method based on context correlation information and discriminative correlation filters is here proposed. This method explores discriminant correlation filters for scale translation and scale estimation within an asymmetric Siamese neural network to improve the adaptability of object trackers to target scale variation, and combines global context information in the discriminant correlation filters to locate the target accurately to improve the tracking performance in complex background. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed approach over the approaches.

articleTitle: Modeling and Optimization of Glucose Separation based on MPSO-SVR
abstract: Modeling the glucose separation process was researched based on support vector machine to remove redundant sugar in the liquid medicine, Ophiopogon japonicas solution was the research object. In the alcohol precipitation process of glucose separation, the pH value prediction model of the liquid medicine was established by support vector regression(SVR). The model parameters were optimized by multi-population particle swarm optimization(MPSO) algorithm, the prediction precision of the optimized model meets the production requirements. In order to further verify the feasibility, the proposed model was compared with the BP neural network model on prediction precision. The results show that the model prediction is stable and accurate on training set and test set, which indicates that the proposed model is feasible to predict the pH value of the glucose separation process in traditional Chinese medicine solution.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Text Detection in Arbitrary Scenes Based on Multi-scale Segmentation Networks
abstract: In recent years, most of the scene text detection algorithms are benefited from the development of deep learning methods which depend on bounding box regression. These methods usually perform two kinds of predictions: text/non-text classification and location regression. Regression may be an important part when predicting bounding boxes, but it is not necessary because the text/non-text prediction can be used as a semantic segmentation which contains location information. However, text instances usually distribute closely in scene images, which is difficult to separate. Therefore, instance segmentation is proposed to fix the problem. In this paper, we propose a pixel-based method based on an efficient segmentation network with multi-scale features. Firstly, the high-level and low-level features are extracted from the modified Xception network. The positive links between the pixels are then calculated to complete the instance segmentation. After we obtain the two predictions of both features, the standard Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) is used to remove the redundant frames and keep the best output of the bounding boxes. The results show that our method performs well on several public benchmarks, and this method requires less training time and eliminates the trouble of setting anchors.

articleTitle: Image Classification via Hierarchical Dictionary Learning
abstract: Recently lots of dictionary learning methods have been presented to deal with the issue of image classification, there is still substantial room for improvement. To further improve the performance, a novel Fisher discriminative criterion based structured dictionary learning method is here introduced which contains the main two components. Firstly, category-unique dictionary for all categories in different levels are learned to obtain the specific information of each category, and category-shared dictionary between all categories are learned in different levels to obtain the common information across different categories; secondly, a discriminative term in terms of Fisher discrimination criterion is here jointly utilized to enhance the discrimination of category-unique dictionary and category-shared dictionary. Experiment results on public available databases are conducted to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method compared with the state-of-the-art dictionary learning methods.

articleTitle: The Users-Demand-Oriented Stochastic Scheduling Method on Seawater Desalination System
abstract: In order to protect the water-supply scheme from the predictive error of water consumption, an user-demand oriented stochastic water-supply scheduling method on the seawater desalination system is proposed. Firstly, Classification and Regression Tree is used to estimate the prediction interval of the users' future demands. Dependent-Chance Programming and Monte Carlo Simulation are used to figure out the probability of the event that the allocated water meets the demands of users. The equilibrium of water-supply is also taken into consideration. In this way, the stochastic model is transformed into the multi-objective optimization problem. Multiple-Population Quantum Genetic Algorithm is employed to acquire the optimal solution. The result of real-world case study validates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Unified non-fragile controller design for event-triggered networked control systems
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of unified non-fragile controller design for networked control system with an event-triggered scheme. The main objective of this paper is to design the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub>, L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> -L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub>, passivity and (Q, S, R)-dissipativity in a unified framework so as to guarantee that the network control systems is asymptotically stable and extended dissipative. The extended dissipativity performance analysis unifies (Q, S, R)-dissipativity, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub>, passivity, and L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> - L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance in one unified framework by regulating some weight matrices. By using Lyapunov stability theory and multi-delay partitioning method, some delay-dependent criteria in terms of linear matrix inequality(LMIs) are proposed. In addition, a non-fragile state feedback controller are designed to ensure that the closed-loop system satisfies the extended dissipative performance. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the efficiency of the addressed method.

articleTitle: Design of three-dimensional garage based on PLC
abstract: With the social-economic and the gradual development of the automobile industry, cars in daily life is becoming more and more popular, car ownership rate increased year by year, some big city parking problems become increasingly serious. Building a three-dimensional garage is the main way to solve this problem, it can be limited in the area of the maximum parking vehicles, give full play to the utilization of land. In this case, the lifting of the three-dimensional garage as the object of study, to complete its control system electrical design.In the three-dimensional garage control system design, the use of Siemens S7-200PLC design, to a car as an example to introduce the entire work process and through the design and debugging, To ensure the normal operation of the work. In addition, a series of protection devices, such as anti-fall devices, travel limit switches, photoelectric detection devices, etc., to ensure the safe and reliable garage, making the whole process can be safe and accurate operation.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Threshold Denoising on Bearing Fault Diagnosis
abstract: Bearing fault signal is complex and non-stationary, this makes fault feature extraction very difficult. Through investigation of soft threshold function and hard threshold function, a wavelet denoising method based on improved threshold function has been proposed. By this method the feature of fault signal is highlighted and the fault diagnosis effect was improved. This paper takes the measured bearing fault signal as the research object, the fault signal feature frequency component has been found by this method. This paper provides a new idea for fault feature extraction and bearing fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: CSR: A Centrality Based on Robustness and Controllable Subspace of Complex Networks
abstract: Complex networks are everywhere, some of them are airline network, road network, power grid network and protein-to-protein network. These networks are robust in failure or under attack but still needs in-depth study. Researchers have proposed various techniques to find and enhance the robustness of networks. However, furthers study required in this area. In this paper, we study the robustness of controllable subspace under random removal of edges and propose the robustness index for controllable subspace from one node as well as from a set of nodes. This work proposes a new centrality CSR (Controllable Subspace and robustness) to rank the important nodes of network based on optimal values of controllable subspace and robustness of controllable subspace. We also discuss the effects of exact robustness index and approximate robustness index on two factor: computational time, and accuracy. We show the analysis of top ten percent important nodes of various real networks with different centrality measures and CSR to compare the results. With the extensive experimentation on the real networks, CSR outperformed other centrality measures.

articleTitle: Robust Sensor Bias Estimation Based on the Bounded Variables Least Trimmed Squares
abstract: Sensor bias estimation is of significant importance to ensure the estimation accuracy of target state for the distributed multi-radar data fusion system. Most previously proposed algorithms rely on the assumption that track to track association has already been solved. In addition, the performance of traditional bias estimation approaches degrades in the ill-conditioned scenarios with densely distributed targets. In this paper, a robust bias estimation algorithm based on the bounded variables least trimmed squares (BVLTS) is proposed. This algorithm can simultaneously overcome the negative influence of the misassociations and ill conditioning. Simulation results verify the advantages of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Linear Quadratic Pareto Game Problem: A Case of Deterministic Controller
abstract: In this paper, we study a kind of linear quadratic Pareto game problem in stochastic system. The biggest difference from the existing literature, is that the control is described by deterministic time function. This kind of game is inspired by some national policy arising from government and can be used to present the players' action. By applying the weighted sum method, we could transform the Pareto game into an optimal control problem and by virtue of Pontryagin maximum principle, we derive all Pareto efficient strategies. Moreover, we conclude that the optimal state is characterized by a linear stochastic differential equation of mean-field type, which is one of novel features in our paper. Finally, we work out one numerical example to enhance the implementability of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Distributed Fault Detection and Isolation for Interconnected Systems in Finite Frequency Domains
abstract: This paper investigates the distributed fault detection and isolation problem for a class of interconnected systems with finite-frequency specifications. A set of local filters are designed to generate residual for each subsystem and a finite-frequency index is used to characterize the fault sensitivity. For the purpose of fault isolation, the filter is designed with a proper reference model which has a finite-frequency H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sub> performance, such that the estimation error between the generated residual signal and the residual of the reference model is optimized, and the attenuation of disturbance is simultaneously considered as a H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance index. Subsequently, the finite-frequency performance and attenuation performance of disturbance are characterized via convex LMI conditions. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness and merits of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Parameter Estimation of Fractional Order Multivariate Grey Model with Time-delay Based on Adaptive Dynamic Cat Swarm Optimization
abstract: In order to reduce the time-delay impact of different factors on some grey systems, we firstly add multiple time delay values in the multivariate grey model and promote it to fractional order for getting better prediction accuracy. As the parameters involved are large and complex, we utilize grey correlation analysis to estimate the time-delay values and adaptive dynamic cat swarm optimization(ADCSO) to estimate the other parameters of the model. The main method is organized as follow. Firstly, use the data of the total domestic tourism revenue and consumption levels of urban and rural residents in China from 2006 to 2014 to train the model to obtain the parameters and then use the data of 2015 to 2017 to test the accuracy of the grey model. Secondly, simulate and analyze the four multivariate grey models: integer order models with and without time-delay, and fractional order models with and without time-delay. The comparison results show that the models with time-delay perform much better than those without time-delay, and the fractional-order models can produce more accurate prediction values than integral-order models under the same condition.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of a Novel Controllable Excitation Feeding Platform Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
abstract: High-precision parameters on the linear synchronous motor of a new magnetic suspension feed platform obtained become a crucial problem of improving accuracy of a controller. The parameters by some regular programs measured are limited. Considering the advantages and disadvantages of differential evolution algorithm and basic particle swarm optimization algorithm, an intelligent evolutionary algorithm based on natural-selective learning-based differential mutation is proposed to optimize particle swarm optimization. The proposed method is applied to the parameter identification and modeling of the platform feed system, and a multi-parameter identification model of linear synchronous motor is constructed based on the particle swarm optimization algorithm, which is improved from elite learning differential evolution. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has higher accuracy, the lowest error reaches 0.3%, and the convergence performance is more than doubled compared with the traditional improved particle swarm optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: A Simplified Path Tracking Design for Stratospheric Airship with Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control Approach
abstract: The flight control of the stratospheric airship is simplified to fly in horizontal plane and is investigated with linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC). A second-order LADRC controller is used to control the yaw angle, while a first-order LADRC controller is used to control the speed. Simulations show that the two controller’s parameters can be tuned independently. The airship can track circle path while the initial position and velocity errors are attenuated.

articleTitle: Lateral Dynamic Modeling and Verification of Vehicles with Steering Characteristics
abstract: This paper proposed the vehicle lateral dynamic modeling method including the characteristics of the steering system. The model can demonstrate the aligning torque and some other characteristics. For the steering system, the input is made up of the driver's torque, the assisting motor torque and the aligning torque obtained from the tire model, the corresponding output is the front wheel angle. The vehicle status information includes the sideslip angle, the yaw rate and the lateral displacement, and the aligning torque can be characterized. The steering system includes the influence of the steering system clearance, elastic components, the overall stiffness, and the ability to express the road feeling. The tire model includes the expression of different road surfaces, the influence of the steering system on the lateral stiffness characteristics, and the influence of the front wheel positioning parameters on the tire cornering characteristics. The lateral dynamic model is mainly used for simulation research and system performance evaluation. Then, the expression ability of the model is verified by the joint simulation of CarSim and Simulink. Finally, the experiment of a snake test was designed. It appears that the integrated model lays a foundation of the designing a controller in the future.

articleTitle: LPV modeling oriented robust predictive output regulation for a class of constrained DC-DC Zeta converter
abstract: This paper considers the constrained output regulation problem for a class of DC-DC Zeta converter. First, the dynamic circuit description is modeled as LPV system based on Kirchhoff's current/voltage law and small signal variation method. Second, the reduced-order observer is designed to estimate the unknown states and disturbance. Third, a minmax optimization method is introduced to achieve the predictive regulation of Zeta converter. Finally, the integrated off-line and on-line synthesis procedures are summarized in an algorithm. The effectiveness of proposed results is verified through a simulation example.

articleTitle: Face recognition based on improved residual neural network
abstract: For traditional face recognition algorithm based on convolution neural network in the insufficient light, side face of 45° environment, for large-scale face recognition accuracy is not high, and when the network layer increases to a certain layer, the performance of the network tends to saturation, continue to increase the network layer instead lead to performance problems. An improved neural network architecture combined with deep residual neural network and ArcFace Loss is proposed, namely, ArcFace Loss replaces the Loss function Softmax of deep residual neural network. Experimental results show that the improved residual neural network has an accuracy of 97.7% in face recognition on LFW data set, which is higher than the traditional and improved deep learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Distributed Receding Horizon Estimation in Sensor Networks with Scalar Packet Losses
abstract: This paper addresses the distributed fusion filtering problem for the linear discrete-time systems with packet losses. These measurements are obtained by a sensor network, where scalar packet losses occur during the data transmission through the different network communication channels. The distributed fusion estimation is accomplished in two phase. Firstly, a batch form and an recursive form of receding horizon estimation for each sensor are developed based on the finite measurements. Secondly, the distributed fusion method is used to generate fusion predictors and filters by a scalar-weighted linear combination of the local estimators. Simulation examples are provided in order to illustrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Process Monitoring Based on Robust Slow Feature Analysis
abstract: A process monitoring method based on robust slow feature analysis (RSFA) is presented in the paper. Slow feature analysis (SFA) is a new feature extraction technology which can find a group of slowly varying feature outputs from the high-dimensional inputs. In order to improve the robustness of SFA, RSFA is presented which applies locality preserving projection (LPP) to define the energy density function and set a reasonable threshold value to remove outliers mixed in the normal process data. This paper uses three spline interpolation method to interpolate the missing value caused by removing the outliers to maintain the integrity of the time series. For the purpose of fault detection, the D monitoring statistic index is adopted and its confidence limit is computed by kernel density estimation. Simulation on Tennessee Eastman (TE) benchmark process show that the proposed method has a better fault detection performance compared with the conventional SFA-based method.

articleTitle: Vibration Energy Harvest and Storage Management System Based on MSMA
abstract: The hotspot of future research is the technology of MEMS(Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems) components. In rechargeable battery compatible chip (thin film lithium-ion battery), people store natural vibration energy that extracted from nature, and it will be available for power supply by adjusting the load circuit (such as sensors, etc.). An efficient and intermittent charge is needed to transfer the energy from the source device to the battery for the reason of the obtained energy showing irregular random low power-"burst". Some researches have shown that utilizing inverse effects of MSMA(Magnetically controlled Shape Memory Alloy) could transform vibration energy of nature into electrical energy, which overcomes the influence of damping effect when using piezoelectric materials extracts electric energy. In this paper, a power management circuit is designed according to MSMA vibration energy, which include two parts: the first part is circuit module of energy acquisition and management , and the second part is circuit module of energy storage and management. Simulation results show that when the acquisition device AC voltage changes, energy acquisition management circuit can output 3.3V DC voltage stably. The energy storage management circuit can fully charge a lithium battery with 250mAh in a short time.

articleTitle: Novel Two-electrode Excitation Mode for 3D Electrical Capacitance Tomography
abstract: The problem of traditional 3D ECT (electrical capacitance tomography) system is serious, the inadaptability and the uneven distribution of the sensitivity field result in poor quality of image reconstruction. In order to improve these problems, on the basis of analyzing the single electrode excitation mode, a novel mode is presented, which is two-electrode excitation mode for non-same layer electrodes. The results of simulation show that the two-electrode excitation mode can increase the charge of detection electrode, facilitate the measurement of small signal, improve the uniformity of sensitive field distribution, reduce the artifacts of reconstructed image, and obtain better quality of reconstructed image.

articleTitle: Correlation Between Diabetes and Body Composition of Based on Decision Tree and Neural Network
abstract: The existing correlation analysis between diabetes and body composition is mostly based on statistical analysis methods. Due to the dependency on experiences and constraints of selected samples, it is difficult to reflect the relationship between physiological and biochemical indicators. Therefore, a method for correlation analysis of diabetes and body composition is proposed in this paper based on decision tree and neural network. On one hand, the decision tree is used to identify the correlation that is easier to find. On the other hand, the neural network with the self-learning advantage is used to further study some uncertainties. The analysis on experimental data shows that this proposed method could effectively simplify the analysis process of the correlation between diabetes and body composition, improve the analysis accuracy, and provide new ideas for the diagnosis and treatment of diabetes..

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization of power system with wind farm
abstract: The RX model is used to solve the problems that occur when the wind farm is connected to the power system. In order to ensure the stable operation of the system, the access nodes are determined according to the reactive power regulation capability of the node and the active power loss of the system, and the improved fill function particle group is used. The algorithm optimizes the reactive power optimization model with wind farm. The simulation experiments show that the improved fill function particle swarm optimization algorithm is more advantageous than the filled function particle swarm optimization algorithm and the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm in both convergence accuracy and speed. It is also used in complex reactive power optimization problems of wind farms. Can be well applied, with practical application value.

articleTitle: Hope Bifurcation of a Fractional-order Neural Network with Mixed Delays
abstract: This paper initially considers the dynamic behavior of fractional-order neural networks with leakage delays and distributed delays. In order to analyze its the stability and bifurcation, a virtual neuron is introduced to replace the term of the distributed delay, so that the new system involves only the discrete delay. By adopting the leakage delay as the bifurcation parameter and analyzing the relevant characteristic equations, the Hopf bifurcation occurs when the leakage delay passes certain specific values. Finally, numerical simulations are given to substantiate the theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: A processing algorithm for the data of urban rail tread profile
abstract: For the tread profile data of urban rail transit vehicles, after the pre-processing of discrete data to find the target data class within a certain accuracy requirement, an indirect algorithm for calculating the diameter of the rolling circle of the wheel is given. The data detected by the 2D displacement sensor is fused to obtain a complete tread curve and other tread feature values. After the data processing algorithm is put into the field engineering prototype system, the results are compared with the manual measurement values, which show that the wheel height, wheel thickness and wheel diameter are consistent with the measured results of the manual measurement standard within the allowable error range.

articleTitle: Design of filter rod pushing system based on fuzzy PID control
abstract: Aiming at the precise positioning problem of cigarette filter box cartoning machine in the process of pushing the production line, a new type of push mechanism control system is designed. The fuzzy control theory is combined with the PID controller, and the PID parameters are adaptively adjusted by fuzzy control. It can improve system response speed and control accuracy. The results show that the improved push mechanism can realize the flexible filter rod packing, and the positioning accuracy is better than 0.1mm, which improves the packing quality of the filter box cartoning machine.

articleTitle: A weighted split Bregman iteration for adaptive fractional order total variation model
abstract: Image denoising is an important branch in the process of image processing which has been widely used in various fields. This paper proposes a weighted split Bregman iteration (WSBI) algorithm for adaptive fractional order total variation model, which provides an effective method to deal with the image denoising problem. A weight coefficient w is added to the split Bregman iteration (SBI) algorithm. Compared with the ordinary SBI algorithm, this improved algorithm can achieve faster convergence and higher (PSNR) of the image by experiments. This algorithm also can well preserve the texture details of the image and avoid the staircase artifact.

articleTitle: Analysis of Photovoltaic Carrying Capacity of Distribution Network Based on Voltage Sensitivity
abstract: With the large-scale access of distributed photovoltaic to the distribution network, the increase of node voltage has become the main reason for limiting the large-scale access of distributed PV, and effectively evaluating the maximum carrying capacity of distributed PV in the distribution network has become the research focus.In this paper, the voltage sensitivity-based method is used to analyze the distributed PV carrying capacity of the rural distribution network. Different scenarios are selected to maximize the distributed PV carrying capacity of the rural distribution network. Based on the voltage sensitivity analysis, the sensitive points of the rural distribution network after the distributed PV is connected are determined through the active sensitivity matrix. The maximum PV carrying capacity and acceptance rate of the rural distribution network are obtained without causing the voltage of the sensitive points to exceed the limit. Finally, a typical rural distribution network example is simulated by matlab simulation software. The simulation results show that this method can effectively evaluate the PV carrying capacity in rural areas.

articleTitle: A Method of Educational News Classification Based on CGLTF-IDF
abstract: CGLTF-IDF is a feature extraction method which combines educational geography lexicon and traditional TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) method. In this paper, CGLTF-IDF is be introduced into K-means to classify the education news texts according to geographic information. Firstly, the existing geographic vocabulary is collected from the internet to form the basic geographic lexicons. Secondly, we take educational news texts as samples from websites, clean and mark the samples, and then extract high-frequency geographic vocabularies from the labeled texts. Thirdly, combining the basic geographic lexicons and the extracted high-frequency geographic words to from the new geographic lexicons. Fourthly, the weights of key words in traditional TF-IDF algorithm are improved to form feature vectors by CGLTF-IDF. Finally, K-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster educational news texts according to geographic information in order to achieve the function of classification. The experimental result shows that the CGLTF-IDF method introduced into model has a significant improvement in the final classification effect.

articleTitle: Multi-variable Grey Prediction Model Based on Positive Real Order Random Weakening Buffer Sequence
abstract: The gray system implements the distribution of different schemes for weights of observation data by constructing weakening buffer operator of different orders, thereby changing the influence of observation data on parameter estimation. The previous way is to use the same weakening buffer order to act on elements in different positions in the observation data sequence. Based on this issue, a positive real order random weakening buffer sequence is proposed, using different orders of weakening buffers for elements of observation data in different positions, which can increase the fineness of weight distribution. And this paper propose a method for determining the weakening buffer order. The established multi-variable prediction model can meet the needs of complex systems considering multiple impacts. The calculations show that using a positive real order random weakening buffer sequence can obtain more accurate prediction results.

Author Keywords: the method of determining the order

articleTitle: The fault prognosis method based on Dynamic Compensation AR model
abstract: In recent years, more and more researchers had focused on predicting the time at which a system or a component will no longer perform its intended function. Nevertheless, the precise trend prediction was difficult. Especially the algorithm modeling with the normal operation data would invalid when fault operations occurred. In this paper, an adaptive time series forecasting algorithm is proposed for the fault prognosis, whose name is Dynamic Compensation Auto-regression model (DCAR). Firstly, we derive the fault statistics of T<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>and Q though PCA, then, DCAR is adopted to predict the steps when statistics beyond the upper control limits. The first advantage of the algorithm is that is a multi-step-ahead time series forecasting algorithm, which has great practical value to predict the faults earlier and avoid the serious consequences caused by faults. The second advantage of the algorithm is it derives more precise trend prediction by compensating the residual dynamically. Especially when the residual is caused by the fault operation rather than the noise. The methodology presented was assessed on the Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) benchmark. These results demonstrate the validity and superiority of this method and the promising potential for the fault prognosis of industrial applications.

articleTitle: Research on Cantonese Phonetic Feature Extraction Algorithm Based on GMM - UBM
abstract: Cantonese is widely used. However, due to the unofficial reason, the speech recognition system of Cantonese is still rare. According to the characteristics of Cantonese language, the GFCC based on Gamma-tone filter bank was used as the Cantonese phonetic characteristic parameter, and PCA dimension-reducing was taken to reduce the computational complexity. In order to shorten the length of the test voice and reject the counterfeit, the GMM-UBM was selected as a speech recognition model. The experimental results showed that as the characteristic parameters of Cantonese, the GFCC is better than others obviously, and GMM-UBM not only shortened the length of test speech, but also rejected counterfeit more than 95%.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of military chess game algorithm based on probability model and situation evaluation
abstract: Military chess is a very popular board game in China and a branch of the imperfect information game. This paper starts from the characteristics of imperfect information game and military chess game. Focus on the probability model, the evaluation of the method of travel, and the search of chess in the game of military chess, designed a military chess game system based on probability model and situation assessment, improved the intelligence and strategic of the system.

articleTitle: Chaos Control of Boost Converter Based on Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Control
abstract: In the beginning, this paper studies the complex dynamic behaviors of current-mode boost converter by bifurcation diagrams and Poincaré sectional. Then, in order to control the chaos phenomena well, the energy constant based super-twisting sliding mode control strategy is proposed. The strategy based sliding mode hypersurface allows the voltage and current of boost converter to converge to the expected value within a finite time. Meanwhile, the boost converter works stably in the period-1 orbit to ensure an ideal output quality. Compared with other chaos control methods, it has the advantages of fast dynamic response, strong robustness and small voltage ripple. The simulation results clearly show that the proposed control strategy can achieve the desired effect.

articleTitle: Bus Priority Strategy Considering Signal Compensation for Non-bus Priority Phase
abstract: In order to balance the traffic efficiency of non-priority phase, to enhance the overall level of service (LOS) of the intersection, this paper puts forward a bus priority strategy considering the non-priority signal phase compensation. Firstly, based on the LOS constraint, a bus priority strategy with no signal compensation for non-bus priority and a bus priority strategy with signal compensation are established. Then, a one-time compensation strategy and staged compensation strategy are proposed for the bus priority strategy with signal compensation.

articleTitle: Stability of Dynamic Quantized UAV Airborne System With Packet Losses and Time-varying Delay
abstract: The stability problem of a dynamic quantized UAV airborne system with time-varying delay and packet losses is studied in this paper. Sufficient condition for asymptotic stability of the system is considered in terms of matrix inequalities. Finally an illustrative example demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Support Degree Evaluation of Cyberspace Operation to Joint Combat System
abstract: The conception and cognitive framework of cyberspace operation support degree is proposed, the conceptual and mathematical evaluation models are established, and the networked support degree evaluation index system is constructed, with using ANP method to calculate its index weights by SuperDecision software, which could provide a reliable reference for cyberspace operation support degree evaluation.

articleTitle: Dots and Boxes Interactive Interface Implementation and Algorithm Improvement
abstract: According to the rules of the 2018 Chinese University Computer Game Contest, a checkerboard interface that can realize the standardized game play is written. The interface program is written in the Pyqt5 framework. The Dots and Boxes algorithm was improved in the early stage, and the rules were imported to make the algorithm more reasonable in the early stage. In the 2018 Chinese University Computer Game Competition, the third-class results were obtained.

articleTitle: Optimal State Tracking Control for Linear Discrete-time Systems Via Value Iteration
abstract: In this paper, the data-based solution for state tracking control problem of linear discrete-time systems is proposed by value iteration, in which only the system state and control information are required. Instead of directly constructing the error system, the Bellman equation is obtained via constructing an augmentation system. Different from previous researches on state tracking control problem, the Q-learning based on value iteration is used to solve the augmented Bellman equation of state tracking control, which does not require initial allowable control. Finally, the feasibility of proposed algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: The optimal type of online channel considering showrooming
abstract: Considering the common market phenomenon "showrooming", this paper studies the optimal type of online channel under the supply chain with one manufacturer and two retail channels. There are two types of online channel, which are the reseller channel and the marketplace channel. Our conclusions are as follows. In the presence of showrooming, first, the marketplace channel increases the profit of the supply chain; second, if the platform fee is not high enough, the manufacturer prefers to adopt the marketplace channel; finally, if the platform fee is intermediate, the marketplace channel is a win-win strategy for the manufacturer and the online retailer. In the absence of showrooming, if the platform fee is low enough, the marketplace channel increases the profit of the supply chain; if the platform fee is high enough, the reseller channel increases the profit of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on the Structural Effectiveness of Overseas Anti-terrorism Operational Command System Supported by Space Information
abstract: Complex network is an important method to analyze the structural effectiveness of Overseas anti-terrorism operational command system supported by space information. Firstly, we expound the command body and its main tasks of overseas anti-terrorism operational command system supported by space information, and demonstrates the complexity of the system; secondly, we discuss the theory, methods and application steps of complex network, define the network performance indicators and calculation formulas; thirdly the method of complex networks is used to model space information support the overseas anti-terrorism operational command system in the current, construct space information to support the overseas anti-terrorism operational command system in the future; finally the complex network parameters and network structure performance indicators are calculated and analyzed. The results show that the future command system has a certain improvement in the timeliness of information flow, synergy, node relevance, and emergence, and the synergy is especially significant, while the node correlation is not improved much.

articleTitle: An initialization-free continuous-time distributed algorithm for convex optimization problem
abstract: In this paper, a distributed convex optimization problem for continuous-time multi-agent systems is studied. The objective function is equal to the sum of several strongly convex cost functions with Lipschitz gradients, which are solved by the corresponding agents. A new distributed algorithm is proposed and the multi-agent system is represented by a strongly connected undirected graph. The exponential convergence of the algorithm is analyzed and the minimum exponential convergence rate is obtained. Finally, mathematical simulations are implemented to illustrate the results.

articleTitle: Lateral Spread Prediction Based on Generalized Additive Model for Hot Strip Finishing Mill
abstract: Based on the measured data of hot strip finishing mill, a lateral spread model is proposed using the generalized additive theory. Firstly, according to the framework of generalized additive theory, design procedures including pre-analysis of variables, model setting, model estimation, result analysis and modification are investigated for lateral spread modeling. For each independent variable, suitable Back-fitting algorithm is selected to estimate the smooth function. Then, a large number of strip data covering variety of steel grades is collected for modeling. For each variable, a univariate function is estimated using cubic spline interpolation. On this basis, a generalized additive lateral spread model is developed for hot strip finishing mill. Finally, practical prediction experiments indicate that the accuracy of the proposed model is much better than the online one. In addition, the new model features the characteristics of high calculation precision and wide application scope. As a result, the proposed generalized additive lateral spread model would be a good option for online process control in hot strip finishing mill.

articleTitle: Robust state estimation for switched systems with unstable subsystems
abstract: In this paper, the robust state estimation problem is discussed for a class of switched continuous time systems with uncertainty. We do not require that all the subsystems of the switched system are stable. First, the definition of interval observers is extended to switched systems. Then, by giving the upper bound and the lower bound of the uncertainty and employing the multiple linear copositive Lyapunov function method and mode-dependent average dwell time scheme, some sufficient conditions are derived and applied to build the interval observer, which supply certain information at any instant: an upper bound and a lower bound are provided for each component of the states. Finally, a numerical example is proposed to illustrate the effectiveness of the main result.

articleTitle: A Novel topology for power decoupling of two-stage inverter based on Buck/Boost circuit
abstract: A novel power decoupling circuit using four switches is proposed, which is connected in parallel to the AC output side of the inverter. Thus, second harmonic voltage appeared in DC bus and second harmonic current appeared in voltage source can be significantly suppressed, and large electrolytic capacitor can be substituted by a small, long lifespan film capacitor. The new power decoupling circuit proposed in this paper can handle bi-directional changed pulsation power through pulse energy modulation (PEM), which calculates duty ratio in each switching cycle and achieves decoupling control. Furthermore, four operating modes of the hybrid Buck/Boost circuit are analyzed and the principle of PEM was deduced. Finally, theoretical analysis is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation platform. The simulation results indicate that the proposed scheme is reasonable and effective and the decoupling ability of the decoupling circuit under various operating conditions is analyzed.

articleTitle: Design of Mining Isolation Switch Action Torque Test System
abstract: Herein, we analyzed the developing situation of coal industry and mining isolation switch movement process, and on the basis of digital signal processor, the overall test system structure for mine isolating switch action torque was designed. The operation panel of the test system was detailed design and the working process of the test system was described. Based on the slope of the torque curve, the maximum torque point test method was put forward. Mine isolation switch action operating force test system was examined by high precision intelligent two-way show torque wrench.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Digital Design of Substation
abstract: The artificial intelligence takes the computer as the core, and has great development and innovation in the research of the interdisciplinary field. The level of artificial intelligence is high, and processing speed is fast, which can ease the burden of designers, and greatly improve the designers life quality and production efficiency. With the development process of science, more and more requirements of substation digitized designing are posed. Application Imagination on Substation Design Based on Artificial Intelligence is proposed in this paper, which can design secondary physical circuit, secondary virtual circuit and intelligent label more quality and effective.

articleTitle: Coordinated Operation Method of Grid Energy Storage and Abandoned Wind
abstract: For high-proportional wind power access to power grids, how to coordinate the energy storage switching strategies with other various power generation energy sources is the key to the effective utilization of energy storage and the improvement of wind power consumption. This paper proposed a safety barrier that power grid established through energy storage for eliminating wind power, studied evaluation and identification methods of energy storage input, and established the model of energy storage operation and the relationship between energy storage capacity and wind power consumption demand energy storage capacity and clean energy consumption demand. It also constructed a method for analyzing the correlation between electric heating thermal storage load and abandonment wind during heating period, and explored the qualitative relationship between abandoned wind power, abandoned wind hours and abandoned wind power. However, the energy storage capacity is configured according to the maximum abandonment power, and the energy storage efficiency is not high, and the wind power that is consumed by the electric heating thermal storage load is the abandoned wind power during the heating period.

articleTitle: Kinematic Control with Gravity Optimization for Redundant Manipulators under Model Uncertainties
abstract: In this paper, trajectory tracking for redundant manipulators is considered. In real implementations, kinematic uncertainties of the robot are inevitable, making it difficult to achieve high-precision tracking control. At the same time, how to ensure the boundedness of the physical states remains challenging. Aiming at reducing energy consumption, with the aid of recurrent neural networks, we propose a RNN based controller, including a Jacobian adaption method. This control strategy is capable of handling system constrains as well as kinematic uncertainties. Stability of the closed-loop system is analyzed. Simulations shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Hybrid Gray Model Based on Fractional order Gray Model and Verhulst model
abstract: Gray system is used to process the object of which information is partly known or incomplete. The GM(11) model is one of the most widely used models. However, it has been shown that GM(1,1) model is more accurate for the exponential data series than data series of saturation. In order to expand the application of gray model, a combined prediction model based on fractional-order gray model and Verhulst model is proposed in this paper. The final predictive result is obtained by fractional-order GM(1,1) model and verhulst model by weighting coefficients. Through examples of Chinese energy consumption, the combined model get better result in prediction than the other two models separately.

articleTitle: Non-positive Face Detection Based on YCgCr Color Space
abstract: Non-positive face detection is a topic worthy of further study, however, there are few paper focus on it. This paper proposes a method to detect non-positive face based on a new color space YCgCr by optimized Gaussian skin model. Firstly, YCgCr color space is compared to YCbCr to show its advantage of better clustering effect. Secondly, OTSU method is used to calculate the threshold, and applied to simple Gaussian skin model to get an improved Gaussian skin model, which achieves excellent results. And then through morphological process, including keeping the maximum connected area and neck rejection, getting an ideal face binary image finally.

articleTitle: 3-DOF flexible joint manipulator motion control based on the double-layer structure
abstract: Due to the existence of flexible joints, the dynamic coupling process of the multi-flexible manipulator system tends to be complicated, and the control of the system tends to be difficult. In this paper, to reduce the influence of joint flexibility on the system, a 3-degrees-of-freedom (3-DOF) dynamic model of flexible joint manipulator is established; and to control the system, the kinematics, trajectory planning and dynamics are integrated. Combine with the proportional-derivative(PD) controller and model predictive controller, the double-layer structure controller is designed. The upper layer of controller adopts the model predictive controller for multi-variable control, and the set value of joint motion of each PD controller in the lower layer is obtained. The simulation results show that the manipulator system based on double-layer structure is easy to control and it has a good stability and a strong applicability.

articleTitle: Exponential Stability of Hybrid Stochastic Differential Systems with Uncertain Parameters
abstract: In this paper, exponential stability is investigated for a kind of hybrid differential system with impulsive, switching, uncertain parameters and time-delay. By employing switching Lyapunov function approach, Itô's formula, Schur complement lemma, and linear matrix inequality techniques, some exponential stability criteria are established. Two numerical examples show the effectiveness of the results.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Linear Continuous-Time Delay-Difference Systems with Three Delays
abstract: This paper is concerned with the stability analysis of linear continuous-time delay-difference systems with three delays. Firstly, a new method for testing the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-exponential stability of the considered system is proposed, which is easier to use than the one in the existing literature. In view of the conservatism and the complexity of the obtained stability conditions in the existing literature, a complete Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) is constructed by analyzing the relationship among the three delays. Sufficient conditions for both L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-exponential stability and exponential stability are then derived based on the constructed LKFs, which are delay-independent. A numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness and less conservativeness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On Evaluation System of Agricultural Science and Technology Poverty
abstract: Precise poverty alleviation of agricultural science and technology is the fundamental way to guide the sustainable development of poverty-stricken areas. FGT index was used to measure the incidence of agricultural science and technology poverty. We got three results based on the evaluation system in this paper. Firstly, the technical market turnover indicator shows highest incidence of poverty. Secondly, the service capacity is weak, especially, lack of agricultural science and technology leaders. Thirdly, R & D funding is insufficient, and the gap in the threshold gradually increased. It is suggested that the government should put science and technology poverty alleviation into the program of anti-poverty, which could improve the endogenous driving force of sustainable development after poverty alleviation.

articleTitle: Unmanned Boat Target Detection Based on Improved SSD
abstract: Currently, vision sensors are one of the most equipped sensors in unmanned boats, and they provide an intuitive description of the environment. Deep learning based convolutional networks can identify and classify targets well. Considering the need for real-time obstacle avoidance by unmanned boats, this section selects the lightweight model Single Shot Detector (SSD) as the recognition framework, but the SSD will appear discontinuous in the target tracking. To this end, the recognition framework of SSD&CAMShift is proposed, and CAMShift is used to obtain the pixel statistical probability of the target to achieve auxiliary tracking. The simulation results show that the designed tracker can automatically detect and track, and the data correlation between the upper and lower frames is greatly improved.

articleTitle: A New Switching Nonlinear Extended State Observer
abstract: To improve the observation accuracy and shorten the transient time simultaneously, in this paper, we propose a new nonlinear extended state observer (ESO) by using a switching strategy. The convergence of the proposed ESO is proved with explicit error estimation. The effectiveness of the proposed switched nonlinear ESO is demonstrated through numerical simulations and comparison with existing ESOs. The numerical results show that the proposed new ESO is more accurate and the transient time is shorter than the previous ESOs with the same tuning parameter.

articleTitle: The Coordinate Control of Multi-UUVs Formation with Double Independent Communication Topologies in the Situation of Velocity Information Missing
abstract: A new method which combine the consensus algorithm and ESO observer to solve the coordinate control problems of leader-following UUVs formation with no velocity information transferred between the members. As the communication width is limited, a new communication topology is proposed, which divided the traditional one into two independent parts: position communication topology and velocity topology. With the state feedback linearization method, the math model of UUV is changed as a double-integrator dynamic model. Based on this model, the coordinate control can be regarded as a consensus problem with ESO observer. As a result, the sufficient conditions are proposed and proven with Lyapunov theorem. Finally, the simulation results are shown to illustrate the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Design of Electric Fixed Torque Wrench Based on Speed Difference Detection
abstract: In modern industry, torque wrenches are widely used in precision assembly. In view of the shortcomings of the existing electric torque wrenches on the market, such as complex scheme, low precision and small torque range, this paper proposes a design scheme of torque wrenches based on the detection of torque difference to control the bolt preload. At the same time, the mechanical characteristics of the series motor used in the torque wrench are analyzed, and the mathematical model between torque and speed difference is established. The electric fixed torque wrench has the characteristics of simple structure, large torque range, safety and reliability.

articleTitle: Dwell Time Adaptive Three-Way Text Entry by Gaze
abstract: Most of the existing gaze-based text entry methods suffer from the Midas touch problem and low accuracy of the typing. To alleviate these problems, a dwell time adaptive three-way text entry method is proposed. In the proposed method, the adaptive dwell time is utilized to alleviate the Midas touch problem. Moreover, feedback and rest strategy for eye tracking help avoid the problem. Three-way decision is introduced to decide the character in text entry. In the virtual keyboard, the whole trigger area of a key is divided into core area, boundary area and negative area, which are correspondingly the positive region, the boundary region and negative region in three-way decision. The positive region is attached with a positive decision, which is the key. The boundary region is with a boundary decision, which is the key or the corresponding adjacent key. The negative region is with a reject decision, which is decided as an invalid typing. Finally, a typing software using the proposed method is programmed on SensoMotoric Instruments (SMI).

articleTitle: Phase Measurement Circuit Study of Eddy Current Signal in MIT
abstract: For the problem of eddy current signal in MIT detection, a phase measurement circuit has been designed in this paper. We firstly analyze the mathematical model of eddy current signal measurement , and then the whole hardware platform design is described. The system mainly includes excitation source circuit, sensor coils and resonant circuit, phase detection circuit and data acquisition circuit. Experiments have been implemented for evaluating the compensating capacitor impact for the phase measurement. And also the measurement accuracy and sensitivity of the system are all considered. These results provide important basis for improvement of MIT hardware system design.

articleTitle: Detection Strategy of Unstable Approach Based on Possibility Measure
abstract: This paper presents a possibility measure based model to detect the unstable approach in flight data analysis. The key elements of stabilized approach, energy height, and some other related flight parameters, including approach speed, touchdown speed, corrected wind speed, approach angle, landing configuration, engine thrust, and etc., are used to establish the fuzzy sets. Therefore, a fuzzy integrated judgment model is also proposed, which would quantify the distance between the current approach and the stabilized approach in the possibility space. Furthermore, the implications of this strategy for practitioners and future work are analyzed.

articleTitle: Pricing and Environmental Innovation in a Supply Chain with a Risk-averse Retailer
abstract: This paper develops a Stackelberg game model of a supply chain with one risk-neutral manufacturer and one risk-averse retailer whose customer demand is price and environmental innovation level sensitive to investigate the role of risk attitude and coordination mechanism in a sustainable supply chain. We study the equilibrium price and environmental innovation level decisions in the decentralized and centralized condition separately, together with a generalized revenue-sharing mechanism to coordinate the supply chain. We find that the manufacturer's environmental innovation level and wholesale price both increase with retailer's risk aversion level. In the centralized setting, the environmental innovation level is higher than that in the decentralized one while the retail price is higher or not depends on environmental investment efficiency coefficient. Moreover, in the coordinated setting, the retailer decreases transfer price with a lower the environmental investment efficiency coefficient. And the Pareto range of unit share of the retailer shrinks when the demand-enhancing effectiveness of environmental innovation decreases. The findings provide managerial insights about the impact of risk attitude and coordination mechanism in achieving both economic and sustainability goals.

articleTitle: Discussion on the innovative mixed model of Automatic control experiment MOOC teaching
abstract: The online course is a new education platform, and its credits have been gradually accepted as college credit. China University Love Course Platform can provide course certificates. At present, universities encourage teachers to teach MOOC courses, which promotes both the internationalization of higher education and the innovation of traditional teaching. However, there are several issues with the current MOOC teaching. First, there is an unbalanced low proportion of laboratory courses; Second, the offered laboratory courses mainly focus on theory, leading to the lack of experimental design and other teaching links; Third, the lack of some practical trainings, such as practical experiments and remote experiments, reduces teaching effects; Fourth, MOOC belongs to the network teaching mode. It is difficult for students to complete the MOOC course if it is not combined with offline course management,. To solve these issues, this paper designed an experiment on automatic control theory, which is a mixed teaching mode, namely the MOOC laboratory teaching + auxiliary Web online teaching platform + off-line laboratory teaching and management. It enables the students to not only take online MOOC content, also manage and download the study materials remotely. We combine online education and offline experiment teaching, thereby providing students with a variety of learning modes.

articleTitle: Analysis of airway model of tumor patients based on CFD
abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is increasingly used to simulate fluid flow in the human body. The theory of CFD is utilized to analyze the flow velocity and pressure of the surgical patients after resection of the airway, then predictions of recovery period are proposed and validated by analyzing the conditions of the airway models about pre-operation and post-operation. In this paper, in order to fit the human body, the CT images of pre-operation, post-operation and surgical recovery were used to reconstruct three different periods of human airways, and the airway models were used for CFD simulation. The simulation results show that the patient's airway will be affected by surgery, and the airway pressure will be changed to cause partial tracheal deformation because the bronchi is removed, but the surgical results are acceptable.

articleTitle: Fast Design and Optimization of Low Energy Moon Return Orbit via STK/Astrogator
abstract: In this paper the fast design and optimization of low energy Moon return orbit is realized with STK/Astrogator. With the analysis of the dynamical characteristics of the low energy return orbit, the return orbit is divided into two phases and a bi-directional integral searching method is proposed. To carry out the searching and optimization process, the STK/Astrogator module is applied to build the simulation environment. The calculation result shows that the low energy Moon return orbit can be designed and optimized efficiently and automatically with the STK/Astrogator module and the searching method proposed.

articleTitle: Neural Network Sliding Mode Path Following Control Based on the DVS Algorithm of Underactuated Ships
abstract: For the external environmental disturbance and model uncertainty of underactuated ships, to further realize the accuracy and stability of ship path tracking. A neural network (NN) sliding mode control strategy based on dynamic virtual ship (DVS) algorithm is proposed, under the condition of model uncertainties and external disturbances caused by winds, waves and currents. The virtual control law of controller is designed by backstepping method, and its derivative is estimated by the dynamic surface control (DSC) to reduce the computational burden. The NN minimum parameter learning method is adopted online to cope with the uncertainties of the model, to approximate the nonlinear terms and to design the actual control law. The direct Lyapunov technique is used to analyze the stability of the closed-loop system. Finally, the algorithm scheme is applied to the 32m mono hull ship, the simulation results are shown that the ship reached the desired path more quickly, and the tracking error was relatively smaller, the robust performance was stronger than before.

articleTitle: System Verification by Regional Mobius Transformation
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the region transformation in safety verification problem: how to choose the region transformation of the system equation so that the newly obtained system is safe in a given initial region and a unsafe region, and the variable substitution is conformal and reversible. Firstly, conformal mapping theory in complex analysis is used to construct conformal transformation that maps the interior of the initial region to the exterior of the unsafe region. Then, by transforming the differential equation system, a region transformation method is proposed to construct the system under the coordinate transformation. An example is given to illustrate our idea.

articleTitle: Event-triggered stabilization for discrete-time Markov jump systems with time-varying delay
abstract: In this paper, stochastic stabilization problem for discrete-time Markov jump system with time-varying delay under event-triggered strategy is investigated. With guaranteeing stochastic stabilizability, event-triggered strategy is introduced to save communication resources for the underlying system. Sufficient conditions are derived for stochastic stabilization of the systems with completely known and partially known transition probabilities, respectively. Moreover, mode-dependent controllers under event-triggered strategy could be designed according to the proposed conditions. Finally, numerical examples are provided to demonstrate the application of the given results.

articleTitle: A Fusion Model of Social Influence and Group Decision
abstract: The influence of members in social networks and the influence of members in group decision-making belong to the same type of mathematical problem, that is, the influence of nodes in the network. This paper combines Friedkin social network influence model and DeGroot group decision model under a unified theoretical framework. The unified model allows us to see the relationship between the two models and create conditions for further in-depth application.

articleTitle: A 3D Point Correspondences Uncertainty Aware RGB-D SLAM System
abstract: In recent years, much research has been done on RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system. Mismatching and depth measurement uncertainty are key factors affecting the accuracy of RGB-D SLAM algorithms. Given that, we propose a 3D point correspondences uncertainty aware SLAM system. Firstly, we conduct ORB feature extraction and matching. Secondly, 3D positions of those pair points are reconstructed by combing depth information with Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) and outliers are rejected and the initial guess of camera motion can be provided based on LMedS. Under the assumption of Chi-Square distribution, the motion results are further optimized by using Mahalanobis distance and Chi-Square test. Besides, the camera motion trajectory is globally optimized by pose graph. Finally, experiment results prove the proposed method can improve the accuracy of localization and mapping.

articleTitle: Modeling and Online Parameter Identification of Lithium Battery Considering Hysteresis Characteristics
abstract: This paper investigates the hysteresis characteristics and variable current dynamic working state of lithium battery for electric vehicles (EVs) by experiments. To describe the hysteresis in battery modeling, a nonlinear battery model based on equivalent circuit model is proposed while introducing a weighting factor for equivalent voltage. Since the vehicle working condition is complex and the model parameters are sensitive to load, the model parameters are identified online to improve its accuracy by variable forgetting factor recursive least squares method. Finally, a battery model simulation is conducted to verify model's accuracy by comparing the voltage curve of simulation with what obtained from the Dynamic Stress Test (DST). The experimental results indicate that the error of terminal voltage is within 0.05V.

articleTitle: Reagent dosage intelligent optimal setting for iron ore flotation process based on CBR
abstract: Reagent dosage setting is closely related to the product quality and economic benefit of an iron ore flotation process. The strong nonlinearities, uncertainties and coupling of the flotation process make it difficult to set proper reagent dosage. In this paper, a reagent dosage intelligent optimal setting method based on case-based reasoning (CBR) is put forward. It can calculate the reagent dosage optimal setting value according to ore properties. Result of the industrial experiments conducted in a Chinese iron ore dressing mill shows that the proposed method has a higher computational accuracy and can realize a more stable product quality when compared with other setting methods.

articleTitle: Social Network Structure: Groups and Their Influence
abstract: Traditional social network analysis was often used for connected or strongly connected networks. Current social network analysis, such as online social network analysis, will target such networks, which have many members and include a large number of connected or strongly connected subnetworks. Using the concept of group (subnetwork), we can convert large-scale networks into small-scale networks with nodes as groups. A theoretical model for the influence between groups is given in this paper.

articleTitle: H∞ state estimation for stochastic recurrent neural networks with randomly occurring nonlinearities and variance constraint
abstract: This paper is coped with the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> state estimation problem under error variance constraint for discrete stochastic recurrent neural networks (RNNs) with parameter uncertainty and randomly occurring nonlinearities. The activation functions satisfy the sector-bounded condition, and the phenomena of randomly occurring nonlinearities are described by random variables obeying Bernoulli distribution. The major purpose is on the development of a time-varying H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> state estimation scheme such that some sufficient conditions are derived to ensure both the prescribed H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance requirement and estimation error variance constraint. Accordingly, the desired estimation algorithm can be realized based on recursive linear matrix inequality approach. Finally, an example is presented to show the effectiveness of the main constrained estimation results.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation of Ship Logistics System based on Reliability
abstract: To solve the calculation problem of time for receiving supplies of the ship logistics system, the consideration of equipment failures is added, the simulation method of ship logistics system based on reliability is proposed. Firstly, the work flow of material receive system is analyzed. Secondly, the simulation of the work flow is achieved. Finally, the reliability of material receive system is solved by Monte Carlo method. The simulation results indicate that the assessment of material receiving time is closer to the actual after the equipment failures is considered.

articleTitle: Design of Lateral Flight Control Law for a Double Vertical Tail UAV
abstract: Flight control system plays a vital role in controlling the aircraft while flight control law is the core of the flight control system. In this paper, an efficient and reliable control law is proposed and introduced in detail for conventional aerodynamic layout UAVs with double vertical tail. A six-degree-freedom nonlinear model and linearization of the model are introduced firstly. On this basis, the control law is designed according to the root locus method. The simulation results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme. Furthermore, in order to improve the control precision, robustness verification is described on the condition of gravity center shifting and parameter variation finally.

articleTitle: Multi-pattern Recognition Technology based Feature Selection and Processing of Apple Near Infrared Spectrum
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the prediction model of soluble solids content in Red Fuji apple, this paper processes the spectrum serially via Wavelet Packet Threshold Denoising method, Multivariate Scattering Correction(MSC) and Mahalanobis Distance(MD) Eliminating Anomaly Sample Method, and then extracts spectral features via Partial least squares (PLS) method and Wavelet packet transform (WPT) method. This paper proposes a feature selection method based on ant colony algorithm that uses the pheromone and heuristic information of ant colony to select the optimal feature combination. The dimension of feature combination selected in this paper is 20. We uses PLS to establish the prediction model, and gainthe correlation coefficient as 0.9435, which shows that the processed data improves the precision of the model. The prediction model of soluble solids in apples established can be applied as a substitution to full-band information.

articleTitle: Fire Analysis of Ancient Buildings Based on Cable Aging
abstract: In order to protecting ancient buildings, this paper takes the fire caused by cable aging in ancient buildings as a breakthrough point, analyzes the causes of cable insulation aging. Focusing on the theory and considering the influence of temperature on resistance, a more practical formula (formula 11) for temperature rise of cables in ancient buildings is deduced. The thermal aging equation of polyvinyl chloride (PVC) insulating layer obtained from Arrhenius empirical formula was modified by the modified algorithm. This paper briefly analyzes the influences of single-phase grounding fault and grounding resistance too large on the cable insulation aging, puts forward some countermeasures to prevent insulation aging according to the physical quantity affecting cable temperature rise and the current situation of ancient buildings. Among them, the temperature rise formula and thermal aging equation obtained by quantitative analysis can provide some references for technical personnel of ancient buildings electrical fire prevention.

articleTitle: Decoupling Modulation Strategy for Three-Level Four-Leg Inverters Based on Independent Control of Fourth Leg
abstract: Three-level four-Leg inverters can be used to supply high-power balanced, unbalanced and/or nonlinear loads. However, the addition of a fourth leg extends the voltage vectors from two- to three-dimensional space and increases the complexity of the neutral-point (NP) potential control. To solve the above problems, a decoupling modulation strategy, which separates the control of the fourth leg from that of the former three legs, is presented to simplify the selection of the modulation vectors, output symmetrical three-phase voltages, and get balanced NP potential. The switching states of the former three legs are established by applying the three-leg nearest-three-virtual-vector (NTV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) modulation method to the four-leg topology.
