Then a new diagnosis method for railway turnouts is presented based on deep forest. The method fully considers the characteristics of fault data, strong sequence, and limited amount of failure data. Finally, this paper conducts an extensive evaluation by using real-world data from the Changsha Railway Station in China. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better performance compared to state-of-the-art methods in diagnostic accuracy under limited field data, with a fault diagnosis accuracy of 97%.

articleTitle: Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm and Its Application in Traveling Salesman Problems
abstract: The purpose of applying the artificial bee colony algorithm to the traveling salesman problems pursuant to its principle is to find out solutions to the traveling salesman problems of different cities and use local search strategy to effectively make such issues less complicated, so as to optimize the path. It is necessary to analyze the correlation between the artificial bee colony algorithm and relevant algorithm parameters and the number of cities. Simulate result denotes the artificial bee colony algorithm can be applied to settle the problems of traveling salesman and is much reliable in effectiveness, usability and researchability.

articleTitle: A distributed and modularised coordination framework for mission oriented fixed-wing UAV swarms
abstract: In this paper, a distributed and modularised coordination framework for mission oriented fixed-wing UAV swarms is proposed. The framework is fully distributed such that no central point is needed for coordination. Each UAV makes decision based on the information from the neighbors autonomously so as to achieve better scalability. Besides, the proposed framework is modularised into many modules with interfaces of inputs and outputs. Thus, the complexity of developing a large system can be reduced and different missions can be feasibly extended to the swarm system. Through field experiments with 21 fixed-wing UAVs, we evaluate the proposed framework and successfully demonstrate coordination missions such as formation flight, target recognition and tracking.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of High Power Density EV Charging Module
abstract: DC charging module consists of AC/DC converter circuit and DC/DC converter circuit. In view of the requirement of charging module high power density and good output characteristic of EV’s charger, AC/DC adopts the three-phase VIENNA rectifier design, and DC/DC adopts the full bridge LLC resonant circuit, in which the former can meet the requirements of high power density and high power factor, while the latter can meet the requirements of high efficiency and soft switch. The working principle of three-phase VIENNA rectifier and all bridge LLC resonant conversion circuit are analyzed. Then, the parameters of the front-end and back-end circuits are calculated, and the output voltage and efficiency of the charging module at full load, no-load and half load are tested. The experimental results show that the output voltage of the front-end circuit is stable, the output DC capacitance can be automatically compressed, the back-end circuit can realize ZVS shut off, the module features high efficiency and good output.

articleTitle: Real-time Hand Gesture Recognition Based on Deep Learning in Complex Environments
abstract: Real-time hand gesture recognition in complex environments has many challenges, such as poor real-time performances and robustness to environmental changes. This paper takes the hand gesture control of the unmanned vehicle as the application background, and focuses on the gesture detection and recognition of video streams based on deep learning in the complex environment. In this paper, we detect the hand in a complex environment by training the ssd_mobilenet model, and initialize the tracking with kalman filter. Then, we detect the hand keypoints by following the architecture of Convolutional Pose Machines (CPMs), in order to obtain the belief maps for all keypoints that are used as the train sets of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Finally, based on the results obtained by our classification, this paper proposes a method of multi-frame recursion to minimize the influences of redundant frames and error frames. In this paper, eight kinds of gestures for controlling vehicle are identified. The experimental results show that our method can successfully realize real-time hand gesture recognition in the video streams. The recognition accuracy can reach 96.7%, and the average recognition speed reaches 12 fps, which basically meets the real-time requirements and successfully applys to mobile terminals such as TX2 for engineering practice.

articleTitle: Image Stitching Based on Improved Gradual Fusion Algorithm
abstract: In order to improve the effect of image stitching and eliminate the gap between images caused by the uneven local brightness of the image in the process of stitching, an improved gradual fusion algorithm is proposed. Compared with linear gradual fusion method, the improved gradual fusion method has a non-linear change in weight, so it achieve no stitching gap and smooth transition at the stitching point .Surf algorithm is used for feature point detection and Hessian matrix is used to obtain feature points. The feature points are matched by Euclidean distance, and the improved gradual fusion algorithm is used for image fusion to achieve the smooth transition. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm could improve the effect of image fusion significantly.

articleTitle: An Improved GMM based Video Foreground Separation
abstract: Surveillance video analysis has applied to kinds of areas. Mixed GMM is a traditional target separation method. In order to overcome the object detection performance under dynamic scene, an improved algorithm is adopted to improve the mixed Gaussian model algorithm. A different initialization and model parameter updating strategy are adopted to detect the object under dynamic scene. The experiments validate the effectiveness of the algorithm at the lakeside and geyser.

articleTitle: Analysis of Lateral Stability Region for Lightweight Electric Vehicle Using Phase Plane Approach
abstract: Vehicle dynamics control systems play an important role in improving vehicle handling stability performance and passenger safety. Analysis of lateral stability region can further help to arouse the potential of the dynamics control system under critical maneuvers. This paper investigates lateral stability region for lightweight electric vehicle via phase plane approach. Based on the improved cubic formula tire derived from Pacejka model, the nonlinear vehicle dynamic analysis model is built and the particular state-space representation for vehicle phase plane analysis is developed. The lateral stability region is analysed using the band-shaped stability region related to two symmetric saddle points. And the influence of important factors such as road friction coefficient, steering wheel angle and vehicle velocity on the lateral stability of vehicle yaw motion is also discussed and presented, which may provide assist for vehicle dynamics control design.

articleTitle: L2 String Stability of Heterogeneous Platoon under Disturbances and Information Delays
abstract: Disturbances and information delays can significantly affect the stability of the vehicle platoon. This paper proposes a robust control algorithm for heterogeneous vehicle platoon under external disturbances and wireless communication delays. By employing the approach of equivalent communication delay and deeming road slop and aerodynamic drag as the external disturbance, the error model of vehicle platoon including delay and interference is established firstly. Then, based on the Lyapunov-Krasovskii theorem and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control, one robust control method that can relieve the control conservatism is proposed to reduce the effects of delays and disturbances. To guarantee that the proposed controller has the property of string stability, the criterion that conforms to the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> stability is presented. A comparative simulation with the traditional string stability controller is applied to prove the effectiveness of raised method.

articleTitle: A New Semantic Segmentation Method of Point Cloud Based on PointNet and VoxelNet
abstract: Three-dimensional laser point cloud technology has been widely used in machine vision and three-dimensional reconstruction engineering, but scene recognition and semantic segmentation of three-dimensional point cloud is still developing and improving. With the gradual maturity of artificial neural networks of deep learning in the field of computer vision, it is possible to identify and segment three-dimensional point cloud scenes. However, most methods perform slowly and inaccurately in real-world outdoor scenes that are large and noisy. This paper proposes a new scenario segmentation method based on PointNet and VoxelNet to improve the efficiency and accuracy of semantic segmentation. Firstly, the voxel meshing method is used to downsample the point cloud scene while keeping the original information of the point cloud. Then the point cloud data is filtered by multiple methods to remove noises and smooth the surface of point clouds. Finally, the processed point cloud scene is trained and the ideal semantic segmentation result is obtained. The results of our method are evaluated on the datasets of BDCI and our own datasets.

articleTitle: A Novel Detection Method for Open-Circuit Fault in Modular Multilevel Converters
abstract: Modular multilevel converters (MMCs) have become one of the most promising topologies for medium- and high-power applications given their characteristics, such as flexibility. An MMC is composed of several submodules (SMs). Hence, the diagnosis of faulty SMs is important to guarantee proper operation. In this paper, we propose an effective fault detection and localization approach for MMCs, which is based on the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). Specifically, detection and phase fault method relies on the analysis of the MMC ac characteristics. To verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed fault diagnosis approach, we performed MMC simulations under normal and open-circuit fault conditions using RT-LAB. The results show that the proposed approach can quickly and easily identify the fault condition and locate the faulty phase to allow a stable operation of the MMC.

articleTitle: Terrain-adaptive Bionic Landing Gear System Design for Multi-Rotor UAVs
abstract: Nowadays the multi-rotor UAVs are used a lot in military and civilian fields and which are playing an increasingly important role. However, the fixed support frames made of metal or composite material acting as landing gears are widely used on the multi-rotor UAVs, which have shortages and can't be applied to the landing environment with uneven terrain. So a new kind of terrain-adaptive bionic landing gear is proposed in this article with the function of adapting complex terrains and makes the multi-motor UAVs landing on rough terrain, great slope and step floor. The composition and designing principles of the system are introduced at first. Based on the working process, the design method of one-leg system is detailed described as a basic part, and the kinematic solution of multi-leg system is also based on this through coordinate transform. And through virtual simulation, laboratory debugging and flight test, the feasibility and correctness of the design are shown at last. From the jobs in this article, the terrain-adaptive landing gear can be successfully used on multi-rotor UAVs when landing on some complex terrain through adjusting the orientation of the legs. Compared to the traditional design forms, the design has important engineering application value.

articleTitle: Comparison and Evaluation of Activation Functions in Term of Gradient Instability in Deep Neural Networks
abstract: The most widely used activation functions in current deep feed-forward neural networks are rectified linear units (ReLU), besides many alternatives. However, none of these alternatives have managed to consistently outperform the rest and there is no unified theory connecting properties of the task and networks with properties of activation functions in the sense of efficient training. In order to understand the related problems fundamentally, it is necessary to figure out possible causes of gradient instability mathematically, and how different activation functions can be adopted to improve system performances. Theoretical analysis about gradient instability is given in the paper, as well as the fundamental explanation for the exploding/vanishing gradient and the possible solutions. The performances of different activation functions in a given example network are investigated. Numerical simulations suggest that the convergence rate of gradient varies with the activation function. There is no activation function that performs well to all structures. The findings in the paper provide a reference for the selection of activation function in the design of deep neural network models.

articleTitle: Data-driven unmanned surface vessel path following control method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: Aiming at many difficult problems of path-following(PF) control of Unmanned surface vessel (USV), such as disturbance of wind, wave and current, nonlinearity of control effect, etc. This paper proposes a data-driven USV PF control method based on SARSA. Using the behavior-reward scoring mechanism of reinforcement learning to learn a set of behavioral rules. These behavioral rules are used for USV to make the best control behavior based on the state of the ternary array consisting of heading deviation, wind and current. The experiment uses the simulation environment to learn the algorithm. Through the analysis of the experimental results and the comparison with the traditional PID algorithm, the feasibility and advantages of the algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Reducing waiting time at an Airport Security Checkpoint based on the queuing model
abstract: In this paper, a model was established to determine an optimal security service system, which can help airlines security. Normal distribution method of the queuing theory was adopted. In order to optimize the quecue, we used the queuing theory of single service model and service desk and applied the weighted average statistical preview and routine security checks to calculate the average queue time. Our optimized queuing model used queuing theory with strict queuing theory of ρ-Lscurve approximation solution to check the correctness of optimization. Besides by using the method of linear programming, we calculated the total flights departing passengers of each period and the peak of each period to reach the minimum of the absolute value of the difference of the average number of passengers. We further identified where we could make our model more powerful by considering things such as security. Finally, the simulation was carried out to test our model.

Author Keywords: single service model and service desk

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of sucker rod pumping system using modified extreme learning machine assisted by gravitational search algorithm
abstract: Sucker rod pumping system is a kind of important oil production unit. How to diagnose its fault conditions based on the electric power data is a challenging task. Aiming at this problem, this paper builds a sucker rod pumping system fault diagnosis method based on the modified extreme machine learning. Two aspects, including the feature extraction and the classifier construction, are involved in the proposed method. Firstly, the electric power data are collected and data features are developed by applying wavelet analysis. Furthermore, a modified extreme learning machine assisted by gravitational search algorithm (GSA-ELM) is proposed to overcome the influences of random initialization of the input weights. In comparison with the basic ELM method, GSA-ELM can provide better generalization performance with a simple model structure. Lastly, the real industrial data are used to test the proposed method and the results demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Face gesture recognition based on clustering algorithm
abstract: In recent years, face recognition has been increasingly applied to all aspects of social life. Face recognition actually includes a series of related technologies for constructing face recognition systems, including face image acquisition, face location, face recognition preprocessing, identity confirmation, identity search, etc. However, most face recognition technologies today have high requirements on the pose of the face, and the robustness to the face pose is very low. Therefore, multi-pose face recognition has become a hot trend in face recognition. This paper uses the ASEF human eye localization algorithm to locate the human eye by preprocessing in the Multipie database. Then, the clustering algorithm is used to cluster the face pose to achieve the effect of gesture recognition.

articleTitle: Amazons Evaluation Optimization Strategy Based on PSO Algorithm
abstract: Amazons is one of the complete information games. The win rate of searching algorithm based on game tree is closely related to the evaluation function. Accurate evaluation can not only greatly improve the win rate, but also improve the searching efficiency to some extent. Based on a variety of pruning optimization algorithms, PSO algorithm is applied to Amazons. Combined with UCT algorithm, Amazons evaluation optimization strategy is proposed. The effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm are validated by experiments, and ultimately the win rate and searching efficiency are effectively improved.

articleTitle: Study on an Optimum Design for DC and Doubly-Controlled DFIG System
abstract: This paper proposed a two-level optimum design for DC and doubly-controlled DFIG system to lower the gearbox ratio and improve the DFIG system economic benefit in the DC grid. Two voltage source converters consisting of a rotor side converter (RSC) and a stator side converter (SSC) interface DFIG with DC grid, which could regulate DFIG system synchronous speed, current and voltage flexibly. Without the limitation of AC grid, a regulation scheme of system current and generator poles is presented by two-level optimum strategy on the basis of the system costs model. The first level optimum strategy is carried out to regulate the generator poles and lower the gearbox ratio. And the second level optimum strategy is adopted to regulate the system current and lower the gearbox ratio. Finally, simulations are carried out to verify the system design effectiveness.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Feature Extraction of Laser SLAM Based on Artificial Landmarks
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is the core issue in the field of mobile robots. Laser SLAM is one of the widely used solutions for the application of SLAM in engineering. Laser SLAM estimates the change of the robot pose using the features of the environment. However, it is difficult to extract natural features in a highly similar environment. Therefore, artificial landmarks are needed to be placed in the environment when necessary. In this paper, the reflective characteristics of the artificial landmark are analyzed experimentally, and two feature parameters for the extraction of the artificial landmark are proposed based on their reflective characteristics. One of them is the intensity of the reflected light received by the laser ranger, and the other is the number of the laser points that the artificial landmark can continuously reflect back in each scan. Through the statistical analysis of the laser data collected in the experiment, the specific values of these two parameters are determined, and the detection range of the laser ranger to effectively extract the landmark under the selected parameters is measured experimentally. These results provide experimental support for the deployment of the landmarks in the environment.

articleTitle: Distributed Continuous-time Optimization over Second-order Multi-agent Networks with Nonuniform Gains
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the distributed optimization problem over second-order multi-agent networks, where the team objective function is the sum of some local differentiable convex functions. Assume one local objective function can only be known by one agent. Based on the local neighbors' information, a new distributed optimization algorithm with nonuniform gains is proposed. By a new coordination transformation, the closed-loop system can be decomposed into two one-order system. It is proved that all agents can reach an agreement and the team objective function can be minimized by analyzing these two one-order systems. Finally, a simulation example ia given to show the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Skeleton Based Fall Detection with Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: There are more and more elderly people living alone in the society today, and the supervision of the elderly has become a social problem. In order to enable elderly people living alone to be found at home when they fall, minimize the damage to them. We propose a skeleton-based real-time fall detection system. Firstly, we encode the sequence of motions into an RGB image and retain the original spatial structure information and temporal dynamic information. Then, we designed a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) to recognize the encoded image. We collected a fall dataset and merged it with the MSRDaily Activity3D dataset. We use two data enhancement methods to extend the dataset. The results of our model on the test set show that the recall is 93.9% and the accuracy is 93.75%. Finally, we also propose an online detection algorithm. The experimental results show that the recall is 1, and the accuracy is 95%.

articleTitle: Observed-based on Robust Control for a Class of the Welding Process Systems
abstract: The problem of observer-based on robust control of a class of welding process systems is considered. According to unknown state of the welding system, design method of observer is provided. In the process of solving observer gain and control gain, Lyapunov theory and Linear matrix inequalities are combined. Finally, a numerical example is illustrated to show the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Continuous-time algorithm for distributed resource allocation over a weight-unbalanced digraph
abstract: This paper studies a resource allocation problem subject to the coupling resource constraint over a strongly connected and weight-unbalanced digraph, where the global cost function is composed of a sum of the agents's local cost functions. To solve the problem in a distributed way, we design a continuous-time algorithm by injecting a graph balancing technique into a primal-dual gradient flow algorithm. We show that the optimal variable generated by the proposed algorithm asymptotically converges to the optimal solution when the local cost functions are strongly convex and and their gradients satisfy Lipschitz conditions. A numerical simulation verifies the theoretical result.

articleTitle: Accounting Control, Motivation and supervision: A Study of Financial Operation of Large Enterprises in China
abstract: Based on the theories of internal control and incentives, this paper systematically analyses the accounting control problems of state-owned enterprises. The research shows that there are many problems in the field of accounting internal control in state-owned enterprises. For example, there is information asymmetry between the enterprise and the competent department, and there is no incentive mechanism in the enterprise rules and regulations. In order to solve these problems effectively, we affirm that the following measures should be taken. Firstly, we should establish the management responsibility system. Secondly, we must strengthen the environmental construction of accounting internal control. Thirdly, we must improve the supervision mechanism of accounting internal control. Fourthly, we should straighten out the relationship between government and enterprises.

articleTitle: Hesitant-intuitionistic Fuzzy Preference Relation and Its Application in Group Decision Making
abstract: This paper investigates the multiplicative consistency of the hesitant-intuitionistic fuzzy preference relation (HIFPR) and its application in group decision making. First, an improved fuzzy preference relation is proposed to deal with the decision making problem with preference and nonpreference as well as hesitation. To check the multiplicative consistency of the HIFPR, a new consistency index is introduced. In terms of the inconsistency in practice, a HIFPR adjustment method based on objective programming is presented by minimizing the deviation of initial HIFPR and adjusted HIFPR. Furthermore, a novel algorithm which can reach group consensus is proposed for group decision making with HIFPR. Finally, an example of a reservoir operation scheme selection is provided to show the application of the proposed method and verify the method's feasibility.

articleTitle: Decentralized Control of Large-Scale Stochastic High-Order Upper-Triangular Time-Delay Systems
abstract: The problem of decentralized control for a class of large-scale stochastic high-order upper-triangular time-delay systems is dealt with in this paper. On the basis of stochastic time-delay system stability criterion and homogeneous domination method, by choosing a suitable Lyapunov-Krasoviskii functional, the decentralized state-feedback controller is constructed such that the closed-loop system is globally asymptotically stable in probability. A simulation example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed design scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Decision-making Optimization of Container MBPP Based on Evolutionary Strategy Algorithm
abstract: As an important part of the vessel stowage planning, the Master Bay Plan Problem (MBPP) can effectively reduce the container's reverse operation and ship stay time, improve the transportation efficiency of container ships and the safety of the entire route if it rationally formulated. The essay established a mathematical model of container loading sequence with the target of minimizing the number of ship containers. The evolution strategy algorithm (ES) is used to optimize the container MBPP, and the two-dimensional real number coding method is designed. The two-point crossover interchange recombination and mutation method is used to analyze ES through different parent and child scales and multiple scale examples. Finally, the ES is compared with the commonly used optimization algorithm PSO and the heuristic algorithm based on the actual shipping problem. The results show that ES can find the optimal solution more quickly, and the optimization efficiency is higher than PSO and the heuristic algorithm of the actual ship loading problem. This consequence verified the validity of the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Fault Monitoring Method Based on Mutual Information and Relative Principal Component Analysis
abstract: Due to the influence of dimension standardization in traditional PCA, each variable is in a relatively equal position and loses relative difference. While RPCA is able to solve the problem, it is not easy to calculate the weight for each variable. In order to solve it, in this paper, a kind of fault diagnosis method based on Mutual Information and Relative Principal Component Analysis (MI-RPCA) is proposed. Firstly, select the key variable of the device as quality variable. Secondly, calculate the mutual information between the process variable and the quality variable separately. Mutual information provides a general measure of dependence between two variables. And then, the proportion factor is determined by scaling the mutual information values between the variables. Finally, experiment on centrifugal compressor show that the proposed method performs better in fault detection compared with the traditional PCA method.

articleTitle: Simulation Study for Forward Problem in Magnetic Induction Tomography By COMSOL
abstract: Simulation of forward problem for eddy current in magnetic induction tomography is one of the key issues in development of the technology of MIT. 2D and 3D MIT forward problem were built by finite-element model (FEM) based on the COSMOL software. Simulate to obtain magnetic flux density for 3D model with different eddy current distribution and make the results be compared, conclude regularity for change of 2D eddy current magnetic flux density influenced by excitation coils. These results provide crucial basis for forward problem and image reconstruction of MIT.

articleTitle: Algebraic parameter estimation approaches for process control systems from sine responses
abstract: The sine signal is a special periodical signal which has single frequency component and is used widely in many research fields. This paper applies the sine signal as the driving signal to generate the observations and studies the parameter estimation for the first-order process control systems. The target of this paper is to propose the easy modeling techniques which can avoid complicated calculation. Drawing on the experience of solving algebraic equations, we put forward an algebraic estimation technique for estimating the parameters of process control systems. By means of the discrete sampled data points from the sine response observations, some equations containing the unknown parameters are constructed. Then the parameter estimates of models of the process control systems can be received. The experiment results show that the proposed technique for system modeling is easy and effective.

articleTitle: Distributed optimal scheduling of virtual power plants with multi-micorgrid
abstract: Microgirds (MGs) alleviate risks of uncertainties from renewable energy sources by integrating distributed energy sources near loads. However, the growing MGs with different stakeholders bring about the non-cooperative scheduling problem in virtual power plants (VPPs), due to the limited information sharing. Therefore, an analytical target cascading (ATC)-based distributed coordinated scheduling method is proposed which enables parallel optimization for multi-stakeholder. Also, Lagrangian multipliers are introduced into a price mechanism of energy transactions between multiple MGs and VPPs. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed method has better convergence and scalability in comparison with the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based scheduling approach. As a result, the validity and effectiveness of the proposed method are confirmed.

articleTitle: The key frame extracting algorithm for record and analysis of psychological sand-play therapy video
abstract: Sand-play therapy is a very effective means of psychological counseling, but it has a very high demand for counseling technology and concentration of the counselors. If digital video processing technology is used to record videos and extract important events, it will greatly reduce the work of counselors and provide multiple help. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of sand-play therapy video analysis, this paper studied the existing video key frame extraction technology, implemented three key frame extraction algorithms and carried out in-depth experimental analysis. Finally, an improved key frame extraction method based on inter-frame correlation of RGB color space is proposed for sand-play therapy video recording, which achieves accurate key frame extraction and effectively reduces the number of redundant key frames.

articleTitle: Mesh Segmentation Algorithm of the Nephogram in Four-node Quadrilateral Mesh
abstract: In order to improve the generation speed and display effect of nephogram in four-node quadrilateral grid, A new nephogram algorithm was introduced into four-node quadrilateral mesh units on the basis of segmentation exhaustive algorithm in three-node triangle mesh units. It effectively improved the efficiency of the calculation and rendering of the nephogram in quadrilateral units. This new algorithm divided the process, in which contour intersect the quadrilateral unit, into four basic forms. Then analyzed and disposed all possible processing paths of each basic form. Because of the possibility of ambiguity problem in four-node quadrilateral mesh units, this new algorithm put forward a "Regress Processing" to simplify the processing flow. Finally, this new algorithm has already been used in actual project, and the results indicate the validity and efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Autonomous Decision-making for Satellites Surveillance
abstract: In this paper, a novel optimization method is proposed to solve the problem of satellites surveillance. A discrete-event system is described as a switched system, the switching law of which is obtained via the mixed-logic dynamic optimization. The solving method of switching law for a discrete-event system is applied to solve the surveillance problem. The process of decision-making is formulated as an event-driven process, and the decision sequence is obtained by minimizing the revisit-durations of the regions. Furthermore, the decision-making process of individual satellite is developed in the cooperative surveillance. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, and the benefits of the proposed method over the benchmark method are shown.

articleTitle: Exponential synchronization for second-order linear systems in complex dynamical networks with cooperatively directed spanning tree topology
abstract: The exponential synchronization problem for second-order linear systems in CDNs with time-varying network topology is investigated in this paper. A sufficient exponential synchronization condition is given under the cooperatively directed spanning tree topology. Moreover, based on the graph theory, Lyapunov method and matrix inequalities, the detailed proof process of exponential synchronization is provided. Finally, simulation results are presented to validate the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Stabilization of the Cascaded ODE-Heat Equations with Time Delay in Boundary Observation
abstract: We consider with the stabilization of the cascaded ODE-Heat equations to boundary observation with time delay. First, we show the well-posedness of the open-loop system. We design the observer and predictor to solve the problem: to estimate the state variable on the time interval [0, t − τ] when the observation is available, and to predict the state variable on the time interval [t − τ, t] when the observation is not available respectively. Based on the estimated state variable, the output feedback stabilizing controller by backstepping method is presented and the closed-loop system is shown to be exponentially stable. Finally, the numerical simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Recursive identification of Hammerstein systems with dead-zone input nonlinearity
abstract: A robust recursive identification algorithm is proposed for Hammerstein systems with dead-zone input nonlinearity and unknown dynamic disturbances. The dynamic disturbance is considered as a slow time-varying parameter to be estimated by the recursive forgetting tracking estimation technique. Based on the decoupling estimation theory and overparameterized method, two improved recursive least squares algorithms are constructed to estimate the model parameters and disturbance sequence. The variable forgetting factor strategy is also used to improve the tracking estimation performance of the disturbance and the estimation accuracy of the model parameters. Besides, the asymptotic convergence property of the proposed algorithm is also illustrated in detail. One example is used to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Identification of Added Mass and Added Damping Coefficient for an Underwater Shaking Table Based on Gradient Algorithm
abstract: The underwater shaking table, the key experimental facility for underwater vibration simulation, is used to test the underwater seismic behaviors and vibration characteristics of the underwater equipment such as underwater civil engineering structures and the submarine production system. However, unlike the normal electro-hydraulic servo shaking table, the special working environment of the underwater shaking table brings many difficulties to its design. One of the key issues is that the added mass and the added damping coefficient caused by the fluid-solid coupling problem between the shaking table and the fluid should be considered. These will reduce the bandwidth of the system and lower the system stability to a great extent. In this paper, the FLUENT software and the dynamic meshing technology are applied to establish the finite element model of the underwater shaking table and its fluid domain. Finally, the added mass and the added damping coefficient of the underwater shaking table are identified by using the gradient algorithm. The simulation results show that both the added mass and the added damping coefficient are precisely identified.

articleTitle: Security inspection of suspension system in urban rail track based on Track-side Signal Detection
abstract: As a key component of urban rail traffic, the suspension system is directly related to the safety and reliability of train operation. Based on the method of track-side signal detection, this paper studied the layout of the sensor by establishing the rigid-flexible coupling model of wheel-rail contact and proposed a method of installing acceleration sensor along the track to obtain the vertical acceleration signal during the train passed. After that, the continuous wavelet packet analysis and short-time Fourier transform method are used to analyze the acceleration signal, compared with local mean decomposition and empirical mode decomposition, LMD is used to decompose the acceleration signals, by calculating the correlation coefficient between the fault signal components and the original faultless signal components, the failure severity for the key components of suspension system is obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by combining the simulation results with the dynamic equations.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of Mobile Service Robot
abstract: In recent years, there is a strong demand for automated and even autonomous robots in many fields such as manufacturing or social services and varieties of robots have been developed. In order to realize the humanized service from the robots, path planning and path tracking problems should be addressed according to typical and unique working environment. In this paper, the simplified four wheeled electric vehicle was chosen as our robot model, then the lateral controller was proposed based on the Lyapunov stability theory and linear control theory. Associated simulation models were constructed in the MATLAB environment, and simulation results show that the designing method of commad signals is reasonable and linear feedback controller can be used for robot trajectory tracking.

articleTitle: Proxy Based Sliding Mode Control for Series Elastic Actuator Based on Algebraic Identification and Motion Planning
abstract: A method based on planning and control for Series Elastic Actuator (SEA) is presented in this paper. In the planned trajectory of arm, the vibration frequency of the arm is identified online, and the zero vibration derivative (ZVD) shaper is utilized to shape the original trajectory of the motor according to the obtained vibration frequency. The arm can be driven to the desired position without residual vibration if motor moves along the desired trajectory. The proxy-based sliding mode control (PSMC) method is applied to the motor, which does not depend on the model parameters of the motor, and the robustness of the motor is improved. Finally, the proposed method is compared with phase plane method and the effectiveness is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Hyperspectral and Image Deep Features for Bacon Classification
abstract: The deep learning method for hyperspectral image and spectral curves image features is proposed in this paper. The convolutional neural network (CNN) model has demonstrated as a universal representation for image feature extraction, especially in the application of image classification. In this paper, deep features of hyperspectral images are extracted using CNN, and the cross entropy is used as the optimization target. Then, the features of spectral curves are used into the image features. Finally, the fusion features are considered as input data, and classified by support vector machine (SVM), which realizes the classification and retrieval of meat. The method is getting our Bacon classification accuracy rate to 99.2%, The experimental results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research of Photovoltaic Generation and Braking Energy Recovery System for Electric Vehicles
abstract: In this paper, a photovoltaic generation and braking energy recovery system was proposed, aiming at the short cruising range and low energy utilization rate of electric vehicles. Through the analysis of the principle of photovoltaic generation and braking energy recovery system, the photovoltaic generation circuit, braking energy recovery circuit, detection and control unit are designed. Finally, the operating environment and condition of the electric vehicles are analyzed, and the system control strategy is described, which is of great significance to improve the endurance of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: A CNN model with statistical correction rules for automatic sleep stage scoring
abstract: In this study, a convolutional neural network (CNN) model with statistical correction rules is developed for the automatic sleep stage scoring. Sleep is a dynamic process which consisted of several sleep stages from light sleep to deep sleep. The convolutional neural network is designed by 6 layers, using two convolution kernels of different sizes to extract the time domain and frequency domain features separately. The statistical correction rules are extracted regarding to the dynamic transition between different sleep stages. The developed method was tested on the large amount of sleep data for the inspection of consisted sleep stages during ones overnight sleep. The prediction results by CNN model were corrected by the statistical correction rules. Totally, the sleep recording of 20 subjects were evaluated. The obtained results showed that the combination of CNN and correction rules achieved rather good and reasonable performance for sleep stage scoring.

articleTitle: A resilient asynchronous filter design for hybrid stochastic systems based on an extended stochastic dissipativity
abstract: This note focuses on the multi-objective filtering issue for hybrid stochastic systems based on an extended stochastic dissipativity property. When the asynchronous phenomenon happens between the plant mode jumping and filter mode jumping as well as inaccuracies or uncertainties occur in the filters, for obtaining the extended stochastic dissipativity of the filtering error system, a resilient and asynchronous filter is designed. Subsequently, the sufficient conditions of extended stochastic dissipativity for the resilient and asynchronous filtering error system are established. Finally, the method of calculating the filter gains is given based on the solvability of the convex optimization problem.

articleTitle: Coupling matrix extraction of coaxial cavity filter using chaotic ant colony algorithm
abstract: Traditional ant colony algorithm has many disadvantages such as poor population diversity and sensitive to initial value. It will be difficult to find optimal solution only relying on traditional pheromone update mode, and easily fall into local optimum. In order to solve these problems, an approach for extracting coupling matrix based on chaotic ant colony algorithm is proposed in this paper. This method effectively combines the hopping of the chaotic algorithm with the fast optimization of the ant colony algorithm, and solves the problem of single algorithm for initial value sensitivity and precocious maturity. Through the simulation experiment of cross and non cross coupled coaxial cavity filter, the method has strong global optimization ability, and has fast convergence speed and good optimization effect.

articleTitle: Three-parameter Control Scheme based on Adaptive Pole Assignment for an Underwater Shaking Table System
abstract: The underwater shaking table, an important device for underwater vibration test, is widely applied to civic engineering, marine engineering and many other fields of submarine structure tests. And the three-parameter control scheme is frequently used to control the underwater shaking table system and provide good control performance. However, the acceleration control performance of the underwater shaking table is greatly influenced by the added mass caused by the fluid-structure coupling. Under the added mass’s influence, the bandwidth of the system is reduced largely and a resonance peak exists in the system frequency bandwidth. In order to enlarge the frequency range and suppress the resonance peak, the adaptive pole assignment control method is adopted to online adjust the parameters of the three-parameter control scheme. The simulation results show that the frequency range of the shaking table system is widened and the resonance peak is also suppressed by using the proposed control scheme. Furthermore, the system acceleration control accuracy is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Output Feedback Reliable Control for a Class of Uncertain Switched Fuzzy Systems with Control Delays
abstract: Based on the T-S fuzzy model, output feedback reliable control problem is studied for a class of uncertain switched fuzzy models with controlled time delay, which is developed by combing the switched fuzzy system, output feedback control and reliable control together .When the actuators seriously failedüthe unexpired part can not stabilize the original system, the output feedback reliable controller and the suitable switching law switching in the non-failure part of the actuator are designed to make sure that the closed-loop systems are asymptotically stable for all allowed uncertainties. A sufficient condition for the form of inequality that keep the closed-loop systems uniformly asymptotically stable is given with the method of multi-Lyapunov. In the end, the state curve and control curve of the proposed systems are given by simulink simulation to illustrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the output feedback reliable control method.

articleTitle: A Multi-attribute Group Decision-making Approach Based on Uncertain Linguistic Information
abstract: Considering the multi-attribute group decision-making based on uncertain linguistic information, interval 2-tuple weighted average aggregation (ITWAA) operator and uncertain linguistic averaging (ULA) operator are employed for the computation of integrated uncertain linguistic information from decision-makers in terms of evaluation attributes. Dominance likelihood matrix is constructed for each attribute according to the definition of likelihood, so as to determine the weight of each attribute. The uncertain 2-tuple ordered weighted average (UTOWA) operator is used to calculate the value of each alternative for ranking. The feasibility and effectiveness of this approach is illustrated in a case study.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis for Rolling Element Bearing under Variable Loading Based on Cumulant-based AR and FDA
abstract: Bearing failure is the most common source of faults in rotating machines. Aiming to solve the problem of fault diagnosis under variable loading condition, a new fault diagnosis method is proposed based on cumulant-based AR and Fisher discriminant analysis (FDA). The diagnosis performance of the proposed method is tested using vibration signals under four different loading conditions. The results show that the proposed method has higher diagnostic performance without the influence of operation condition variety.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of High-tech Industry Growth Based on Composite DEA Model
abstract: According to the connotation of high-tech industry and its growth, the paper proposes the evaluation index system of high-tech industry growth, which includes the absorbing degree of new technology and knowledge and the influence of new technology and knowledge on the surroundings, input level of social capital, alliance system innovation and input level of learning organization construction, innovation level of network business model, expense of encouraging the talented to attempt the creative idea, resource input index of establishing the sense of alliance identity, advanced situation of main product's technology compared with that at domestic and abroad, as well as the transformation of innovation achievement. Combined with the characteristics of evaluation index, the paper applies the composite DEA method to empirically evaluate the growth of high-tech industry in China.

articleTitle: Research of Group Recommendation Based on Matrix Factorization
abstract: In current big data era, it is more and more important to extract valuable data from big data, i.e. information filtering. Information filtering is categorized into personalized recommendation for the individual users and group recommendation; the later is the extension of the former and is more complex. The current group recommendation has quite a lot of shortages, such as ignoring the items' natural property, the users' interest and their behavior's temporal dynamics. Based on the advantages of matrix factorization on personalized recommendation, the paper adopts ridge regression analysis to propose a matrix factorization model (WMF model) weighted by the items; and combine the WMF model with time effect function to get further improvement. Experiments show that the proposed group recommendation has better precision and recall rate.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Control for Coupled Hyperbolic Linear Systems and Its Application
abstract: This paper is devoted to coupled linear first-order hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDE) systems. Firstly, the well-posedness of the system is analysis deeply. We solve fault tolerant control for such systems suffered from internal faults and coupling faults by boundary feedback technique. What's more, in order to analyze the coupling terms, small gain theorem for infinite dimensional system is further investigated. At last, boundary control based on small gain theorem is proposed to recover the process faults successfully.

articleTitle: Rapid hybrid modeling and nonlinear robust control for hydraulic system
abstract: In order to simplify the modeling procedure of a hydraulic system, we take advantages of bond graph and circuit network. First, the bond graph of hydraulic system is drawn and then transformed into its equivalent circuit diagram. Then, the transfer function of the system could be directly written with circuit network modeling method. Finally, in order to achieve the expected value of the system quickly, this paper adopts the nonlinear feedback and closed-loop gain shaping algorithm to design the robust controller for the model. Simulation results show that the controller has a satisfactory robustness and the methods of building model and the designed controller are effective with obvious energy-saving performance.

articleTitle: A Second-order Grey Model for Forecasting Interval Number Series
abstract: Interval number contains both the average and change information. This paper presents two second-order grey models suitable for the forecasting of binary and ternary interval number, named BINGM (2, 1) and TINGM (2, 1). The overall development coefficients of two models are taken as an accurate number, and the grey inputs are taken as interval numbers. By this method of parameter setting, the models are suitable for the interval number series directly, and no need to transform the interval number series into the accurate number series. The overall development coefficients, grey inputs, and constants in the forecasting formulas of TINGM (2, 1) and BINGM (2, 1) are all determined by the new information priority principle (NIPCM), instead of the least square method (LSM). The wind power generating capacity and the generating capacity of China are predicted based on BINGM (2, 1) and TINGM (2, 1). The forecasting performance is better than the models based on GM (1, 1).

articleTitle: Memory State Feedback and Robust Fault-tolerant Control for a Class of Time-delays Switched Fuzzy Systems with Nonlinear Perturbation
abstract: The problems of designing the memory state feedback controller and switching law for a class of time-delay switched fuzzy systems with nonlinear perturbation against actuator failures based on T-S models are investigated.The nonlinear perturbation proposed in this model is bounded, dealing with it in mathematical tools.A robust, fault-tolerant and memory state feedback controller with two different control gains, whose conservative is lower than memoryless controller, and system switching law are built using multiple Lyapunov function method to analyse the system stability. The sufficient condition making the close-loop systems asymptotically stable is derived through the above works, when the actuators have something wrong.The designed controller and switching law in this paper not only make sure the asymptotically stability of the close-loop systems against actuators failure, but also heighten the resistibility for nonlinear perturbation.Numerical example is provided to show the validity and effectiveness of the method what this paper proposes.

articleTitle: Target Bounding Box Adjustment Method Based on Feature Matching and Improved Three-channel RANSAC Filtering
abstract: In common target tracking algorithms, the focus is often on the location of the target, rather than on some of the changes of the target its own. Especially when the size and rotation of the target change, the bounding box is difficult to accurately adapt to this change. In this regard, we use SIFT feature matching method to find the corresponding feature points on the front and back frame targets, and get the mean value according to the distance and angle changes of all matching points as the basis of adjusting the bounding box. However, this method has a higher requirement for the accuracy of feature matching, otherwise, once there are some large deviations in the matching results, it will have a great impact on the final adjustment. In order to ensure reliability, besides improving the matching accuracy, a large number of accurate results are needed to calculate as well. Therefore, we adopt a matching screening method that combines three-channel similarity and RANSAC, which select a large number of accurate matching results as the basis to calculate the change of size ratio and rotation angle, to ensure that the adjustment of bounding box is accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Network Control Technology applied in Remote Mine Ventilation Control System
abstract: Mine ventilation control system is an essential link in the mining and mining industry, especially in the working face which requires strict gas concentration. The ventilation state and gas content in the well are very important for the staff. Therefore, the control of mine ventilation has important theoretical significance and practical significance, especially the control of remote mine ventilation system has received special attention in recent years. In this paper, the network control technology is applied to study the control of the remote mine ventilation system, and the network scheduling algorithm is used to reduce the influence of network induced delay. The air flow state is controlled by the speed regulation of the ventilator, the stability of the air volume under the mine is guaranteed, and the safety and reliability of the mine are raised.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis of Starting and Stopping for Single-axis Inertia Vibration Machine
abstract: This paper describes the transient vibration analysis of a single-axis inertial vibration machine. In order to avoid the disadvantage of excessive amplitude caused by the resonance zone during starting and stopping, a dynamic model of SDOF (single degree of freedom) is established based on the dynamic analysis of the physical phenomena during starting. According to the Runge-Kutta method in numerical analysis, a vibration differential equation based on linear vibration is established, and the variation of variables over time during starting and stopping of the vibration machine is analyzed, providing the theoretical evidence for the amplitude control. By means of computer programming, variables in the changing process are simulated and solved, data are processed to a certain extent, and numerical simulation is carried out. Finally, the rationality of the theoretical analysis is verified by experiments, which provides a reference for solving the problem of excessive amplitude increase in engineering.

articleTitle: Asynchronous control of Markov jump linear systems with incomplete transition descriptions
abstract: This paper presents the asynchronous control problem of Markov jump linear systems (MJLSs) with incomplete transition descriptions. Different from most of the existing results, controller modes are asynchronous with system modes described by conditional probability matrices (CPMs) in this paper. Moreover, the information of transition rate matrices (TRMs) in continuous-time domain and transition probability matrices (TPMs) in discrete-time domain are considered to be incomplete. In continuous-time case, the necessary and sufficient conditions of stability and sufficient conditions of stabilization are derived. In discrete-time case, the necessary and sufficient conditions of stability and stabilization are derived. Finally, several numerical examples are given to illustrate the results.

articleTitle: Path Planning Based on the Method of Integrating Adjacent Obstacles
abstract: Path planning for an autonomous mobile robot refers to using various sensors to detect its surrounding and finding a suitable path from the initial position to the target. In the current research on path planning of autonomous mobile robots, the artificial potential field method is widely applied because it is simple and concise. However, it may cause the robot to stop or circular motion of the robot in the area where obstacles are dense, that is the local minimum problem. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a neighbor-obstacle unifying method. It is composed of three steps. First, the position of the obstacles is detected by the sensors of the robot, and some obstacle areas can be obtained according to the distances between the adjacent obstacles. Next, a circumscribed circle is determined according to the center of each area, this circle is regarded as the integration of the obstacles. Finally, the original obstacles are replaced by the integrated one. This method can not only avoid local minimum, but also improve the efficiency of path planning. The simulation results verify the efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Design of Delayed Output Feedback of Linear Time-Varying Systems With Applications to Spacecraft Magnetic Attitude Control
abstract: This paper studies the low-pass filter (LPF) design in the delayed output feedback control of linear time-varying systems. In the case of linear time-invariant systems, the safe implementation of the distributed delay (integral terms) needs to introduce an LPF in the control loop and the LPF can be designed by using the pole assignment method. However, the parameters of LPF in linear time-varying systems are time-varying and the existing design methods are not applicable. This paper provides a new method to design the LPF for time-varying systems. The designed LPFs are such that, if the closed-loop system without LPF is uniformly asymptotically stable, then the closed-loop system with LPF is also uniformly asymptotically stable, while the later is robust with respect to approximated numerical implementation. Finally, simulations are carried out on a magnetic attitude control system and the results verify the effectiveness of the methods proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis of Key Influencing Factors of Equipment Battlefield Damage Test Design
abstract: In the design of the battlefield damage test, in order to reduce the cost of the test and obtain more equipment damage data, it is necessary to analyze the primary and secondary relationship of each test design factor. Firstly, the test plan is formulated by useing orthogonal test, and then a large amount of equipment battlefield damage simulation data is collected by using the equipment battlefield damage simulation platform. Finally, the gray correlation analysis method is used to analyze the test data, and the quantitative index of the correlation between the test performance and the main design factors of the test design is obtained. The analysis results show that the degree of influence of the experimental design factors on the test performance is ranked as: the distance of the explosion point > the vertical height of the ammunition from the ground > the horizontal angle of the ammunition > the elevation angle of the ammunition. The analysis results provide theoretical support for the design and optimization of the equipment battlefield damage test program.

articleTitle: Thrust Vector Control for Powered Flight of the Upper Stages
abstract: In the powered flight phase of a multistage rocket, a small deviation of the thrust direction will makes an extremely orbit transfer deviation from the target position. For an upper stage of rocket, a thrust vector control (TVC) is strongly affected by the center of mass owing to it is accomplished by a main gimbaled engine. In addition, the real location of the upper stage's mass center is hardly to be precisely obtained due to the limited identification accuracy of the identification system, which deteriorates the performance of the TVC system. To overcome this drawback, this paper develops a novel TVC strategy for the upper stage, making the thrust vector of the gimbaled engine aligns with its command direction. The direction can be obtained by the orbit design system with the center of mass uncertainty during the powered flight. The effects of the center of mass uncertainty on the TVC system, are derived, which include deviations in the command attitude and control torque. Then, a novel TVC strategy is developed for the upper stages to overcome these effects. The proposed method guaranteeing the thrust pointing accuracy under the center of mass uncertainty is verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Incremental Recursive Least-squares Identification for the Systems under Poor Observation Condition
abstract: For the autoregressive (AR) signal under poor observation condition, a kind of incremental recursive least-square (IRLS) algorithm is presented based on the incremental observation equation. Applying the convergence of RLS algorithm, it can be easily proved that the obtained estimates of model parameters and noise variance converge to the corresponding true values with probability one, i.e. they are strongly consistent. A simulation example shows its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Gaomi Cultural and Creative Industry Cluster Development Evaluation Research
abstract: Based on industrial cluster theory, cultural and creative industry theory, cultural and creative industry cluster theory and relevant theories, this paper establishes the development evaluation index system of Cultural and Creative Industry Cluster of Gaomi City through research and analysis of the concepts and theories of cultural and creative industry cluster, and evaluates the current development status of Cultural and Creative Industry Cluster of Gaomi City in the southern cultural region.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Energy Separation in a Vortex Tube with Different Vane Number Rectifiers
abstract: Based on the flow characteristics in the vortex tube, a kind of guide vane type rectifier was designed to improve the flow characteristics of the vortex tube. Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) method was presented to study the influence of the rectifier and the number of guide vane on the flow field and energy separation performance of the vortex tube. The results show that the axial and tangential velocity of fluid in the vortex tube is changed by rectifier, which promotes the energy separation process. It could be observed the temperature difference at both outlets of cold and heat fluid increases, and the temperature rise at the hot outlet is more significant. At the same time, the rectifiers with various number of guide vanes have an effect on the performance improvement of the vortex tube under each cold fractions. On the whole, three-vane rectifier is a better choice for optimization and can be applied in electronic cooling.

articleTitle: Detection and Location for In-pipe Detector Block Accident Based on Image Edge Processing
abstract: It is very dangerous for the in-pipe detector to block during operation. In this paper, based on the idea that negative pressure waves detect leaks in pipelines, the theory of pressure-based in-pipe detector blocked positioning is proposed. Image processing methods is applied to quickly detect and accurately locate the positive and negative pressure waves on the pressure curve. The pressure curve is converted into a one-dimensional gray image and the image edge detection method is utilized to determine the starting point of the pressure mutation. Specifically, pressure data is expressed as gray scale to make the positive and negative pressure waves more obvious. The simulation and application shows the effective and good performance of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Energy Regional Trading Strategy Based on Cooperative Game
abstract: The realization of multi-energy complementarity in the integrated energy region is the main trend of energy development. In this paper, we refer to the area containing integrated energy equipment and load as We-Energy. In the case of multi-energy coupling, energy trading only for electricity is no longer applicable. Therefore, the study of integrated energy transaction has theoretical significance and certain practicality. We establish operating cost model of We-Energy and the energy storage satisfaction is designed to model the reasonable behavior of the energy storage. Then the cooperative game is used to solve the trading problem and the Shapley value is also used to solve the cost sharing problem. At the end, the effectiveness of the cooperative game about We-Energy and the energy storage satisfaction are illustrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Decoupling Predictive Control of Reheat Steam Temperature of USC Double Reheat Unit
abstract: Based on the actual operating results of the domestic and foreign USC(ultra-supercritical) double reheat units, the USC double reheat unit has better economic and environmental benefits than one reheat unit when they have same capacity. However, the reheat steam temperature of double reheat unit becomes a multivariable system which is characterized by strong coupling, big inertia, and time delay, due to the complexity and particularity of double reheat unit's boiler construction. Realizing the effective control of two reheat steam temperatures requires a prompt solution.Predictive control is an effective method against such characteristics as time delay and big inertia-controlled object. This paper presents a decoupling predictive control strategy with input constraints to control the reheat steam temperature. To measure the control quality of the reheat steam temperature control strategy, the increasing and decreasing load tests were analyzed on the emulation platform of 1000MW USC double reheat unit, using Xi'an Thermal Power Research Institute adopting APROS emulation software. Simulation results show that the decoupling predictive control strategy with input constraints can achieve a better performance (except disturbance rejection) when compared with PID (Proportion Integration Differentiation).

articleTitle: Reliable Tracking via Adaptive Correlation Filter and Local Patches
abstract: Due to excellent classification performance, tracker based on correlation filter shows excellent performance in the most challenging occasions, such as illumination change, motion blur, and etc. However, these methods are still sensitive to occlusion and fast motion for they rely on the overall spatial construction of the tracked object heavily. In these scenarios, most conventional methods based correlation filter show performance degradation and can lead to eventual tracking failures. To circumvent drift in above complex scenes, we will derive an efficient method via correlation filter and local patches for tracking, which fully make use of the whole and local information of the target jointly. By incorporation the information of local patches into the tracking framework, the method is less sensitive to the cases with deformation, occlusion, and etc. To further improve the discrimination ability of tracker, we integrate the global representation in the tracking framework to fuse multi-channel features in the tracking process, which will improve the tracking performance significantly. Extensive experiments on several tracking benchmark datasets show that our approach achieved superior performance compared to several state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Robust Object Tracking Via Low-Rank and Reverse Fused-Lasso Regularization
abstract: Object tracking via low-rank and sparse learning easily exists the following problems: 1) requiring to solve a lot of l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> optimization problems, which is time-consuming. 2) usually occurring tracking drift when facing object abrupt motion. Therefore, a low-rank and reverse fused-lasso regularization based object tracking algorithm is proposed. Firstly, convex low rank approximation based on the nuclear norm is used to constraint the correlation of the candidate particles, so as to remove the uncorrelated particles. Secondly, fused lasso regularization is introduced to the object tracking, minimizing the absolute value sum of the sparse coefficient difference, which can restrict the object appearance with little difference between the consecutive frame, but allow the greater variation between individual frames, so as to adapt object abrupt motion. Thirdly, an inverse sparse representation formulation is built for object appearance, using candidate particles to represent the target template inversely, simplifying the computation for online tracking. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods, especially for object abrupt motion.

articleTitle: Cooperative Search Strategy for UAVs with Frontal Image Sensor
abstract: This paper focuses on the cooperative search strategy for a team of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with limited Field-of-View (FOV) and communication range. Firstly, the models of environment, UAV, frontal image sensor, and communication network are established. Secondly, a distributed map fusion strategy is proposed. Thirdly, a Voronoi Partition based Receding Horizon Control (VPRHC) strategy for path planning involved in the cooperative search is proposed, and available overload of the UAV and inter-UAV collision avoidance are taken into account. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed search strategy is demonstrated via simulations.

articleTitle: A New Machine Learning Based Framework to Identify Protein Glycation Sites Using Comprehensive Features and the mRMR Method
abstract: Accumulation of the final product during glycation reaction often leads to many diseases, such as diabetes, Alzheimer's disease and atherosclerosis. Identifying the glycation site can help researchers to understand the pathogenesis and provide new ideas on how to treat these diseases. In this paper, we develop a new predictor by using the support vector machine which apply four feature extractions to encode peptide chains such as binary code sequence, grey incidence degree, accessible surface area and secondary structure probability. The maximum relevancy minimum redundancy (mRMR) feature selection algorithm is used to select the optimal 170 features for the prediction problem. In training set, the performance of Gly-Predict is assessed with an accuracy of 84.815%, a sensitivity of 80.156%, a specificity of 88.868%, and a Matthews's correlation coefficient (MCC) of 68.411% by k-fold cross validation (k = 5). To objectively evaluate Gly-predict, we tested our model on an independent dataset and compared with previous predictor. The results indicate that Gly-predict is superior to existing glycation site predictors.

articleTitle: Current Tracking Method of Cascaded STATCOM With Passive Control
abstract: For the cascade STATCOM system, the traditional proportional integral (PI) control may bring the poor dynamic performance and be difficult in parameter determination. Therefore, a passive control based current tracking method is proposed for the cascade STATCOM. By establishing the passive model, the proposed controller is designed based on the global stability requirement of the system, so as to have strong robustness to external disturbances and parameter changes. The influence of passive parameters on system performance is analyzed and the off-line design of passive parameters is presented to aid in the implementation. At last, the cascade STATCOM control system is built and the feasibility and superiority of the passive controller is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis and Suppression Method of Train Network Side Based on Multiplex Control Strategy
abstract: This is the paper style requirement for the Chinese Control Conference. The writers of papers should and must provide normalized electronic documents in order for readers to search and read papers conveniently. In order to reduce the harmonics pollution by AC drive electric locomotive and EMU in traction power supply, this paper presents a side harmonic suppression method for train network based on multiple control strategy. Firstly, the structure and topology of multiplex control rectifier are introduced, then the influence of carrier modulation and carrier shift on train harmonic voltage and current is analyzed in detail. Finally, the validity of the harmonic analysis method and the effectiveness of the harmonic suppression method are verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Measurement Feedback Control of Nonlinear Uncertain Systems with Integral-ISS Dynamic Uncertainties
abstract: This paper studies the measurement feedback control problem of nonlinear systems in the cascaded form with dynamic uncertainties. It is assumed that the dynamic uncertainties are integral input-to-state stable (iISS). A new construction design with set-valued virtual control laws is proposed to deal with the measurement disturbance, and the closed-loop system is transformed into an interconnected system with the subsystem being ISS or iISS. The closed-loop system is proved to be iISS with respect to the measurement disturbance by constructing an iISS Lyapunov function.

articleTitle: A New Life Estimation Result Based on a Nonlinear Degradation Model
abstract: The degradation data have been widely applied in reliability analysis and life estimation for deteriorating products. The existing life estimation approaches mainly focus on linear degradation models, and the results under nonlinear degradation models are relatively limited in literature. Additionally, the normal distribution is commonly adopted to represent the unit-to-unit variability in the existing literature, but the assumption can be unsuitable for some practical applications. In this paper, a nonlinear degradation model is presented to estimate the life of deteriorating products. To be specific, a general nonlinear stochastic process with truncated normal distribution is used to characterize the dynamics and nonlinearity of the degradation, and the exact and explicit expressions of the life distribution are derived in terms of the concept of the first hitting time. A numerical example is also provided to demonstrate the applicability of the proposed results.

articleTitle: The Design of Intelligent Experimental System for Hardware-in-the-loop Simulation of Aerocraft Control System
abstract: To design the intelligent experimental system for hardware-in-the-loop simulation of aircraft control system, this paper realizes a multi-sensor intelligent data acquisition system. Multi-sensor intelligent data acquisition system uses photoelectric encoder, linear encoder, temperature acquisition module and other sensors. The output of sensor is digital with small interference. Multi-sensor intelligent data acquisition system includes photoelectric encoder, linear encoder, temperature acquisition module, data acquisition board, data acquisition computer, communication cable and other parts. Among them, data acquisition board realizes the communication protocol of EnDat and SMBus through FPGA programming, connecting with photoelectric encoder and linear encoder according to EnDat protocol, and connecting with temperature acquisition sensor according to SMBus protocol, then it collects and processes sensor information in real time. The experimental results show that the system can identify sensors with intelligence, quickly upload collected data values, and improve the acquisition precision with good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Soft Sensor Modeling and Adaptive Model Correction Strategy for Gold Cyanide Leaching Process
abstract: During the gold cyanidation leaching process (GCLP), due to the change of raw material properties and longterm use of equipment, production characteristics will undergo change in working conditions or slow time-varying, which will lead to degradation in model prediction accuracy and track performance. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a type process state recognition approach and an adaptive model correction strategy. Firstly,in this paper, the model residual and the rate of residual change as monitoring indicators of soft sensor model, which effectively distinguishes the process state of the leaching process from four circumstances that steady-state, working conditions, slow time-varying and outliers.
