Then the local moving window PLS method (L-WMPLS) and the recursive Just in Time Learning (RJITL) method were applied accordingly to correct the soft sensor model when GCLP occur slow time-varying and working conditions. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Defeating 2-D Runge Problem by Coefficients and Order Determination (CAOD) Method
abstract: Runge problem is a problem of edge-oscillations in polynomial interpolation of Runge function at evenly spaced nodes. While many works have been presented to defeat the 1-dimensional (1-D) Runge problem, its higher dimensional cases are rarely discussed. Our previous works have presented an approximation method called CAOD method to defeat the 1-D Runge problem. In this paper, we generalize this method to defeat the 2- (or higher-) dimensional Runge problem, and conduct computer experiments to substantiate the accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: Control Synthesis of Markovian Jump Nonlinear System via A New Fuzzy Switching Controller
abstract: The task of control synthesis of Markovian jump nonlinear system is well investigated through giving a new fuzzy switching controller aiming at easing the conservatism than before. Compared with previous results, less conservative stabilization conditions for the considered discrete-time Markovian jump fuzzy system can be gained which lead to wider application of the proposed theoretical method. In the analysis and derivation process, some important information hidden in the fuzzy basis function is well utilized and thus a new scheme of fuzzy switching control law is presented to reduce the conservatism that is caused by ignoring those important information hidden in the fuzzy basis function in the literature. Finally, the validity and advantage of the proposed method over the recent one is also demonstrated by controlling an inverted pendulum model.

articleTitle: Consensus building for interval MAGDM problems based on integer programming models
abstract: This paper is primarily interested in optimization consensus models in the context of multiple attribute group decision making (MAGDM) where the uncertain information can be represented by interval numbers. The preservation of the original opinion scales in the modified preferences, and the scarce number of consensus approaches for the interval MAGDM problem are the major motivations to develop new optimal consensus models. Two general consensus rules from a cost perspective are used as the objectives: one is to minimize the amount of preference changes and the other is to minimize the number of modifications. Based on the two rules, two consensus models based on the Manhattan distance are presented. The presented models can be solved by integer linear programming techniques. The main advantage of the proposed consensus models comparing to the existing approaches is that the generated preferences are belonged to the original scales. These models can be extended to other uncertain situations and can find wild applications in decision science.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control Allocation for Flight Systems with Stuck Actuator Failures
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive control allocation method for flight systems in the presence of stuck actuator failures and model mismatch. During the flight, some unknown actuators are stuck at unknown values and at unknown time instants, which badly influence the system stability. The method can adaptively allocate the control power to the operating actuators based on the failure pattern. More realistic situation that incorporates model mismatch caused by icing, modeling errors and damage is also be considered in this paper. The traditional reference model is not appropriate, and an adaptive reference model is designed to solve this problem. The effectiveness of the proposed method is simulated by a longitudinal linear model of the NASA Generic Transport Model. The simulation results show that this method gives better tracking error performance.

articleTitle: Research on Group Review and Conversion Algorithm Based on National Counselor Competition
abstract: The National College Counselor Professional Ability Competition is a large-scale competition for more than 130,000 college counselors. It aims to promote the specialization and professionalization of the counselor team. The competition carries out the way that the judges give reviews by groups. In order to avoid the impact of the different scoring habits of judges, the original scores need to be normalized. This paper analyses the drawbacks of the current normalization method, in which group players rely too much on the highest score and the lowest score, puts forward improving strategies, and makes an empirical analysis.

Author Keywords: National College Counselor Professional Ability Competition

articleTitle: A Color Separation Algorithm with Multi-Levels Grayscale for Glass Printing
abstract: This paper proposes a color separation algorithm with multi-levels grayscale for glass printing. Different from the existing algorithms without grayscale for glass printing, we separate the original image into several color separation layers with given grayscale levels, which can be easily applied to n grayscale levels' case. The number of color separation layers for one type of ink is considered before color separation, and grayscale levels of each pixel are varied by value of corresponding layers. After handling the transparency channel, original image is separated through dithering and the related color separation layers are written based on the grayscale intervals. Moreover, we put forward three methods of dividing grayscale intervals by using RGB values or grayscale values. The experiments show that original image can be appropriately separated into multi-levels grayscale and vividly expressed with a small average value.

articleTitle: Industrial Reactor Material Separation based on Image Recognition
abstract: The industrial/chemical reactor is a vital part when chemical production have been widely used in many factories. The material separation followed by the chemical reaction in the industrial reactor is crucial to the quality of product. At present, existing industrial reactor material separations mainly depend on human intervention, that suffers the drawbacks of high cost and low accuracy. In this paper, a novel intelligent image recognition based industrial reactor material separation algorithm is developed. The industrial reactor materials are first captured with a equipped camera and an improved binary color histogram feature extraction algorithm is then developed for image representation. The support vector machine (SVM) is trained as a classifier for material separation. A total of 1522 images of the industrial reactor material belonging to five different categories are collected for performance evaluation. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm is able to achieve an accuracy of 98.36% in the industrial reactor material separation, and outperforms the conventional histogram feature based algorithms.

articleTitle: On Control Strategy of Energy Consumption for Micro-electric Vehicle
abstract: In order to improve the mileage of the micro-electric vehicle, the vehicle energy consumption is optimized and controlled comprehensively. The research progress and evaluation standards of energy consumption are introduced, the influence degree of vehicle parameters on energy consumption is studied and the conclusion of their optimization is obtained. Compared with the regenerative braking system in actual engineering, improved regenerative braking control strategies are designed and implemented by fuzzy control algorithm, and the research is carried out by Cruise/Simulink joint simulation. The experimental results under NEDC driving cycle show that the optimization of vehicle parameters and control strategies can reduce energy consumption while satisfying safety regulations. In the process of parameter optimization and braking system design for the micro-electric vehicle, this research has certain reference significance.

articleTitle: Variable Structure Control Method for Human-Machine Cooperative Driving
abstract: Effective switching between the driver and the automatic driving controller is very important in semi-automatic drivin situation. To improve safety and smoothness of the switching in cooperative driving, and combine the human and the machine effectively, a variable structure control method for cooperative driving is proposed. By the method, the vehicle and traffic scenesare modeled firstly. The cooperative driving system model is composed of the driver control model, the automatic driving controller model and the traffic model. According to the characteristics of the cooperative driving system model and the corresponding parameter region, the stability regions of the driver control model and automatic control model are analyzed. Then a sliding mode controller is put forward where the control variables and switching function are designed to complete the transition between human and automatic driving controller. The control variables are designed by the deformation of models, and the switching function of sliding surfaces is estimated by the stability regions. Simulation results of multiple scenarios show the feasibility and effectiveness of the presented method.

articleTitle: The mean square exponential synchronization for stochastic complex networks perturbed with Poisson noise via a single controller
abstract: This paper focuses on the mean square exponential synchronization problem for a class of stochastic perturbed complex networks with Poisson noise. Different from the previous works, here the structure of the dynamical network is assumed to be directed and strongly connected. By designing a single state-feedback controller and using the stability theory of stochastic differential dynamics, some synchronization criteria are obtained to guarantee that the complex network with Poisson noise perturbation can be synchronized to an isolated system in mean square. Finally, numerical examples are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Predictive Control for Coke Oven Blowing Cooler System Based on SVR
abstract: Coke oven blowing cooler system is one of the important parts in the process of coking production. It is a complex system with the characteristics of nonlinear time-varying, multi-variable, strong random disturbance and so on which cause the system to be difficult to establish the accurate mathematics model. In this paper, a predictive control strategy based on support vector machine regression (SVR) is proposed. The support vector machine regression (SVR) modeling based on the structural risk minimization is used to predict model and the adaptive weight particle swarm optimization (APSO) algorithm is used to optimize SVR parameters. Then using online rolling optimization and feedback correction to forecast and compensate the error in the future. The simulation results show that the control strategy has strong anti-interference and robustness, and ensure the rapid and effective stability of the pre-cooling device pressure in the process.

Author Keywords: Coke Oven Primary Blowing Cooler System

articleTitle: Entire process accurate evaluation abandoned wind for high proportion wind power connected to large power grid
abstract: Aiming at the randomness and volatility of the abandoned wind with high proportion wind power connected to the large power grid, this paper proposed a the entire processes accurate evaluation analysis method with multi-dimensional, multi-period and multi-type, constructed a multi-dimensional analysis system such as electricity, hours, abandonment rate and abandonment ratio, and constructed a multi-period analysis system such as the annual, heating season, monthly and hourly electricity distribution and the corresponding low valley period, it also constructed a multi-type analysis system such as peak shaving abandoned wind and grid structure abandoned wind, which provides a theoretical basis for implementing large-scale abandoned wind consumption. Combined with the actual examples, the abandoned wind analysis system established in this paper has practical significance for mastering the law of abandoning wind and selecting appropriate measures for abandoning wind consumption.

Author Keywords: Abandoned wind law and Analysis system

articleTitle: Adaptive backstepping control of nonlinear systems
abstract: In this paper, a novel adaptive backstepping control scheme is proposed for a class of nonlinear systems with unknown disturbances. A new adaptive disturbance approximation algorithm is proposed to estimate unknown compound disturbances, including external disturbances and system uncertainties. The controller is designed by combining adaptive and backstepping methods. The Lyapunov function is applied to ensure stability of the system. Simulation results demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed control technique.

articleTitle: Two level optimization model for multi period compounding loan of engineering project groups
abstract: To reduce the financial risk of engineering project loan, the multi period compounding loan problem of engineering project is studied. The background and precondition of two level optimization model for multi period compounding loan of engineering project group (2OMMPCLEPG) are described. The variables and parameters of 2OMMPCLEPG are defined. In the objective function of 2OMMPCLEPG, financial risk for multi period compounding loan of engineering project is minimized. In the constraints of 2OMMPCLEPG, the time of multi period engineering project loan is limited according to the demand of engineering project; the amounts of project loans in each year should not be less than the amounts of engineering project demand capital; the amounts of repayment in each year is no less than the total capital amounts of capital which can be used for repayment; the thresholds of total loan amount, total repayment amount are limited. 2OMMPCLEPG is applied into a practical instance of multi period compounding loan of engineering project, it is solved and validated. The result shows that the more balanced repayment amounts scheme of the compounding loan for the engineering project are achieved obtained by 2OMMPCLEPG than that by artificial experience. 2OMMPCLEPG is benefit for reducing financial risk of engineering project.

articleTitle: Environment-Based Railway Transportation Safety Assessment Using Hybrid Belief Rule Base
abstract: For the high-speed line and the existing line in the Cheng-Yu region, an environment-based railway transportation safety assessment approach using hybrid belief rule base (H-BRB) is proposed. Indicators of building the H-BRB models include rain, wind, fog, frost, disasters and so on. Model data are from January 1, 2017, to August 30, 2018. The case study shows that high-speed line is relatively safer than the existing line. The results of the assessment are compared with the historical records of accidents and failures to verify the effectiveness of the method. The H-BRB model contains both conjunctive and disjunctive rules, which can reduce the number of rules and thus avoid the combination explosion problem.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Freedom Gymnastic Robot with the Ten DOF
abstract: Robot is a research focus at present, and how to build and design a robot, the related model building is difficult. In this paper, a 10-DOF gymnastic robot is proposed and designed, which includes the head of the robot, the left and right two-DOF arm structure, the two-DOF waist structure and the left and right two-DOF leg structure. By establishing the dynamic model of a typical two-degree-of-freedom joint robot, a reasonable overall structure and model of the robot are designed, and the actual object of the robot is made. In this paper, the ATmega32 is used as the main controller. Through the software design, the corresponding gymnastic movements of the gymnastic robot are compiled, including two-handed push-ups, one-handed push-ups, handstand, roll forward and a series of actions. Through the application analysis of the actual robot, the feasibility and validity of the 10-DOF gymnastic robot model designed in this paper are verified. It can be widely used in teaching platform, scientific research and competitions.

articleTitle: Ground Moving Targets Recognition Based on Chaos Genetic Algorithm
abstract: The target feature selection and the hidden layer numbers confirm of the neural network are the key problems in the radar target identification. In this paper initial population suitable for ground moving targets recognition is constructed. Then the alterable crossover probability and alterable mutation probability are proposed, which consider the influence of every generation to algorithm and the effect of different individual fitness in every generation. A satisfying result is acquired after many times crossover and mutation operation. At last by analysis and comparison of the final classification results of three kinds of ground moving targets, the feasibility and effectiveness are tested.

articleTitle: Random trajectory tracking of flexible manipulator with buffer
abstract: Modeling, tracking and stability analysis for flexible manipulator with buffer under stochastic disturbance is researched. In the absence of noise, the Lagrange system is obtained combining kinetic energy with potential energy. The stochastic oscillation in the environment is equivalently transformed into disturbance to the controller, and the Lagrangian system with colored noise is obtained. Based on the quasi-lower triangular structure of the model, a trajectory tracking controller with design parameters is obtained by using the multiple-input-to-multiple-output backstepping method, such that the nonlinear system is noise-to-state stable in probability. By adjusting the parameters of the design scheme, the result of tracking error is small enough as we expected.

articleTitle: A fuzzy time series model study based on Principle Component Analysis
abstract: In view of the problem of how to filter fuzzy rules,this paper presents a method based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA).Firstly, construct the covariance matrix of fuzzy rules and calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors, Then fuzzy rules are filtered out according to the contribution rate of the eigenvalues, Finally, through the forecasting of Dow Jones stock, results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: The Study on Opening Book Based on Computer Game of Draughts
abstract: Computer game is one of the important research directions in the field of artificial intelligence. The opening book is an important way to improve the level of computer game program. This paper first discusses the understanding of computer game and gives a brief introduction to the rules of draughts. The moves in the opening are of great significance to the development of the whole game. This paper takes the draughts with 10*10 board computer game program as the research object and introduces the method of applying the opening book. The application of opening book avoids the time-consuming search of the program in the opening and the strategic mistakes that affect the overall development. This paper also studies the generation method and structural design of the opening book. It demonstrates the necessity and superiority of the application of the opening book in the draughts computer game program.

articleTitle: Initial alignment of shoulder-launched miniature munitions
abstract: In the Strapdown Inertial Navigation System (SINS), the initial alignment accuracy directly affects the navigation accuracy. In this paper, the initial alignment of the moving base of the human body in the irregular motion state of the shoulder-launched miniature munition is studied. By establishing the mathematical model of the initial alignment process and the error model of the SINS, the Kalman filter is used to estimate and solve the platform error angle according to the initial pose matrix provided by the alignment. The results show that the Kalman filter algorithm effectively improves the initial alignment accuracy of miniature munitions.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on the Service Pricing Strategy of Car Wash Industry
abstract: The service price decision problem in car wash industry was studied in this work. Based on the customer perceived value theory and revenue management theory, queuing theory and method were used to analyze the per-use pricing strategy and subscription pricing strategy according to the service time (including waiting time and service time in the service process) and service ability. Considering the complexity of different pricing schemes and service capacity, the service time cost, service ability cost, service-processing rate and customer arrival rate were used as the decision variables to establish the service pricing decision model in car wash industry. The relationship among the service time cost, service capacity cost and profit was revealed by the model. The decision goal is to determine the specific implementation strategy of service pricing scheme in car wash industry and maximize the enterprises' profits.

articleTitle: Research on Arm Movement Aided Electronic System for Parkinson's Patients
abstract: Parkinson's patients have different degrees of dyskinesia due to the controlling ability decrease of the brain to muscles, their typical symptoms are static tremors. A movement aided electronic system was designed in this paper, it can assist patients' arm movements to restrain the tremor. Feed-forward control and band limited multiple Fourier Linear Combiner Algorithm were adopted. The experiment results showed that the system could initially realize the function of arm movement to relieve the tremor, which had certain effect to improve the life quality of Parkinson's patients.

articleTitle: Prediction for Gyros output based on EMD-SVR
abstract: To solve the problem of prediction for Gyros real-time output, improve the prediction accuracy of Gyros output, a new prediction algorithm based on Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) and Support Vector Regression (SVR) is put forward in this paper. Due to the non-linearity and non-stability of Gyros output, the conventional prediction methods are not accurate, so the Empirical Mode Decomposition were chosen to decompose the Gyros output to several Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMF) and a residual series. For these IMFs and residual series, use Support Vector Regression to build the prediction model. The prediction results of IMFs and residual series were merged to obtain the Gyros output. Result show that this prediction algorithm is effective compared with Support Vector Regression, which verified the precision of the method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Signal Processing for Position and Speed Detection System of High Speed Maglev Train
abstract: Position speed detection technology is the key technology of high speed maglev train traction and control system. Signal processing unit is crucial for position speed detection technology. This paper introduces the structural framework of the signal processing part of the position speed detection system. The signal processing of the relative and absolute sensors is described. The internal signal transmission between the crate and the sensors is presented. And the tests are given to validate the performance of system.

articleTitle: Weighted Fusion Incremental Kalman Filter
abstract: Usually, the unknown system error is widespread and difficult to be verified or corrected, which will yield to relatively large filtering errors. Incremental equation can eliminate the unknown system errors and improve the accuracy of state estimators. On this basis, a kind of optimal weighted fusion incremental Kalman filter is presented in this paper. It has the global optimality, and greatly improves the state estimation accuracy for the multi-sensor systems under poor observation condition. The proposed algorithm is simple in form and small in computational burden so as to be easily applied in engineering practice. The simulation results show its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Train Air-conditioning Controller Interface Based on Linux and Qt
abstract: Good air-conditioning system is an important reflection of passenger comfort. Traditional air-conditioning controller interface is mostly realized by the combination of PLC(Programmable Logic Controller) and configuration software. However, with the continuous development of urban trains, the requirements of control accuracy, response speed and equipment expansion are constantly improved. Therefore, this paper presents the design and development of train air-conditioning controller interface based on Linux platform and Qt framework. Firstly, the design method and requirements of the interface are determined from the user-centered point of view, and then on this basis the framework of the interface is determined. Secondly, the interface drawing, control association, data refreshing and thread safety which are realized by Qt framework and C++ design pattern are introduced. Thirdly, the PID(Proportion Integral Derivative) control model of air-conditioning controller is established with temperature as input and air-conditioning unit as control object.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a Positive and Negative Sequence Component Separation for Grid Voltage Based on the Improved Method of Instantaneous Symmetrical Components
abstract: In this paper, the voltage sag information extraction is taken as the research object, and a simulation model based on voltage sag caused by different transmission lines is established. On account of the problems that the detection techniques of fundamental harmonic of a positive and negative sequence for common grid voltage of power network have poor ability of suppressing harmonic interference and slow detection speed, a method of instantaneous symmetrical component based on adaptive notch filter is proposed. Three adaptive notch filters are used to extract the fundamental components and their 90° phase-shift components of the three-phase unbalanced voltage signal, and the instantaneous symmetrical components are used to separate the fundamental positive and negative sequence voltages of these components. The improved method are simulated. The results of simulation demonstrate that the proposed and improved algorithm can quickly and accurately detect the magnitude of voltage positive and negative sequence components and track the change of grid frequency.

articleTitle: An improved multipoint interpolation DFT algorithm for high-frequency underwater acoustic communication
abstract: An improved multipoint interpolated DFT method is presented for underwater acoustic communication. This method originates from two known Hann-windowed algorithms and derives the general form of the unwindowed interpolation algorithm using the relationship between the rectangular window and the Hanning window. The paper applies multipoint interpolation for frequency estimation and extends the processing of FSK underwater acoustic signals from the frequency domain to the complex frequency domain. The method has better performance for high-frequency water acoustic communication. The reliability and precision of this proposed method are verified by field experiments.

Author Keywords: suppression of noise and wake waves

articleTitle: Power Control with Quantized Feedback in Wireless Networks: Stability Analysis of Foschini-Miljanic Algorithm
abstract: This paper is concerned with the power control problem in wireless networks and presents bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stability analysis of the classic Foschini-Miljanic (FM) power control algorithm with logarithmic quantized feedback. Thereby, we first construct the model of FM algorithm with logarithmic quantized state feedback, where the feedback scheme has been used by multi-input system with imperfect input channels. Then we analyze BIBO stability of system and derive sufficient and necessary condition of the stability. Finally we provide numerical examples to demonstrate the correctness of condition and compare quantized effects under different parameters.

articleTitle: Soft Sensor for Ball Mill Load Based on Multi-view Domain Adaptation Learning
abstract: In the operation process of wet ball mill, there are often multi-modal and multi-condition problems. In this paper, a multi-view based domain adaptive extreme learning machine (MVDAELM) was used to measure the mill load. Firstly, the correlation relationship between the load parameters and the two views (vibration and acoustic signals of the ball mill) was obtained by Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) respectively. Secondly, a small number of labeled data from the target domain were introduced to construct a Domain Adaptation Extreme Learning Machine (DAELM) model under manifold constraints, which solve the mismatch problem caused by the change of working conditions in the multi-condition grinding process. Finally, based on the correlation coefficient obtained before, the two views domain adaptive load parameter soft sensor model was integrated to solve the uncertainty problem in single-modal data modeling. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the learning accuracy of the soft sensor model under multi-modal conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Incentive Decision-making Scheme for Charging Electric Vehicles in Internet of Things: A Stackelberg Game Aproach
abstract: With the help of Internet of things (IoT), many more advantages have easily been brought to electric vehicle (EV) users supplied from mobile charging stations (MCSs). However, through the existing methods, the charging problems cannot be solved with many different constraints, i.e., the finite power supply and the dynamic arrival of EV users. In this paper, we propose a four-stage Stackelberg game scheme to study how to charge EV users in MCSs. Firstly, this charging system composed of EV users, MCS operators (MCSOs) and smart grid operators (SGOs) in IoT is considered. Due to the trading relationship among them, the utility functions of them are designed when bit error ratio (BER) as an important performance criterion in IoT is also taken into account, leading to the uncertainty of power demand. Then, through the backward induction method, we obtain the optimal strategy while the existence of Stackelberg equilbrium (SE) is analyzed and proved. Considering the complex computation, an iterative search algorithm for SE in this four-stage game scheme is presented. Finally, simulation results validate the effectiveness of our proposal and each of them in this charging system can be benefited.

articleTitle: A Visual Detection System Design of Multi-region Segmentation Based on Embedded System Framework
abstract: Aimed at the features that the production speed of personal health products was fast, surface background feature was complicated and position was disperse, a visual detection system of surface defect of linear scanning multi-region segmentation based on embedded system framework was designed in this paper. The design principles of all function modules of system were introduced in detail. Moreover, according to the speed requirement of production line and the operational capability of embedded image processing, a statistical algorithm of threshold segmentation was proposed. The practical application proved that the production line running of health products on this system was stable, detection effect was reliable, and debugging application was simple, which could meet the requirements of industrial popularization and application.

articleTitle: A Community Detection Approach on Data Latent Relationship
abstract: One of the most important steps in community detection is detecting clusters. In many applications, they pay more attentions in the direct relationship in data. However, with the development of the Internet and complex network, the data set is growing bigger and bigger, and the latent relationship in data sets is becoming more and more important. Taking all of these into consideration, a community detection approach on data latent relationship is proposed in this paper. The frequent item-sets and item-association Markov network are introduced to present the data latent relationship, and it also can processed in distributed stations. The validity of this method is discussed in theory and illustrated by experiment.

articleTitle: Self-adaptive chaotic local search particle swarm optimization for propylene explosion region parameter identification
abstract: A new parameter identification method for propylene explosion region based on self-adaptive chaotic local search particle swarm optimization (SACLSPSO) algorithm is proposed. First, the chaotic local search is integrated with the particle swarm optimization (PSO), which contributes to avoid PSO falling into local minima. Then, the nonlinear dynamics inertia weight coefficient is incorporated into the chaos local search particle swarm optimization (CLSPSO) algorithm to balance the overall search ability and the local improvement ability of the CLSPSO. Third, the learning factors with asynchronous change are developed to enhance the capability of the information exchange. It is shown that the proposed algorithm has some advantages, such as good stability, strong information exchange capacity and fast convergence. Meanwhile, it can also overcome the drawback of easily falling into the local minimum. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed SACLSPSO algorithm could achieve high accuracy in the parameter identification of the propylene explosion region. The propylene explosion region of reactor is from 2.5% to 12.7% and the propylene explosion region of mixer is from 2.6% to 11.4%, which are in the reasonable interval (2%~11%). Therefore, the safety of propylene oxidation process is ensured and the efficacy of the proposed algorithm is proved.

articleTitle: Application design of 3D printing technology in the field of Architecture
abstract: This paper points out the advantages and disadvantages of 3D printing technology in many aspects, and according to one part of the shortcomings, puts forward two design schemes to solve these problems. The software part of the two design schemes draws the design drawings by drawing software, and then transfers the data of the drawings to the hardware part by slicing software. The hardware part uses Arduino development board as the main control chip to control the working mode of the steering gear and the cement truck, and prints through the nozzle device to complete the work according to the design requirements. One way is to use the rudder to control the 6-DOF manipulator, the other is to use the rudder to control the flexible lifting rod. Experiments show that this design can be realized. The purpose of this design is to improve the practicability and efficiency of 3D printing technology in the field of architecture.

articleTitle: Feature extraction using nonparametric margin discriminant analysis
abstract: High dimensional data often lies in a low dimension structure and is often recommended to perform dimensionality reduction before the tasks of classification or clustering. In this paper, we propose a new method called nonparametric margin discriminant analysis based on the trace ratio criterion (TRNMDA) to extract discriminant vectors from original high dimensional space. TRNMDA does not have the assumption on data distribution that overcomes the limitation of LDA, which can not perform well in non-gaussian data. Compared with other nonparametric methods like nonparametric maximum margin criterion (NMMC), TRNMDA takes full advantage of marginal information, which is essential for classification. Experiments conducted on three standard face data sets have validated that our proposed method is more effective than several state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: An Improved Lexicographic MO-MPC Based on Linear Decomposition
abstract: A computational efficient multiobjective model predictive control (MO-MPC) scheme with prioritized objectives is proposed for linear time-invariant system with state and input constraints. The terminal states are decomposed into several auxiliary decision variables and then the traditional terminal control law is parameterized by using the several corresponding controller gains. According to the priorities of multiple objectives, the MO-MPC problem is reformulated as a multi-layer single objective one. Moreover, by establishing the conditions on the most important objective, the recursive feasibility and asymptotic stability properties of the designed MO-MPC are proved by the method of the triplet of the terminal constraints, terminal penalty functions and local state feedback laws. Finally, the advantages of the new MO-MPC are illustrated by a numerical example in terms of the enlargement of terminal set and the low computation loads.

articleTitle: Kinship Understanding for a Family Photo
abstract: In social media analysis technology, kinship mining and understanding is an import issue. Previous works mainly focus on kinship verification between two people, while there has been less research on multiple person kinship recognition of the entire family. In this paper, we present a model to analyze the kinship of all members in a single family photo. Assume that a standard family relationship framework already exists. For an original photo, pre-processing and feature extraction are performed first. Then, we use kinship constraint rules to fill the framework all potential position with members in the photo. Next, calculate the genetic similarity information of the person to determine more specific position. At last, adjust and output the corresponding family tree. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Detection and Recognition Algorithm of Optical Fiber for Surface Defects
abstract: Based on machine vision technology, this paper studies the detection and identification technology of surface defects of optical fiber communication cables. This paper uses mathematical geometry and linear interpolation method to convert cable cylinder into plane. Based on the gray-scale characteristics of the pinhole in the picture, gray threshold and gradient amplitude are used to improve the detection rate of the pinhole. Finally, the experimental results show that this algorithm can all-around detect the surface defects of optical cable, with the minimum detection area of 0.05mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the diameter detection accuracy of 0.1mm, and real-time alarm for defects. In the case of a lot of dust, ensure the correct detection of conventional defects on the surface of the cable, the correct detection rate of the pinhole reaches 70%, reducing the false alarm rate of dust and water stains.

articleTitle: Modeling and Decision of Success Probability of Ship Sail Mission in Multi-Force Cooperative Operation on the Sea
abstract: Thinking about the requirements of ship missions in multi-force sea cooperative operations, put forward the view of redundancy time in ship sail. The definition of redundancy time is given and modeled. The criterion for judging the failure of the sail is discussed. The calculation method of the upper and lower limits of the redundancy time and the actual redundancy time in the sail is given, and the redundancy time and the success probability of the typical redundancy process are calculated by the simulation method. The relationship between the probability of sail success and various types of sail parameters is discussed, and the optimal sail strategy of the ship is analyzed. A feasible solution is proposed for the simultaneous arrival problem in multi-military maritime coordinated operations.

articleTitle: Research on Target Identification Technique of Anti-ship Missile Terminal Guidance Based on GA-BP
abstract: Aiming at the target recognition problem of anti-ship missile terminal guidance radar, the statistical mean, maximum value, minimum value, range, standard deviation, variation coefficient, smoothness of RCS frequency sequence are proposed as the feature vector, which is classified by GA-BP neural network. The simulation results show that the GA-BP model greatly reduces the possibility that the BP network would be trapped in the local minimum. At the same time, compared with the single RCS size feature, the multi-dimensional RCS frequency statistical feature can significantly improve the anti-missile target recognition capability.

articleTitle: A Novel Game-Theoretic-based Security-Constrained Unit Commitment Including Wind and Vehicle-to-Grid
abstract: A novel multi-objective security-constrained unit commitment model is proposed in this paper considering wind power and electric vehicles. A fuzzy chance-constrained program is utilized to solve the wind power forecasting errors. We use game theory and formulate an EVs energy scheduling game. The proposed distributed EVs energy management strategy requires each EV owner to simply apply its best response strategy to the current total load and tariffs. Numerical simulation was conducted on the IEEE 24-bus system to demonstrate that the synergy between wind power and V2G can promote the utilization of wind power and make the power system operation more eco-friendly and economical.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Consumption Oriented Car-Following Model for Electric Vehicles Traffic Flow
abstract: A new car-following model has been proposed for electric vehicle traffic stream in order to minimize the energy consumption. In particular, we first introduce the energy consumption model of electric vehicles. Then, the new car-following model is derived from the optimal energy consumption model using the minimum principle theory. Results from numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model in terms of position, velocity, and acceleration profiles.

articleTitle: Robustness Analysis of Urban Public Transportation Network Based on Accessibility Index
abstract: With the accelerating process of China's urbanization and the gradual expansion of the city scale, the robustness and reliability of urban road traffic networks are particularly important. This paper took the public transportation network in Heping District of Shenyang as the research goal, and obtained the important public transport stations as the research object. The bus stations were used as the nodes of the complex network to analyze the degree, the degree distribution, the clustering coefficient and the average path length. Node attacks included random attack, degree attack and betweenness attack. This paper analyzed the robustness of the network by combining the changes of network efficiency ratio and accessibility index. The research results show that the accessibility index can be used to analyze the robustness of complex networks, and the public transportation network has good robustness against the random attack, poor resistance against the deliberate attack, and degree attack is more destructive than betweenness attack.

articleTitle: Wastewater treatment sensor fault detection using RBF neural network with set membership estimation
abstract: There are many sensors used to monitor the quality of the effluent during the wastewater treatment process. So the normal monitoring of the sensor is critical to wastewater treatment. In this article, the proposed sensor fault diagnosis method is based on fault diagnosis of interval prediction which using RBF neural network with set membership estimation. After some input and output data of the WWTP are obtain, an interval containing the actual output of the system without a fault can be easily predicted. If the sensor measured is out of the predicted interval, it can be determined that a fault has occurred. This paper also establishes two independent interval diagnosis models to further make sure whether the senor is faulty or the system is faulty. The results demonstrate that the proposed sensor fault diagnosis method is effective and useful.

articleTitle: Research on Target Selection Simulation Based on Multidimensional Feature Parameter Identification
abstract: Aiming at the problem of sea surface target selection, the multi-dimensional characteristics of group targets in sea background are summarized by the analysis of single target and group target feature parameters. The multi-dimensional characteristics of target indication information are normalized by relative situation calculation based on penetration direction. On the basis of this, the comprehensive matching of group target situation and multi-dimensional feature parameters is carried out, and the general principles and steps of group target parameter identification are given. In order to verify the effectiveness of the method, target selection parameters are selected for typical formation targets. The simulation calculation is identified, and the simulation examples and calculation process are given. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the selection probability of formation targets.

articleTitle: Cooling load forecasting for public buildings
abstract: In order to realize optimization control strategies for central air conditioning systems, an air conditioning load forecasting model for public buildings is developed with BP neural networks. Bayesian normalization method is used to train the neural network model for improving its generalization abilities. The neural network model constructed in this thesis is simple in structure, and does not need to know the internal mechanism between the load and its influencing factors, and has fewer input parameters, avoiding cumbersome calculations. This project utilizes the real-time data samples of the water storage air-conditioning system from June to August for network training and network verification. The validity and accuracy of the model model are verified by comparing the load prediction value with the actual load value, which can be used for central air conditioning. Research on system control strategy and predictive control of water storage air conditioning systems. It can be used for the research of control strategy of central air conditioning system and the research of predictive control of water storage air conditioning system.

articleTitle: Aero-engine Sensor Fault Diagnosis Based on Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: A fault diagnosis method based on convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed for aero-engine sensors. Convolutional layers and pooling layers in CNN are used to extract correlation features among sensed signals, based on which fully connected layers are used to diagnose sensor faults. The inception module method is used to extract features on different data sizes among sensors, making the method capable of detecting multi-sensor faults. The simulation results based on a turbofan engine model demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Clustering Research on Ship Fault Phenomena Based on K-means Algorithm
abstract: Use data mining to extract useful information and knowledge of equipment fault repair information data, so as to provide equipment design and maintenance support services more fully. This is of great significance for strengthening the management and design of equipment, improving the integrity of equipment and the effectiveness of maintenance support. Based on the characteristics of historical maintenance data of a ship's equipment, this paper proposes a data mining method based on K-means clustering, and analyzes the fault phenomenon in equipment maintenance historical data, and analyzes the distribution of equipment failure modes. The situation provides effective data support for the analysis of equipment failure causes and the design requirements generation of the support features.

articleTitle: Leakage Detection in Pipelines Based on Synchrosqueezed Wavelet Transform
abstract: Because of uncertainty, the diagnosis of gas pipeline leakage is a difficult problem. In order to solve the difficult problem to distinguish leakage in gas pipelines, an approach of leakage detection using Synchrosqueezed Wavelet Transform (SST) and Stacked Contractive Auto-encoder (SCAE) was proposed. First, the sound signal in gas pipelines is subjected to simultaneous compression wavelet transform to obtain time-frequency images n grey-scale and normalized the image. Then, the time-frequency representations were compressed to the appropriate size. The compressed time-frequency matrix should be expanded into a column as the SCAE’s input. The classification model of SCAE and SoftMax was established to realize the leakage detection in pipelines. The experimental results indicated that this method could effectively identify small leakage in pipelines, and the method could effectively improve the fault recognition rate and reduce the training cost.

articleTitle: Workflow Model Mining Based On Educational Management Data Logs
abstract: Process model plays a guiding role in the programming and configuration phases, while data plays a leading role in the implementation, monitoring, and diagnostic phases. The paper selects the logs data in Xi'an Education Statistics Basic Database Platform as the data source and the purpose is to mine the real data service flow. During the mining process, we need to solve the two-loop problem. At the end of the paper, the improved algorithm results are measured by four quality dimensions (fitness, simplicity, precision and generalization), and finally the complete process model from the event logs is discovered. The results indicate that the improvements have an important influence for process model optimization.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Algorithm on Light Intensity Applied to Threshold Selection for Pipeline Detection Based on Image Processing
abstract: Pipeline is one of the safest and most effective ways to transport oil and natural gas, whose quality is correlative with the safety of oil or gas transportation. Therefore, effective extractive detection of pipeline faults is essential. In the work of extracting pipeline faults, selecting the appropriate thresholds is a very important step. Based on some traditional image processing algorithms, a processing algorithm for parallel detection with the method of adaptive threshold is proposed briefly here, and the corresponding examples and processing effects are also given. The experimental results show that the method can accurately select the optimal threshold for pipeline inspection under certain illumination intensity, which provides great convenience for the subsequent processing in the field of pipeline detection.

articleTitle: Perpetual American Put Option With Default Risk
abstract: An American option gives the owner the right to buy or sell an underlying asset at a specified strike price on any trading day or before expiration. It has become an important financial derivative, and plays an essential role in the financial market. In this paper, we introduce the credit risk to enhance practicability of the option. Once credit risk occurs, the option will lapse immediately. In the context of a reduced form model driven by a Brownian motion, we give the explicit solution to the American put option based on the constant default intensity function, and the solutions of free boundary problems are also obtained. It turns out that the structure of optimal stopping strategies has changed since the credit risk is taken into account.

articleTitle: A Study on the Game System of Dots and Boxes Based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In this paper, based on AlphaZero, we propose a model with deep convolutional neural networks using value function and policy function for Dots-and-Boxes game system. In supervised game learning strategies, one challenge is the lack of sample data of high-quality. Our approach for solving this problem is to generate sample data effectively by iteration and self-playing. Experiments demonstrate that our novel method can significantly enhance the gaming skill of Dots-and-Boxes.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Self-balancing and Navigation Robot Based on ROS System
abstract: Based on the SLAM (instant location and map construction) technology of monocular vision and multi-sensor information fusion, the following robot self-balancing path planning system is proposed. The system can handle strenuous moving images well, and for scenes with simple description and feature points being scarce, no loss of positioning occurs. In the selection of key frames and the connection of local maps, a variety of algorithm optimization and multi-sensor fusion methods are selected, which makes the drawing faster and more accurate. Path planning uses a more accurate and time-saving bionic algorithm-ant colony algorithm, combined with gyroscope and PID processing feedback information to achieve self-balancing and navigation path planning.

articleTitle: Comparison and Simulation of Particle Swarm Optimization and Lagrange Multiplier Method
abstract: Based on the simulation of the social activities of biological groups, the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm simulates the mutual synergy of group organisms to construct a new intelligent optimization algorithm. This article briefly introduces the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm and the Lagrange Multiplier Method, and introduces an optimal distribution example of active power in the power system. It is simulated by MATLAB and compared with the Lagrange multiplier method. Compare and draw conclusions.

articleTitle: Incremental Wiener Predictor for the Systems under Poor Observation Condition
abstract: Usually, the unknown system error is widespread and difficult to be verified or corrected, which will yield to relatively large filtering errors. Incremental equation can eliminate the unknown system errors and improve the accuracy of state estimators. On this basis, a kind of incremental Wiener predictor is proposed for the systems under poor observation condition in this paper. It is simple in form and small in computational burden so as to be easily applied in engineering practice. The simulation results show its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Analyzing the collision probability changed over time at intersections for autonomous vehicle
abstract: In this paper, a method for calculating vehicle collision probability is proposed. The vehicle running state and the relationship between the velocity and displacement are determined by analyzing the vehicle running speed sequence. Using the Monte Carlo simulation method, the frequency histogram of vehicle running time that arrived at collision point is obtained. In order to get the vehicle running time distribution function, the vehicle running time probability corresponding to the frequency histogram is fitted by the Gaussian fitting method. At last, the collision probability of two vehicles at intersection is calculated by the collision formula. The experiment results show that this method can calculate the collision probability of vehicles exactly, which can provide correct operate decision and environment information for autonomous vehicles, and also make the whole autonomous technology more reliable.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Driver Training Expert System based on Driving Posture Recognition
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of driver training expert system which is created to coach and train the person especially driving learner who lacks of the correct driving posture in various sequence of driving postures. Webcams are used as visual sensors to obtain the driving leaner posture as input parameters. Image processing, Viola-Jones and Skin Color Segmentation algorithms are used to recognize driving learner postures. A rule-based expert system is built to evaluate whether the detected driving posture is correct by considering the relation between head movement with the activities on steering wheel and shift lever. If incorrect driving posture has occurred, this proposed method can be corrected it by giving the proper advice. The experimental shows the effectiveness of the proposed method in coaching and training the driving learner.

Author Keywords: Skin Color Segmentation and Driver Training Expert System

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Hive and Intelligent Bee Farm Based on Internet of Things Technology
abstract: Internet of things technology is to collect any object or process that needs monitoring, connection and interaction in real time through various information sensing equipment and technology. At present, in the process of bee breeding, it is the most difficult problem to understand the internal situation of the beehive under the premise of least disturbance to the bee colony. The application of Internet of things technology can solve this problem. This paper discusses the design of intelligent beehive structure, and expounds the application of iot technology in beekeeping industry from two aspects: intelligent beehive and intelligent factory. This article aims to help the beekeeping industry reduce employment, increase production efficiency and improve the quality of honey.

articleTitle: Application of synchrosqueezed wavelet transforms in Lamb wave based structural health monitoring of wind turbine blades
abstract: The wind turbines are deployed in harsh natural environments and operate at high loads. In this situation, the wind turbine blades are easily damaged. Active Lamb wave based structure health monitoring technology is a proper way to ensure the safe operation of wind turbines. However, due to the complex propagation of Lamb waves in the wind turbine blades, it's usually hard to analyze the responses and to extract the characteristic parameters. Synchrosqueezed wavelet transforms is a one of the new time-frequency domain analysis methods. It is based on wavelet transform and synchrosqueezed compression to extract wavelet ridges, which makes the time-frequency expression of harmonic signals clearer. In this paper, the application of synchrosqueezed wavelet transforms are introduced based on the analysis of the mechanism of active Lamb wave based structural health monitoring. In the experiments, wavelet transform and synchrosqueezed wavelet transforms was performed on a series of responses, and the effectiveness of synchrosqueezed wavelet transforms in active Lamb wave based structural health monitoring is verified by comparison.

articleTitle: Improved fault detection and tolerance method based on local test and adaptively robust filtering for INS/GNSS integration
abstract: The abrupt fault contained in GNSS measurement will reduce the accuracy of SINS/GNSS loosely-coupled integrated navigation. To solve this problem, the performance of residual chi-square test method is analyzed, on this basis, an improved fault detection and tolerance method based on robust adaptive adjustment is proposed. The local test is implemented to detect and identify the faulty observation. Aiming at the problem that the small size of fault is hard to detect, the gain matrix is adjusted adaptively by using the robust adaptive factor to improve the fault tolerance ability for the missed detection. This in turn improves the detection performance of local test method for the small size of fault. The simulation results show that compared with conventional methods, this method has better performance for the abrupt fault especially small size of fault, and can improve the accuracy and reliability of integrated system effectively.

articleTitle: An Interval Discrete Wavelet Neural Network Model and Its Numerical Analysis
abstract: This paper proposes an interval discrete wavelet neural network (IDWNN) model with learning algorithm, which can be used for the system modeling with uncertainty. Compared with the conventional interval BP neural network (IBPNN), IDWNN has both the time-frequency localization characteristics of wavelet analysis and the powerful nonlinear approximation ability, which can provide some guidelines for the network structure construction. The algorithms of the forward calculation and the gradient descent-based back propagation training of IDWNN are derived. The numerical simulation results show the advantages of IDWNN in network structure selection and convergence speed.

articleTitle: A Unified Coordinate Frame Method for GNSS/MEMS-INS Navigation System
abstract: For GNSS/MEMS - INS integrated navigation system, the traditional geographic coordinates of longitude, latitude, altitude as navigation parameters involving the floating point operation of angle is improper to be implemented practically. In this paper a unified coordinate transformation algorithm is presented .The N-coordinate reference frame is served as the reference navigation system. And improved combination algorithms is designed on engineering scenes. Which will reduce the complexity of the combination algorithm, decrease the amount of calculation and reduce the cost of engineering. The method has been tested successfully practically, based on real data and simulation of MEMS sensor and verified the feasibility and navigation accuracy of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Assistance Evaluation and Online Optimization Method of Lower Limb Exoskeleton Based on Musculoskeletal Model
abstract: Human intends play a dominat role in exoskeleton robot control system and frequently need an accurate estimation algorithm. This paper attempts to build a detailded musculoskeletal model of the knee joint based on human anatomy, and then introduces electromyographic(EMG) signals to estimate human body intend from sitting to standing. We identified parameters of musculoskeletal model considering individual differences. Furthermore, an evaluation indicator is proposed that appropriately reflects the comfortable degree of human body and muscle strength. An online optimization algorithm of the evaluation indicator is then investigated to obtain expected exoskeleton forces. The simulation results indicate that the musculoskeletal model is able to correctly estimate msucle torque, and the indicator makes it possible to follow human motion to some extent.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Integrated Ship Monitoring Network with High Reliability and Zero-time Self-healing
abstract: The realization principle of zero-time self-healing network communication technology is introduced. According to the characteristics of ship monitoring, an integrated ship monitoring network is designed, which integrates the information of ship monitoring equipment. By setting up a network performance test environment, the information delay of self-healing network switch is tested, and the technical characteristics of "no packet loss" are verified. Zero-time self-healing network communication technology is an innovative technology in the design of ship monitoring network. It will greatly reduce the laying of network cables, reduce the workload of information upgrade and transformation of ships, and has the characteristics of continuous maintenance of the network. It has a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: ℋ∞ Stability Criteria for Memrisitve Neural Networks With Time Delays
abstract: This paper investigates the ℋ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> stability of memristive neural networks with time delays. Two alternative methods, which take into account the excitatory and inhibitory of memristor-based synaptic weights, are provided to develop the desired ℋ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> stability conditions. It is shown that both the two methods can be viewed as the tradeoff between conservativeness and complexity. Under the proposed methods, several concise delay-dependent and delay-independent ℋ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> stability criteria are formulated in terms linear matrix inequalities, respectively. In the end, two comparative examples are presented to illustrate the viability of our methods.

articleTitle: SMC-based Data-driven Terminal ILC for Nonlinear Discrete-time Systems with Unavailable Intermediate Measurements
abstract: In this work, a new terminal iterative learning control is proposed by incorporating the sliding mode control (SMC) to address for the system uncertainties. The learning control system design and analysis is provided directly for a class of nonlinear and nonaffine discrete-time systems via a data-driven method by passing modeling steps. An iterative sliding surface with respect of terminal output error is developed at first. The terminal learning control is then attained by designing and minimizing an objective function with the sliding surface. The robustness of the proposed method is guaranteed by rigorously theoretical analysis and is further verified by simulation results provided in this work.

articleTitle: An Improved Adaptive Weighted Gaussian Nearest Neighbor Classification Method
abstract: The category of a test sample is decided by the template sample which has the smallest distance to the tested one for the traditional nearest neighbor algorithm, which may cause the sample to be misjudged. In order to improve the correct classification rate, more template samples should participate in decision-making. Therefore, the item of class distance used to classify the test sample is proposed in this paper, which is relative to several template samples selected adaptively. The Gaussian function is employed in the class distance because of its better clustering. To verify the merit of the improved methods, experiments of grading 1588 tobacco leaves belonging to 41 levels by the nearest neighbor algorithm, its improved methods, SVM, SRC, BP, RF and Adaboost have been implemented under the same conditions. The experimental results show that the adaptive weighted Gaussian nearest neighbor has better recognition ability than other methods.

articleTitle: Design of Drive Control Strategy for Mini Pure Electric Vehicles on the Condition of Slope Climbing
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the driving performance of mini pure electric vehicles is insufficient in vehicle's climbing ability, a vehicle driving control strategy based on an new fuzzy control and the total torque command with the corresponding MAP is proposed to help advancing to improving the vehicle's driving performance in vehicle's climbing ability. The article uses the characteristics that the fuzzy control have better recognition for abstract acceleration intentions, this fuzzy control identifies the real-time state information of vehicle and the change rate of acceleration pedal opening, which represent the driver's acceleration intention, and the reference torque derived from the total torque command with the corresponding MAP is compensated to different degrees according to different acceleration intentions, which can improve the driving performance of the vehicles climbing ability, such as dynamic performance and maneuverability. Finally the vehicle tests verify that the whole vehicle driving control strategy proposed in this paper significantly improves the dynamic performance and operating performance, which make the vehicle more practical in the slope climbing condition of 5%~10% than the traditional control strategy, and the control is simple and easy to implement.

Author Keywords: Driving Control Strategy and The Fuzzy Control

articleTitle: Cooperative Strategies with Boundary Conditions for Optimal Aircraft Simultaneous Attack
abstract: In this study, a distributed guidance law for simultaneous attack of multiple missiles on single target is proposed. The guidance law consists of two components, one component utilizes the optimal control theory and boundary conditions to ensure missile-target relative states converge to zero, while another component keeps the relative states consistent before the simultaneous attack is accomplished. The control inputs and adaptive parameters are optimized by a protocol function to avoid excessively large input. The boundary conditions are designed to ensure the relative states converge to the designer specified values. The simulation results demonstrated the practicability of the proposed guidance law.

articleTitle: The Evolution Law and Crisis Early Warning of Military-related Network Public Opinion
abstract: According to "The Reform of Military Commission" and "Japanese aircraft interfering with Chinese military aircraft" cases, the general evolution law of military-related network public opinion is summarized, and divided into "latency-formation-diffusion-extension-repetition" five stages, then the "Five-stages and seven-points" model is established. Furthermore, the crisis prediction methods are expounded in each stages, and the crisis early warning mechanism as well as strategies are put forward, which provides correlative references for army to control net-mediated public opinion more properly and effectively.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis and Prediction of Runoff Based on Chaotic Wavelet Neural Network
abstract: This paper proposes a method combining phase space reconstruction and chaotic wavelet neural network to predict runoff. The mutual information method and Cao method are selected to calculate the delay time and embedding dimension, and the Lyapunov exponent is used to judge the chaos. In the chaotic wavelet neural network model, the reconstructed time series is used as the input of the neural network, and the wavelet function is used as the activation function of the neuron. Applying the model to the prediction of the daily runoff and monthly runoff of the Mississippi River, the results show that the model is effective for predicting data of different scales and still has high precision under a long prediction period.

articleTitle: Intelligent Diagnosis of Power Transformer Working Fault
abstract: The most important power equipment in a power system is a transformer. Its mission is heavy and its cost is expensive. The safe operation of the transformer directly affects the safety of the entire power system. Once a fault occurs, it will have a huge impact on the power system and the end users. harm. At present, the effective method for diagnosing the internal fault of transformer is the dissolved gas analysis method in transformer oil. Based on the relationship between transformer fault gas and fault type, BP neural network model of transformer fault diagnosis is established. And genetic algorithm is used to optimize the weight and threshold of BP neural network. Through testing fault model, results show that the fault diagnosis rate meets the requirement and it has excellent practical application value.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive control of output-constrained linear motor
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a control law for the linear motor system with output constraint. To prevent the output large variation of the motor, we employ a Barrier Lyapunov Function in control law design, which grows to infinity as its variables approach the given limits. By introducing Barrier Lyapunov Function into the control law design, it can ensure that those given limits to the output are not transgressed. Comparing the control performance with one that is based on a traditional quadratic Lyapunov method, it shows that the tracking error is within the preset range during the whole transient process under the proposed controller instead of large variation of Quadratic Lyapunov control method. The simulations and experimental are carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control law at last.

articleTitle: Efficient constrained fault tolerant optimized tracking control for a class of LPV systems based on double signal compensation and predictive regulation
abstract: This paper considers the constrained fault tolerant optimized tracking control problem for a class of LPV systems. The proposed control strategy is consisted of three parts. First, the unconstrained robust tracking control policy is designed off-line, which basically guarantees the closed-loop stability of tracking error systems. Second, the double signal compensation policy is further designed off-line, which eliminates the influences from fault, fault estimation error and unknown process noises. Third, a extra degree of freedom, i.e. predictive regulation, is introduced to handle the state/control constrains online. In addition, the predictive regulation also has the ability to optimize the tracking performance. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed tolerant control strategy is validated by a comparison test example.

articleTitle: Soil Moisture Measurement Based on Monte Carlo Method
abstract: Soil image samples were collected and calculated image gray level, the probability distribution of soil image gray level was analyzed. A mathematical model was constructed with the average gray-value of soil image as input and soil moisture as output. Measurement of soil moisture was calculated based on Monte Carlo method. Comparison of measured values and actual values of soil water content, the results show that: 1) Using Monte Carlo method measure soil water content that reduces the analysis of complex nonlinear model, reduces the calculation of some additional first-order or high-order sensitivity coefficients, and reduces the amount of calculation. 2) The accuracy of measurement value depends on Monte Carlo simulation times, and the more number of Monte Carlo simulations, the more accuracy of the soil moisture content measurement values, which makes the very small error between the measurement values and the actual values of soil moisture content.

articleTitle: A New Weighting Method based on Gap Metric for Multi-model Predictive Control
abstract: A new weighting method is proposed based on gap metric for multi-model predictive control of nonlinear systems. The proposed weighting method is simple but efficient. It is used to combine the local predictive controllers into a multi-model predictive controller which is employed to optimize and control the considered nonlinear system. Compared to traditional weighting methods, such as the Trapezoidal weighting method, the Gaussian weighting method, and so on, the proposed new weighting method has just one tuning parameter, and thus it is simple and easy to tune. Besides, it continues the merits of the traditional method: the weights can be computed off-line. What is more important, it is effective to schedule the local model predictive controllers and get an effective control signal to control the outputs. Therefore, the closed-loop performance is raised and the stability and robustness are improved. A CSTR system is studied to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-step Finite Set Model Predictive Control for Modular Multilevel Converters
abstract: This paper mainly proposes a multi-step finite set model predictive control for modular multilevel converters(MMC). For multi-step finite set model predictive control problem, a simplified optimization method is proposed to reduce the candidate vectors to cut down the computational burden. Besides, the voltage sorting algorithm is designed to make the number of switches are controlled, instead of switch states. The simulation result shows that this method has good performance. In order to satisfy the real-time requirement of power electronics with high switching frequency, Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is used for control algorithm speeding to meet the real-time requirement of Mosfet used in MMC.

articleTitle: An innovative method for optimization of power system restoration path
abstract: Optimization of power system restoration path is a combinatorial optimization problem, which is one of the sub-problems of the whole power system restoration. Because the optimization of restoration path problem is a classical NP-hard problem and time consuming, furthermore the corresponding solution algorithm for optimal path will be performed frequently during the entire optimization process. It is very important to speed-up the computational runtime of optimization procedure. In existing research, heuristic algorithm has been widely used to solve this problem due to its strong optimization capability, and has achieved a good performance. But the efficiency of existing heuristic algorithm for large scale system should be further enhanced. Therefore, an efficient heuristic algorithm based on minimum cost maximum flow modelling has been proposed in this paper. The problem of optimizing power system restoration path is formulated as a minimum cost maximum flow problem. The system topology is constructed as a single-source and single-sink network, maximizing the network flow is used to ensure the connectivity of restoration path, then the best set of energizing transmission line can be found by minimizing the cost of flow from source s to sink t. The IEEE standard test systems are used to examine the applicability of proposed method. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method is more efficient than traditional method.

articleTitle: Intertemporal pricing strategy for partial mixed bundling
abstract: Traditional bundling strategy includes pure components, pure bundling and mixed bundling. As the service industry develops, more varieties of bundling gradually emerge. By using the game theory, this paper sets up an analytical model to study the partial mixed bundling in a duopoly price competition. One firm sells the partial mixed bundling in stage 1 and decides the bundling price as well as the individual product price. Then the other firm sells the left component and decides the individual service price in stage 2. Numerical experiments show that the equilibrium pricing strategy is jointly influenced by the marginal product cost and the bundling discount.

articleTitle: A Novel Control Design of Bilateral Teleoperation System with Fuzzy Logic based General Environments
abstract: In this paper, a novel adaptive robust sliding mode control(ARSMC) design is proposed for bilateral teleoperation system to achieve simultaneous stability and good transparency performance under communication delays, nonlinearities and uncertainties. For the environment force, the fuzzy logic system is used to model the environments with the general form, and the non-power environment parameters are identified and transmitted to the master side for the environment force estimation, which avoid the stability problem in the traditional teleoperation system. For both master and slave subsystems, the reference trajectory generators are designed, and the ARSMC approach is employed after-wards to design the controllers in view of nonlinearities and uncertainties.
