On the basis of the Kinetic model of two-link manipulator, the proportional, integral and differential coefficients of the PID controller can be online adjusted by the multi-objective optimization algorithm for the desired motion planning path, so that the motion of two link manipulator can be controlled. The optimization results show that the self-tuning PID controller of NSGA-II can effectively control the joints according to the established target, especially the proposed preference information based RV-NSGA-II multi-objective algorithm has less deviation on joint position control.

articleTitle: Adaptive non-singular terminal sliding mode control with high-gain observers for robotic manipulators
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive non-singular terminal sliding mode controller is proposed for robotic manipulators in the presence of uncertainties and disturbances. The adaptive control is used to obtain robustness to system uncertainties and disturbances. In addition, the high-gain observer is employed to estimate the speed information, which make the controller more applicable in practice. Theorem proof and simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Prediction Based on Dynamic STARMA Model
abstract: Wind power prediction plays an important role in the safe integration of wind power. In this paper, we propose a dynamic spatial-temporal autoregressive and moving average (STARMA) model for short-term wind power prediction. The adjacency matrix is determined based on the variations of wind speed and direction, and predicted by using the autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) model. The proposed wind power prediction method can reduce the influence of wind direction on prediction accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed prediction method.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Complex Dynamic Network under One-Sided Lipschitz Nonlinear Condition
abstract: In this note, the synchronization problem of complex dynamic network system is investigated. By considering the more general nonlinear Lipschitz nonlinear conditions, the improved results of complex network system is obtained. By using the Lyapunov function method, the general complex dynamic network system framework is established. At the same time, Some generic mean square stability criteria are derived in terms of nonlinear conditions, which guarantee that the complex network system can be forced to some desired trajectory. Finally, the numerical example is proposed to demonstrate the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A Time Weight Convolutional Neural Network for Positioning Internal Detector
abstract: Pipeline is widely used in long-distance transportation of various oil and gas energy sources. After years of use, these pipelines are vulnerable to corrosion caused by external environment. Regular internal inspection for the pipeline can detect the corrosions in time. The risk of detector blockage is very likely to occur in the detection process. Therefore, how to locate the position of internal detector is particularly important when it is blocked. This paper presents a new approach to positioning internal detector based on time weight convolutional neural network. The algorithm effectiveness is tested by using experiment data obtained from ultra-low frequency electromagnetic wave. The results demonstrate that the proposed method can improve the accuracy of internal detector positioning.

articleTitle: Fast salient object detection based on multi-scale feature aggression
abstract: Since the current CNN-based salient object detection algorithms are of slow speed, as well as fail to preserve rich information of object boundaries, which makes the regions along object contours blurred and inaccurate, a fast salient object detection algorithm with multi-scaled features aggression was proposed. Based on deep ResNet-50, four kinds of features in various resolution levels are extracted separately and then aggregated, which can make the output of network preserve more detailed information about object boundaries, so that the blurry salient maps can be solved via the proposed method. We trained an end-to-end model on THUS10K database, the resulting network can produce a saliency map with pixel-level accuracy from an input image. Extensive experiments on PascalS and DUTOMRON confirm that the proposed method achieves higher AUC and F-measure value while processing images at a rate of 15 fps, which is dramatically faster than any other eight existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Generalized Traveling Salesman Problem based on Modified Ant Colony Optimization
abstract: The generalized traveling salesman problem(GTSP) is a typical combinatorial optimization problem. Many practical problems involving the allocation and optimization of multiple tasks can be reduced to the generalized traveling salesman problem. A modified ant colony optimization is proposed for GTSP. The modified ant colony algorithm combines 2-opt algorithm to minimize the total path length, while considering the task balance of different travelers. Simulation results show that the modified ant colony optimization has good optimization accuracy and stability in solving the generalized traveling salesman problem.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Energy Optimization Strategy of Parallel Hybrid Electric Vehicle Based on Improved Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Parallel hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) is a complex control system and in this paper we mainly study its energy control strategy. Firstly, a fuzzy logic control strategy is designed. The fuzzy controller takes the difference between the required torque and the optimal torque of the engine, state of charge (SOC) of the battery and the motor speed as the inputs, and the engine output torque factor as the output. Secondly, because the division of membership functions and the formulation of fuzzy rules have certain subjectivity, we use an improved adaptive genetic algorithm (IAGA) to optimize the parameters of the fuzzy controller. Finally, two control strategies are simulated on the ADVISOR platform. The simulation results show that compared with the original fuzzy control strategy, the optimized fuzzy logic control strategy could improve the fuel economy of the vehicle and reduce the emissions significantly.

articleTitle: Course Controller Design for Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on Trajectory Linearization Control with Input Saturation
abstract: This paper proposes a novel course controller for unmanned surface vehicle (USV) by trajectory linearization control (TLC) technology, disturbance observer technique and auxiliary design system. First, TLC is a nonlinear tracking and decoupling control technology, which is a new control method in the USV field. Then a nonlinear disturbance observer (NDO) is constructed to estimate and compensate for unknown time-varying disturbance. In addition, auxiliary design system is hired to deal with input saturation issue. All the error signals in the course control system are uniform ultimate bounded by Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, numerical simulations are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed course control strategy.

articleTitle: Modeling and Robust Control with Virtual Inertia for Super-large-Scale Battery Energy Storage System
abstract: A secondary coordinated control method with virtual inertia is proposed in this paper, which takes full advantage of the large capacity of energy storage in the super-large-scale energy storage system. Firstly, the architecture of super-large-scale energy storage system and the structure of control system based on power converter are constructed. Accordingly, the non-linear model of the system is established and the virtual synchronous generator model is equivalent. Meanwhile, the influence of different virtual inertia on the output frequency of the system is investigated. Based on these, a secondary coordinated controller is designed by using robust control method. As a result, it can solve the asynchronous problem of voltage and frequency when multiple energy storage units are connected to the grid in large-scale energy storage system, due to the complexity of equipment and the limitation of conventional control system architecture. Finally, a simulation system of energy storage station is built to verify the control effect of virtual inertia and the designed secondary coordination controller.

articleTitle: Research on the Coupling Vibration of Middle-Speed Maglev Vehicle and Track Beams
abstract: The influence of the coupling vibration between the medium-speed maglev vehicle and the elastic bridge is becoming more and more prominent with the increase of vehicle speed, which may cause the vehicle rail crashing and endanger the safety of the vehicle. Therefore, studying and mastering for discipline of movement about suspension system and the elastic bridge track is necessary. In this paper, the electromagnetic field analysis method and the kinetic analysis method are used to mathematically analyze the magnetic field, and the single electromagnet suspension system model is established. Considering the mutual influence between the vehicle and the track under active control, the response of the electromagnetic suspension system is observed, the main parameters of the track and the intrinsic influence on the system vibration is analyzed, and the theoretical analysis is verified by numerical simulation. These results provide the theoretical basis for further research on the vibration of the maglev system.

articleTitle: Ultra short term probability prediction of wind power based on wavelet decomposition and long short-term memory network
abstract: With the large-scale wind integration into power grid, the intermittent and stochastic nature of wind power possess a threat to the safety of power grid, and wind power prediction has become one of the most important solutions to the current grid connection problem. However, the prediction error in point prediction of wind power cannot be ignored, so it is necessary to make probability prediction of wind power and improve reliable information to the power grid dispatch department. In this paper, by combing with the wavelet decomposition technology and the long short-term memory (LSTM) network, an ultra short-term probability model is proposed. Firstly, the original time series are smoothed by wavelet decomposition technology, then the LSTM network prediction model of each sub-series sample is developed. The Gaussian distribution function of the prediction error is obtained by using the maximum likelihood estimation method, and finally the probability interval prediction of the future wind power in four hours could be realized. Finally, by using the data collected from a wind farm in northeast china, a numerical example is presented to illustrate the usefulness of the proposed method, which show that combining wavelet decomposition with deep learning method can improve the accuracy of prediction, improve the interval reliability of probability prediction, and enhance the generalization ability of the model.

articleTitle: Control and Synchronization of a New Class of Finance Chaotic Systems
abstract: In this paper, a class of improved finance chaotic systems is constructed, which is more in line with actual economic activities. The dynamic behaviors of the new systems are analyzed by bifurcation diagrams, Lyapunov exponent spectrum and system phase diagrams. In addition, both theory and simulation prove that only one adaptive controller can realize control and synchronization of the new systems when the parameters are unknown. Furthermore, composite controllers combining adaptive control and linear feedback control are proposed, which realize control and synchronization of the new class of finance chaotic systems quickly. Finally, simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: An adaptive EWMA median chart for monitoring the process mean
abstract: The Adaptive Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (AEWMA) chart is known to combine the Shewhart and the classical EWMA schemes in a smooth way. In this paper, we studied the run length properties of the AEWMA median chart using a Markov chain approach and the performance of the proposed chart is compared with the existing Shewhart and EWMA median charts. The comparative results show that the AEWMA median chart represents a good alternative to achieve a reasonable balance for various shift sizes.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Motion Trajectory of PUMA 560 Manipulator Based on MATLAB
abstract: In this paper, the mechanism and kinematics of the six degree of freedom joint manipulator PUMA560 where contains the forward kinematics, inverse kinematics and trajectory planning problems of PUMA560 are analyzed by the standard D-H method, and the forward and inverse kinematics transformation formula is derived. The manipulator was modeled with Robotics Toolbox, and the forward kinematics, inverse kinematics solutions and trajectory planning were simulated which can obtain the required data in MATLAB. This paper studies the changes of the main kinematic indexes of the robot in the process of operation, which intuitively reflects the motion state of each rod and end working part of the robot, and provides a theoretical basis for the specific development and control strategy of the manipulator.

articleTitle: 3D Magnetic Field Finite Element Analysis of Dual-Stator PM Spherical Motor
abstract: In this paper, the three-dimensional magnetic field analysis of a dual-stator permanent magnet spherical motor is carried out by the finite element simulation software ANSYS. This method uses ANSYS Parametric Programming Language (APDL) to simulate the motor and then analyze the data through MATLAB. Parametric modeling involves building geometric models, assigning material properties and meshing, and then applying loads and boundary conditions to solve them. Compared with traditional Graphical User Interface (GUI) modeling methods, parametric analysis can modify parameters, analyze multiple sizes, adjust to achieve harmonic analysis, and successfully implement the function of 3D magnetic field analysis. The results verify that the method has high precision and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Improving Dynamics of the Single-Genetic Regulatory Networks with Delays via PD Controller
abstract: In this paper, the stability and Hopf bifurcations are investigated in the single-genetic regulatory networks with time delays. The total time delay is chosen as the bifurcation parameter. We can gain that the bifurcation condition for the single-genetic regulatory networks via PD controller. At last, we carry out some experiment simulations to verify the correctness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A Method for Position Estimation of Mobile Robot Based on Data Fusion
abstract: Triangulation is a commonly used method for position estimation of mobile robots. In this work, we describe the triangulation algorithms in detail and analyze the error by establishing a Gaussian error model. We perform multiple triangulation algorithms using angular information of landmarks in one scan. A different approach is proposed to fuse the estimated values which is acquired from multiple triangulation algorithms. The proposed algorithm effectively improves the accuracy of position estimation based on triangulation and reduces the uncertainty of position.

articleTitle: Simulation of Urban Macro-Traffic Flow Based on Cellular Automata
abstract: By transforming the topology of city blocks and roads into grids, and using two-dimensional cellular automata model with different traffic capacity to express the roads with different widths, a simulation model of urban macroscopic traffic flow is presented and the operation rules of cellular automata are designed in this paper. In view of the characteristics of distributed occurrence, evanescence and time variation of traffic flow, the quantity of traffic OD (origin-destination) is updated step by step according to simulation time. The macroscopic running track and quantity distribution of urban traffic flow within a period are simulated through the operation of cellular automata. The results of simulation have reference value for urban road traffic planning and traffic flow evacuation.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Gas Pressure Regulator Based on Recursive Least
abstract: Establishing a good system model is the basis for effective control. Firstly, the basic principle of system identification based on recursive least squares method is introduced. The recursive least squares algorithm is simulated by MATLAB software, and the corresponding simulation results and analysis are given. The obtained model is verified, and then the gas pressure regulator is taken as the research object. The fuel input and output data are analyzed and processed, and the recursive least squares method is used to identify and establish the black box model of the gas pressure regulator.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Semi-Active Suspension System with Double-Pendulum Spray Boom
abstract: Currently, aiming at the problem that the height control of the boom on the large-sized sprayer is not satisfied to track the ground undulations or obliquity, a position tracking strategy on spray boom suspension system with double-pendulum was proposed. First, the second Lagrange kinematics equation was applied to build double-pendulum spray boom suspension model, a non-linearity mathematical model is gained and linearized for satisfying the demands of controller designing. Second, the augmented state space equation was built and the controller was designed by linear quadratic optimal control theory to make the output error of the system converge to zero, the ability of tracking was proved and the results of simulation showed that the controller designed had a great performance of tracking the ground undulations or obliquity.

articleTitle: A Hypergraph-Based Key Management Scheme for Smart Charging Networking
abstract: In this article, to deal with data security requirements of electric vehicle users, a key management scheme for smart charging has been studied. According to the characteristics of the network, three elements and a two-subnetwork model between the charging and the electric vehicle users have been designed. Based on the hypergraph theory, the hypergraph structure of the smart charging network is proposed. And the key management scheme SCHKM is designed to satisfy the operational and security requirements of this structure. The efficiency of SCHKM scheme is analyzed from the cost experiment of key generation and key storage. The experimental results show that compared with the LKH, OFT and GKMP, the proposed key management scheme has obvious advantages in multi-user and key generation cost.

articleTitle: Study on a Class of Robust Fractional Interference Observers
abstract: In order to reduce the system performance degradation caused by parameter variation and external disturbance uncertainty, and to ensure the tracking performance and anti-interference performance of the system, this paper studies the robust fractional-order disturbance observer. Fractional-order observers have greater flexibility in order selection than integer-order observers. Firstly, based on the hybrid sensitivity method, the evaluation function of the interference suppression performance and the noise suppression performance is defined, so that the influence of the detection noise on the system is reduced to a certain extent, and the influence of the interference on the system is minimized within a certain frequency, and the system performs stability analysis.

articleTitle: Design of Environmental Control System Based on Embedded Modbus
abstract: In order to improve the stability of the control system in the plant, and the reliability of data transmission, this paper proposes a design of Environmental Control System Based on Embedded Modbus, using STM32 processor with embedded Cortex-M3 as the core. Through the Modbus fieldbus technology, the subsystems in the plant factory are relatively independent and easy to expand, improving the reliability of the transmitted data and avoiding unnecessary circuit interference. At the same time, in order to monitor the plant factory information in real time, the experiment developed a "smart plant factory environment control system" PC software using C# language. The results show that the plant growth cabinet based on embedded Modbus bus has good regulation, and plants based on this environment can get better growth.

articleTitle: Fault Detection of Flight Vehicle Electric Servo System by Extended Kalman Filter
abstract: An extended kalman filter based fault detection method for the servo system of flight vehicle is proposed in this paper. The servo system considered in this paper is a electric servo system together with a nozzle. By considering the electric servo system and the nozzle as a whole, the nonlinear model of them is built and the possible faults are analyzed. Then an extended kalman filter is introduced to detect the faults of the whole system. An experiment on the a simulation equipment with same size and weight as a real one is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed fault detection methods.

articleTitle: An Improved Image Inpainting Method Based on Patch Matching and Texture Synthesis
abstract: Compared with the pixel based image restoration algorithm, the digital image restoration algorithm based on sample blocks is more effective for the restoration of texture and structure information in large area damaged images. The key technology is to determine the repair order. In this paper, an improved priority value calculation method is proposed. The experimental results show that the improved method can further improve the repair order of the region to be repaired and fill the missing part of the image with the matching block in the improved order on the basis of the original algorithm. The unreasonable extension phenomenon is reduced, and the texture and structure information are more accurately distinguished, which makes the inpainting effect more coherent in vision.

articleTitle: Complex Network Nodes Attack Method based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Recently an increasing number of research is devoted to the question of how to find the most influential nodes effectively in complex networks Actually, the problem of complex network nodes attack is searching the way to find most important nodes in complex network. In this paper, the problem is transformed into traveling salesman problem. An evaluation method for measuring the importance of nodes based on the average network reliability is designed. The improved genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the optimization problem. We establish a mathematical optimization model with the minimization of network connectivity as a target function. We generate the node attack sequence using the improved genetic algorithm. Experiments showed that the new evaluation strategy is more effective than traditional methods.

Index Terms: Importance Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Multimodel Facial Makeup Translation with Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: Automatic apply/remove makeup is a more challenging task than traditional style transfer, there are specific makeup styles in different facial areas, such as eye shadow, lipstick, and foundation. We propose a method of makeup transfer, which can achieve a makeup-oriented synthesis under different faces without pairs of images, and output different styles of makeup automatically. Specifically, owing to makeup transfer is more than a simple global transformation, we will use the separation training method, not only save the identity of the face, but also retain the characteristics of the specific part. Our framework is based on generative adversarial networks, adding face segmentation algorithms and Poisson blending techniques in the synthesis, make it possible to smoothly blend faces from different parts. Then we can complete makeup and makeup removal between different faces.

articleTitle: Data Driven Intersection Signal Control Strategy Considering State Controllability
abstract: According to the intersection signal control problem under the saturated traffic condition, a new method of intersection queue length equalization control based on state controllability is proposed. First, the paper regards the queue length difference equal to 0 as the control objective, to realize vehicle queue equalization control of the intersection and ensure the effective allocation of phase green time. Secondly, for the constraints of intersection controllability, the vehicle queue length of each phase is limited effectively to prevent the occurrence of queue overflow or deadlock. Finally, the method is verified by the simulation of the actual data, and the results show that the method is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Amodal detection of 3D objects with separate network output branches
abstract: Indoor 3D object detection has always been a great challenge in the field of computer vision because of the irregularities of indoor object's shape and posture. In this paper, an improved deep neural network structure with four separate output branches is proposed. The neural network separately regress dimension, coordinate and orientation offsets, which can better predict the 3D-bounding-box's position, size and angle informations. Meanwhile, a new loss function is introduced according to the proposed network structure. The experimental results evaluated on the public NYUV2 dataset demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the state-of-the-art method and has a better generalization ability for different indoor objects.

articleTitle: Weighted Data Fusion Based on Evidence Confidence Distance
abstract: Aimed at the problem that D-S evidence theory cannot deal with high conflict, a new weighted combination algorithm based on confidence distance is proposed in this paper. This algorithm introduces the concept of confidence distance measure, in which the variance factor is computed by two evidential variance determination methods. The data source is processed by confidence distance and transformed into distance matrix. A new set of evidence is obtained by weighting the similarity matrix. Finally, the evidence is fused by D-S evidence theory. An example is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Self-Attention Networks for Text-Independent Speaker Verification
abstract: In this paper, we present a self-attention based model for text-independent speaker verification task and a novel variant of the triplet loss. Conventional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) used in speaker verification tasks need very deep layers to realize considerable performance. In our proposed model, the self-attention mechanism could easily capture long-range dependencies, thus achieves better representational capability with fewer parameters. Based on triplet loss, we propose a novel triplet selection method, which makes the training more efficient and achieves significant performance enhancement. Text-independent speaker verification experiments on AISHELL-2 corpus shows that the proposed model with the improved loss function decreases the verification equal error rate (EER) by 16.81% relatively compared with the state-of-the-art ResNet-like model with common triplet loss, while the proposed model has fewer parameters and requires lower computational cost.

articleTitle: A Learning Control Algorithm for Networked Stochastic Systems Under Fading Channels
abstract: In this paper, iterative learning control(ILC) is used to solve the problem of accurate tracking of random systems with fading channel. In order to achieve the tracking target, we use a two-dimensional Kalman filter method to design a learning gain matrix varying with the time axis and iteration axis. It minimizes the trace of the covariance of the input error, so that the output of the system can accurately keep up with the desired value. Then, we prove by mathematical derivation that when the output side of the system undergoes fading channel, the algorithm can ensure that the tracking error asymptotically converges to zero in the mean square sense. The case of input fading case can be proved by a similar method. Numerical simulation is used to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The Research on the Strategy of Power Grid Fault Treatment with Multi Information Integration via Expand Linear Temporal Logic
abstract: The precision of the analysis and judge for power grid anomaly and fault, as well as the rapidity of the power fault recovery were the two important indexes of the level of automation for power. So far, the level of automation for power could achieve the extent that observed and control the power state. However, it still has its some limitations. For example, the analysis and judging the power grid anomaly and fault mostly depended on manual work, which need power grid dispatching and operation decide and command during the fault treatment process, which canÿt realize intelligent analysis and prognosis. It has also made a telephone call for substation operation where has the anomaly and the fault that need to the scene to examine the equipment and the parameters states. Meanwhile, the failure of power service interruption didn't notify the power client at the first time, which resulted to lots of complaints from the clients because they didn't know what happened to the power grid. In this paper, we focused on this problem and discussed the method of modeling of treatment mechanism for power fault by mean of expand linear temporal logic, and presented on the disposition logic formulas. The new model considered the related professions that related to power fault treatment, involved power grid dispatching and operation, substation operations, power marketing. Applying these to the logic formula, integrating the SCADA system, substation operations mobile message system, as well as the power marketing client. The research in this paper has important significance for engineers and technicians on power grid dispatching and operation, substation operations, power marketing, relay protection and so on.

articleTitle: Kalman Filtering for Sprung Mass Velocity Estimation of Magnetorheological Suspension for All -Terrain Vehicle
abstract: The vibration control efficiency of automobile semi-active suspension system depends on the accuracy of information from sensor installed on the vehicle, including the sprung mass acceleration and deflection of the suspension system. The control algorithm for vibration attenuation of the vehicle body takes into account sprung mass velocity and relative velocity of suspension. In this paper, a new method for estimating sprung mass velocity using Kalman filter is presented. This method is compared with a typical solution in which the sprung mass velocity is calculated by integrating the signals obtained from the accelerometers placed on the vehicle body. Experiments for All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV) confirmed that using Kalman filter for sprung mass velocity estimate can significantly improve ride comfort by better vibration attenuation of the vehicle body, compared with that of using typical integrating method.

articleTitle: Research on Data Synchronization of Cement Intelligent Control Cloud Platform
abstract: Based on the data category of cement intelligent control cloud platform, this paper deeply studies the three types of replication of SQL Server replication technology for the synchronization of data between cement enterprise server and cloud platform data center. After analyzing and comparing the three replication types, a data synchronization solution is proposed. SQL Server transaction replication technology can be used to realize real-time data synchronization, meet the real-time demand of local enterprise and cloud platform data synchronization, and provide necessary real-time data guarantee for the stable operation of cloud platform.

articleTitle: Development of fault diagnosis test bench for doubly-fed wind generator based on stator current analysis method
abstract: In order to realize the fault diagnosis technology of wind turbines in the laboratory environment by using the stator current analysis method, a wind turbine mechanical fault simulation test bench based on general frequency converter is designed. The utility model uses a general-purpose frequency converter to control the asynchronous motor to output different speeds and torques to simulate the action of the wind wheel, and the other frequency converter supplies the one-way frequency excitation power supply of the wound generator rotor which can simply realize the generator off-grid and grid-connected power generation processes. By collecting and analyzing the stator current signal of the generator, it is possible to carry out research on the mechanical failure of the components of the wind turbine drive system such as gears and rolling bearings.

articleTitle: Fractional-Order Memristor response to periodic current functions
abstract: The Memristor is a new passive element representing relationship between electric charge q and flux φ. The concept of memristors in the generalized fractional order domain has gained much relevance due to their unique behavior which cannot be obtained in conventional elements. The generalized state equations of the memristor is discussed in the fractional-order sense and the effects of the added fractional-order parameter on the memristor characteristics and output behavior are studied. Numerical analyses of the model are presented for case 0<;α<;1 with sinusoidal, symmetric sawtooth and square-wave excitation currents. The instantaneous power and area under the v-i curves at values of fractional order is observed and it is found that the shape and the area enclosed by the hysteresis loop depend on the fractional-order and excitation frequency; the area is less dependent on frequency for the square wave current excitation.

articleTitle: Implementing subarray average delay multiply and sum ultrasound beamformer using OpenCL
abstract: The subarray average delay multiply and sum (SADMAS) beamformer, proposed by our group recently, has achieved significant improvement in the resolution and performance of the ultrasound images with lower computational complexity compared to MV or DMAS beamformers. Since SADMAS beamformer is based on matrix processing, it has the advantage to be used in ultrasound system based on FPGA or GPU for real-time imaging. In this paper, we put forward an implementation of the SADMAS beamformer on a high performance graphics processing unit (GPU) by using Open Computing Language (OpenCL). In this implementation, the specific algorithm architecture was designed and implemented by 2 kernel-based parallel beamformer. To evaluate the performance of the algorithm architecture, point phantoms were used to evaluate the performance of the algorithm. The execution time and the frame rates were measured by using this implementation targeted on GPU and CPU, respectively. Experiment results show that, by using different subarray length with M/2 and M/4 (where M is the size of array), the frame rates improve 38.6 and 44.6 times, respectively, compared with the beamformer implemented on CPU. Those results indicate that the implementation of SADMAS beamformer on GPU is feasible for real-time imaging in medical ultrasound system.

Author Keywords: Subarray average Delay Multiply and Sum

articleTitle: Fractal dimension of Katugampola fractional integral of continuous functions with unbounded variation
abstract: The present paper mainly explore fractal dimension of Katugampola fractional integral of continuous functions with unbounded variation. We prove that Box dimension and Hausdorff dimension of Katugampola fractional integral of continuous functions with finite unbounded variation points are 1. Furthermore, we get an important conclusion that Box dimension and Hausdorff dimension of Katugampola fractional integral of continuous functions with infinite and countable unbounded variation points are 1.

articleTitle: Supervisory fault tolerant control for a class of parabolic PDEs system
abstract: In this paper, the supervisory fault tolerant control (FTC) is used to stabilize a class of partial differential equations (PDEs) system in the presence of process and boundary faults ranging over a finite cover, described by parabolic PDEs. The FTC design relies on a supervisory switching among a family of pre-computed candidate controllers without any additional model or filter. The system is ensured to be stable during the switching delay, which ends when the correct stabilizing controller has been selected. Simulation results illustrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A 3D Adaptive Coverage Optimization Algorithm in Wireless Multi-media Sensor Networks
abstract: The coverage optimization issue is one of the key technologies of Wireless Multi-media Sensor Networks (WMSNs). The covering effect has a great influence on the monitoring ability, quality of service, network lifetime of WMSNs. Therefore, a noble centralized adaptive coverage optimization algorithm that is solved by improved Cuckoo Search, is proposed in this paper. The traditional Cuckoo Search can quickly find the optimal solution covering variables. However, it is difficult to find a unique optimal solution for practical optimization problem. So a survival of the fittest mechanism is studied to adjust the iterative process of Cuckoo Search. Furthermore, a scenario of improving rate and an adaptive adjusting search step are also discussed in the evolution, which can stabilize the iteration process by closed-loop control. In order to evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithm that the simulation experiments are designed. The results show the proposed algorithm is better in coverage-enhancing compared with other distributed coverage enhancing algorithms.

articleTitle: Simulation and Test of the Balance Ability for the Elderly Based on Morlet Wavelet Analysis
abstract: Balance ability is a significant function of human body. For the elderly, the evaluation of balance ability is important, therefore, predicting the possibility of fall for the elderly is a momentous topic. This paper aims to evaluate the balance ability for the elderly quantitatively. In this paper, take typical secondary system as a research model, giving Morlet continuous wavelet transform for the center gravity fluctuation data acquired under free walking of the elderly, then calculate the adjust time from falling to resume and regard the result as the assess indicators for evaluating the balance ability. Compared with the Pole Analytic Method, the average absolute error, root mean square error and average absolute error value of Morlet Wavelet Analysis are smaller, which indicates that the wavelet method processes a higher precision and it is more suitable for the study. By analyzing the adjust time for 76 samples and verifying the feasibility of the method, then concluded that the range of adjust time is 5.2952 ~ 59.6272s approximately. In the end, the study gives proposals accordingly, such as help the elderly with exercises properly and create a safety environment for them. The complete suggestions are listed in the paper.

articleTitle: ConfiConv: A Confidence Measure for Disparity Estimation Based on Deep Learning
abstract: In this paper, a confidence measure for disparity estimation is proposed to encode the degree of uncertainty of each point in disparity map. Based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a network is set up which is named as Confidence Convolutional neural network (ConfiConv). Compared with four different Confidence Measures (CMs) in Middlebury 2014 dataset using two stereo vision algorithms, it is shown that the average Area Under Curve (AUC) values of ConfiConv are better than other measures. And ConfiConv is also tested in another dataset which contains multiple movie clips.

articleTitle: T-S Fuzzy Control for Blood Glucose Regulation in Type-1 Diabetes
abstract: This paper is concerned with blood glucose control problem for type-1 diabetes whose nonlinear dynamics are explained in the Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy model. The proposed T-S fuzzy control method is derived based on quadratic Lyapunov function aiming at attenuating the error as small as possiblin in the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance sense. Conditions for the solvability of the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller design given here are written in the form of linear matrix inequalities which are easier to be solved by convex optimization techniques. Simulation example is given to demonstrate the validity and applicability of the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Game Strategy of The Bidding and Playing of Dou Dizhu
abstract: This paper analyzes the basic characteristics of the Dou Dizhu computer game. It divides the call into three basic strategies, and analyzed the winning and losing ratio of each bidding strategy through experiments. It divides playing cards into three common basic strategies, and analyzed the effect of each strategy on the ratio of winning and losing through experiments. These analyses will provide a more detailed reference for the optimal design of the Dou Dizhu computer game competition system.

articleTitle: Design of Data Analysis System for Full Scale Carrier-based Aircraft Drop Test Based On LabVIEW Programming Environment
abstract: Full scale drop test of carrier-based aircraft is a new type of dynamic impact test, which requires higher operation efficiency of analysis system and monitoring function of test data due to multiple channels and high fault rate of sensors in the course of collecting and processing of test data. Aiming at the requirements of carrier-based aircraft drop test, a data analysis system is developed which is applicable to the drop test of carrier-based aircraft based on LabVIEW programming environment. Main functions of the system consist of channel name identification, data display contrast, data consolidation, data monitor and output etc. It is verified via actual application in the test that the system has high level of automation, high efficiency, and good universality, which fulfill the requirements of data analysis and processing of full scale aircraft drop test.

Author Keywords: Full scale drop test of carrier-based aircraft

articleTitle: Study on Maintenance Interval control of Heat Exchanger in Aircraft Systems Based on MSG-3 Philosophy
abstract: This paper proposes a maintenance program improvement method in the aircraft system. Starting from the generation of maintenance program, this paper establishes the optimization process of the system parts of maintenance program, including reliability data collection, data preprocessing, data distribution exploration, data distribution analysis, engineering analysis, engineering conclusion, engineering verification and corrective measures. For data collection, MSG-3 as the first philosophy is followed. JMP software is introducted in reliability data distribution exploration, and data distribution analysis. At the last of the paper, heat exchanger in aircraft air-condition system is taken as an example to verify maintenance optimization process, according to minimum maintenance cost model, the optimal maintenance interval, which meets the system reliability requirement, is obtained and consistent with the judgment of engineering experience.

articleTitle: On-line distribution of coordinated attack targets for multi-anti-ship missiles based on genetic simulated annealing algorithm
abstract: In the case of coordinated combat, Multi-Missiles Cooperative Targets Assignment(MMCTA)of anti-ship missiles attack aircraft carrier fleet, comprehensively consider various factors affecting the operational effectiveness of anti-ship missile, and construct a missile-target distribution optimization model and Combat effectiveness evaluation index calculation model. In addition, the offline-MMCTA can't cope with the dynamic change of the operational environment. Through the instantaneous data interaction capability between missiles, the online-MMCTA is realized. To meet real-time requirements of online distribution, an improved hybrid genetic simulated annealing algorithm(GASA) is proposed. GASA by designing coding methods avoids the problem of multi-missile ballistic crossing and low search efficiency. The simulation results demonstrate that the constructed model and the proposed algorithm can effectively solve the online distribution problem of the multi-anti-ship missile cooperative attack aircraft carrier fleet target.

articleTitle: Alarm system design for hydraulic turbine governing system via generalized delay-timer
abstract: In process plants, alarms are configured to notify operators of any abnormalities or faults. In practice, operators receive far more false and nuisance alarms than valid and useful alarms. In this paper, generalized delay-timer is applied in alarm system design for Hydraulic Turbine Governing System (HTGS). Simulations of diagnosis on gate opening sensor fault and controller fault are made using sample data produced by the nonlinear state equations for HTGS. Results show that the proposed method practically improves the accuracy and rapidity of the alarm system.

articleTitle: Effect of Rotation Rate Change of Rotary MIMU On System Navigation Accuracy
abstract: Inertial navigation relies on the measured angular rate and acceleration, and thus, errors in the inertial sensors can lead to inaccurate results for the navigation solution. The rotary modulation technique (RMT) can suppress the effect of inertial sensor bias, and it has thus been widely studied. Several studies have focused on the application of single-axis reciprocating rotation to micro-electromechanical-system inertial measurement units (MIMU) to improve the accuracy of the MIMU navigation solution. This scheme involves the values of the commutation angular acceleration and the angular rate of rotation, which also affects the effectivity of the RMT. However, only a few studies have carefully analyzed this issue. In this study, the authors theoretically analyze the error characteristics of MIMU reciprocating rotation, as well as the effect of angular rate and commutation angular acceleration on the effectivity of the RMT. The results indicate that the RMT can significantly improve the accuracy of MIMU navigation solution; however, the angular velocity and commutation angular acceleration considerably influence the navigation accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Descriptor of Loop Closure Detection for Visual SLAM Systems
abstract: This paper is concerned of the loop closure detection problem, which is one of the most critical parts for visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems. Most of state-of-the-art methods use hand-crafted features and bag-of-visual-words (BoVW) to tackle this problem, but not all SALM systems require hand-crafted feature. With the improvement of machine learning, Convolution Neural Networks (CNNs) has a significant effect on feature detection. This paper proposes a loop closure detection method without hand-crafted feature. We extract the image features through CNNs, and reduce the dimensions of the feature values with t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (T-SNE). And then we get a dictionary of two-dimensional feature points, which are obtained by T-SNE. Combined with the new similarity judgment method, the BoVW model based on CNNs is constructed. The new method can solve the loop closure detection of SLAM systems without hand-crafted features. Based on the characteristics of CNNs, the performance of scale-invariant feature transform has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: SSM-Based Joint Dictionary Learning for Cross-View Action Recognition
abstract: Human action recognition is a central problem in many visual intelligence applications, such as video surveillance, clinical care and ambient-assisted living. However, the same action is variable under different viewpoints, and the self-similarity matrix (SSM) methods get worse when the viewpoint changes greatly. In this paper, we propose a novel approach, referred as SSM-based joint dictionary learning (SJDL), which can obtain more discriminative features for cross-view action recognition. The approach learns a set of view-specific dictionaries for each view to align the view-specific sparse representations and a common dictionary shared by all views to obtain view-shared sparse representations. Those dictionaries are learned by enforcing sparse representations of different views to have concise and similar patterns. The superior performance of SJDL is demonstrated by experimental results on the IXMAS dataset.

articleTitle: A Data Fusion Method in LPG Monitoring System
abstract: With the more and more extensive use of the Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) in recent years, safety issue resulted from using it becomes increasingly important as well. This essay targets at the feature of the LPG monitoring system, applies mathematic simulation software, verifies feasibility of weighted average data fusion algorithm, and comes to a real time sensor variation calculation method. Via application of the environmental data provided by multi-sensor at targeted experiment sites based on weighted average data fusion, data collected from the same type of sensor in the monitored area are fused and are shown on mobile terminal users on a real time basis, allowing a real time alarm pushing of a certain datum in the environment.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Dual-mode Control of Maximum Power Point Tracking for Photovoltaic Arrays
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation systems will switch between two situations: uniform illumination and local shadow. For maximum power point tracking (MPPT), the conventional strategy is often efficient in only one situation. But for both situations with switching, there face problems such that the tracking time may be too long or it may fall into the local maximum power point (LMPP). Aiming at these problems, in this paper, an event-triggered dual-mode control technology is proposed, which enables the system to work with high efficiency and high precision under both uniform illumination and local shadow. Under the uniform illumination, the maximum power point is tracked by the perturbation method (P&O), while in a local shaded environment, the current flowing through the bypass diode acts as a trigger signal which enables Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to track the Global Maximum Power Point (GMPP). The simulation experiment by Matlab shows that in both the uniform illumination and local shadow, the algorithm of event-triggered dual-mode control is efficient in MPPT and has a fast and smooth transition between P&O and PSO, overcoming the problems of conventional strategy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Multiple-model Fault-tolerant Control based on a Pre-compensator Method
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive multiple-model fault tolerant control problem is investigated based on a pre-compensator method. Firstly, the faulty system model is established using multiple models. To overcome the difficulty introduced by the coupling of unknown parameters in the control matrix and adaptive parameters, the pre-compensator method is introduced to design the adaptive controller. The principal contributions of the paper is that the proposed method can reduce the design complexity of existing methods. Moreover, the proposed method is extended to the design of output feedback controllers. The effectiveness of the proposed method is illustrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Improving ADNet for Robust Tracking
abstract: By taking advantages of the multi-domain structure and efficient searching strategy, ADNet (Action Decision Network) outperforms other approaches. However, its precision is limited due to the lack of detail feature caused by the improper network structure and other issues. Through our improvements, the proposed approach is more accurate than ADNet. Experiments demonstrate the advantages of our method.

articleTitle: Research on Living Face Detection Based on Dual Camera Contour Matching
abstract: Combining the advantages of visible-light camera and thermal-imaging camera, a research method of living face detection based on contour feature matching is proposed. In view of the different focal lengths of the two cameras, firstly, this paper establishes a camera positioning model to make the thermal-imaging image and the visible-light image spatial display range consistent; Secondly, the thermal-imaging image is preprocessed and the face contour is extracted by the improved multi-line convex hull detection algorithm; Thirdly, based on the YCbCr ellipse clustering model, the CbCr space of the visible-light skin color range is segmented, then the multi-motion convex hull detection is used to extract the visible-light image face contour; Finally, the contour matching algorithm is used to match the contours of the face extracted by the thermographic image and the visible-light image to determine whether it is a living face. The test results show that the method of this paper solves the application requirements of the national security department such as airports for living face identification.

articleTitle: Adaptive Congestion Control for Uncertain Networks with Unmatched Nonlinearities
abstract: This paper focuses on dealing with the nonlinearities in network congestion control. The nonlinearities are reflected in time-varying perturbations in the state and delayed state with unknown bounding coefficients, which have not been considered in the existing congestion control methods. A new system model is established for networks with unmatched nonlinearities, uncertainties and time-varying delays, and a new state feedback congestion controller is designed based on adaptive control. Finally, the stability and the performance of the closed-loop system are validated via a new Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and linear matrix inequality. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed congestion controller are verified through simulations.

articleTitle: One-to-One Logistics-Client Stable Matching
abstract: Facing the circumstance of high ELDR (empty loaded driving ratio) on logistics, a stable matching method is applied in the logistics selection optimizing problem. Firstly, the preferences of logistics providers and clients are analyzed respectively. Then, according to the preferences, the satisfaction matrixes of "logistics providers to clients" and "clients to logistics providers" are calculated based on the TOPSIS method. Next, the corresponding mathematical model is constructed, where the stable matching condition is embedded as a constraint into the optimization model, which aims to maximize the whole satisfaction of both sides. Finally, by studying case, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed approach are verified as the average ELDR on logistics is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Application of a full-dimensional observable smoothing algorithm in SINS
abstract: The traditional zero-velocity correction algorithm (ZUPT) can theoretically suppress the accumulation of navigation errors, but it can only correct the state errors of the zero-velocity interval and the observations are less. The state information of the model solution based on the SINS algorithm and the navigation error equation in the non-zero-velocity interval causes a sudden change in the entire pedestrian trajectory process, that is, the stability is poor and the accuracy is not high. This paper proposed a algorithm, which 3D errors of attitude and position are added as observations to achieve full-dimensional observability based on the traditional zero-velocity correction, then all state errors are obtained by EKF estimation, and a post-processing smoothing algorithm is introduced to make full use of the measurement information over the entire time period to correct the navigation errors of the non-zero-velocity interval. In order to verify the accuracy and stability of the algorithm, experiments were carried out by using the self-developed IMU. The results show that the proposed algorithm has better stability than the traditional ZUPT, improves the smoothness of the trajectory, and the navigation accuracy is improved by 1.7%.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Based on the Improved Sparse Representation
abstract: In recent years, face recognition is a hot research topic in the field of biometrics, and sparse representation is a hot topic in this field. In order to solve the problem that the sparse representation algorithm does not have good recognition effect in the face image training samples and test samples including both expression changes and illumination condition changes, a face recognition algorithm based on sparse coefficient and residual fusion is proposed.. The algorithm combines the sparse coefficient into the residual classification decision, considering that the sparse coefficient is the fidelity condition that discriminates the correlation between the feature correlation and the class in the training sample class, and the feature correlation between the training sample and the test sample class. The new residual is defined as the classification standard, and the improved residual fully exploits the correlation information of the sparse coefficient. At the same time, the algorithm in this article is combined with the PCA feature extraction method to effectively reduce the data dimension while ensuring the recognition rate of face images. Several experiments were carried out in the standard face database to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, and it is proved that the algorithm is robust.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Escort Robot Based on Improved Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization
abstract: The path planning working space of resident community for escort robot is a complicated NP-Hard problem in the optimization research. The novel escort robot path planning model in resident community is presented, path describing as a grid graph of mathematical model. The Improved Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm is proposed for solving path planning model. The escort robot prototype is developed for the elderly assist in the community, which is also designed to walk with global path indoor and outdoor. The experiment platform is built on the developed escort robot and test environment. And then the experiment results are implemented for verifying effective and robust Improved Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm, as well as the algorithm can solve the real optimal escort robot path.

articleTitle: Improved exponential stability of time-delay systems
abstract: In this paper, a new inner product space is defined, which has a standard orthogonal basis. Based on this basis, an improved integral inequality is established, which is used to construct a new Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals (LKFs). Thus, a less conservative exponential stability criterion of time-delay systems is obtained, which is in form of linear matrix inequalities(LMIs). Finally, non-conservatism of this exponential stability criterion can be not only numerically illustrated by an example, but also rigorously proved in theory.

articleTitle: Effect of compressive measurement in spatial domain on attitude determination
abstract: Compressive sensing (CS) theory is an emerging field that can sense sparse signals at a sub-Nyquist sampling rate. The star tracker is currently the most accurate onboard sensor that determines the attitude of a spacecraft by star observation. CS theory provides a compressive measurement method for star tracker that performs attitude determination in a low data rate. This novel application based on the spatial sparsity of star image can be implemented in an optical superposition way that conducts compressive measurement and reconstruction in spatial domain. A series of statistical simulations are designed to quantitatively investigate the effect of spatial CS on attitude angles regarding different noise levels and compression ratios. The numerical simulation shows that the spatial compressive measurement for star tracker can keep the attitude accuracy in noise cases and reduce the data rate to a large extent. The results prove that the spatially reconstructed star feature can be used for star identification and attitude determination, which verifies the feasibility of CS spatial application in star tracker.

articleTitle: A Kind of Digital Controlled Electro-Optical Switch Power Source with Variable Voltage and Variable Frequency
abstract: This paper proposes a pulse voltage source based on MOSFET for the electro-optical switch. The voltage regulation stage is composed of two-stage dc/dc converter, including a buck and a voltage multiplier. The pulse voltage generator is based on the series-connected MOSFETs. The principle of the electro-optical switch drive is analyzed and the parameters design method is also presented. An experimental prototype was built to verify the effectiveness of the proposed design method.

articleTitle: Guaranteed Cost Robust Kalman Estimators for Systems with Uncertain-Variance Multiplicative and Colored Measurements Noises
abstract: The guaranteed cost (GC) robust estimation problem for discrete-time systems with uncertain-variance multiplicative and colored measurements noises is considered. By applying the augmented state approach and fictitious measurement noise technology, the system under considered is converted into one only with uncertain noise variances. By parameterizing the perturbations of uncertain noise variances, two classes of GC robust Kalman estimators are presented based on the minimax robust estimation principle. The proposed GC robust estimators can concurrently give the minimal upper bound and maximal lower bound of accuracy deviations. A unified approach of designing the robust Kalman estimators is addressed based on the robust Kalman predictor. The GC robustness is proved by the Lyapunov equation method. A example applied to uninterruptible power system verifies the robustness of the proposed estimators.

articleTitle: Research on Condition-based Maintenance Technology for Power Transformer
abstract: In the basis of analyzing the importance of power transformer in substation and power system, the development process of operation and maintenance technology for power transformer are introduced in detail. And the meaning of condition parameters used for characterizing the state of power transformer were illustrated, for example, the temperature of winding hot spot, casing insulation, the micro water and gas content in oil and the vibration. Taking ATmegal 16L microcontroller as the core, the whole structure of condition monitoring system, the power supply unit and signal processing unit were detailed designed.

articleTitle: Robust Stabilization Control for a Class of Non-Triangular High-Order Time-Delay Systems
abstract: In this paper, we consider the robust stabilization control for a class of high-order nonlinear systems. Different from the existing work, the studied systems contain time-delay, input dead-zone and zero dynamics. By employing the modified homogeneous domination method, a delay-independent controller is presented such that all signals in the closed-loop system are bounded. A simulation example is studied to show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Multi-population Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm for Multi-objective Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel artificial bee colony algorithm for solving the multi-objective flexible job shop scheduling problem. In this algorithm, the whole population is divided into multiple subpopulations at each generation, and the size of each subpopulation is adaptively adjusted based on the information derived from its search results. Furthermore, the two mutation strategies implemented in the differential evolution algorithm are embedded in the proposed algorithm to facilitate the exchange of information in each subpopulation and between different subpopulations, respectively. Experimental results on the well-known benchmark multi-objective problems show that the improvements of the strategies are positive and that the proposed algorithm is better than or at least competitive to some previous multi-objective evolutionary algorithms.

Author Keywords: multi-objective flexible job shop scheduling problem

articleTitle: Research on Market Entry Order and Product Development Strategy of Aerospace Components Based on Game Analysis
abstract: Focusing on the decision-making confusion of aerospace components manufacturers in market entry order and product development strategy, a market entry game theory model based on the conversion cost and learning curve effects, as well as a product differentiation with downward compatibility game theory model is established. Game analysis shows there is a significant first-mover advantage in the aerospace components market, while adopting a downward compatible strategy may provide a second-mover advantage. The study has two implications. First, companies must strive to be the first mover into the market; second, the incomers should adopt a downward compatible product differentiation strategy.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control for Satellite Formation Keeping Based on Genetic Algorithm
abstract: This paper presents a genetic-algorithm-based predictive control strategy to solve the control problem of satellite formation keeping. First, the relative dynamic model of satellites considering J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> perturbation in elliptic reference orbit is introduced. Then, a predictive controller is proposed to realize the control of the satellite formation. Moreover, in order to improve the control performance, the predictive control parameters P, M, q and r are optimized by genetic algorithm online. Simulation results show that the performance of predictive controller based on genetic algorithm is better than that of the traditional predictive controller.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Heat Transfer Performance Of Thermal Suit Based On Fourier Law
abstract: In this paper, we use the Fourier law of heat conduction, combined with the convection theory and the heat radiation theory, to establish a three-dimensional temperature field model, and analyze the influence of the temperature of each layer of the thermal protective clothing with the change of time and space position under the unsteady condition. After the derivation of the Fourier heat transfer formula, we compare the temperature field to the electric field and derive the unified formula of the temperature field. In addition, we optimize the thickness of each layer according to the actual situation.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Localization Algorithm Based on Occlusion Judgment
abstract: With the development of Device-free localization technology, indoor fingerprint localization has attracted more and more attention. However, in indoor environment, the degree of occlusion at different locations is obviously different, the positioning accuracy based on Channel State Information (CSI) system decreases. In this paper, we propose a fingerprint localization algorithm based on occlusion judgment (FLOJ algorithm). In the fingerprint processing phase, we use principal components analysis (PCA) to reduce the dimension of fingerprint database to remove redundant data. And k-nearest neighbor (KNN) position estimation algorithm is used to get the matching results. In the phase of multi-position fusion, we use the algorithm based on CSI propagation model as the criterion to measure the occlusion degree of indoor environment. And we fuse the matching positions obtained by multi-receivers at the same time. Experiment results show that compared to KNN localization methods, our proposed algorithm can effectively reduce positioning error.

articleTitle: The Pricing Mechanism and Decision-making of Core Components Based on the Game Model under the Implicit Condition of Localization Substitution
abstract: Pricing is important when considering the difficulty of localizing core components. Localization encompasses three essential implicit conditions, under which a two-stage alternative game model reveals the formation of prices of domestic core components: the contraction in price at the beginning of localization is negatively correlated to the cost of domestic core components. Further analysis shows that sellers of domestic core components may use the strategy of second-degree price discrimination to alleviate the contradiction between cost and price reduction. It is also possible to adopt the price skimming method or the experience pricing method based on the order of entering the market.

articleTitle: Phased Algorithm Strategy Analysis of WTN-EinStein würfelt nicht!
abstract: EinStein würfelt nicht! is a game model which both sides participate in and play alternately. Each moving cube is determined by the dice number, that increases the difficulty of designing the game strategy. Through a large number of game records analysis, we find that the whole game can be divided into three stages; the situation and environmental noise faced by each stage are very different, and the corresponding game goals should be different. Targeted division of the game process and phased goal setting can greatly improve the robustness and winning rate of the game strategy. Based on the above analysis, we design a phased game goal as well as a feasible strategy for the combination of stage division criteria and multiple game algorithms. It is shown that the obtained game strategy not only can better guarantee the winning rate, but also greatly improve the efficiency and resource utilization according to a lot of experiments. The obtained results are useful explorations for robust game strategy design with random interference and can be applied to a variety of robust control scenarios.

articleTitle: Study on Port Efficiency in Different Storage Strategies of Container Yard
abstract: Different storage strategies of container yard have different advantages. To know the efficiency and advantage, the transverse and lateral mixed strategies are comparative analysis. The distance and time are the comparative point. Firstly, the characteristics of different storage strategies were introduced. Secondly, we got the truck distance in two strategies through calculating expected distance and corresponding probability all kinds of combination. Then, we calculated the time using in different storage strategies. Finally, Case showed that when the objective is to improve the operation efficiency, lateral mixing distribution is a good choice. While the objective is to control cost, good plan is transverse mixing distribution.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive sliding mode control for delayed singular systems with randomly occurring uncertainty: the uncertain probability case
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive sliding mode control (SMC) problem is discussed for a class of discrete singular systems subject to time-varying delays and randomly occurring uncertainty, where the uncertain occurrence probability case and the nonlinear disturbance are addressed. A proper discrete switching function is firstly designed and the corresponding sliding mode dynamics is obtained. The aim of the addressed problem is to design an adaptive controller such that, for all randomly occurring parameter uncertainty, nonlinear disturbances and time-varying delays, the closed-loop system is guaranteed to be regular, causal and stable under uncertain occurrence probability case. In particular, a robust adaptive sliding mode control (RASMC) law is constructed which is capable of ensuring the reachability of the pre-specified sliding surface. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed RASMC approach is illustrated by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A Cloud Platform Tracking System Based on Image Recognition
abstract: Most of the existing mobile platform target tracking systems have the defects of high cost, large volume and low degree of visualization. A tracking system based on image recognition for the mobile platform is designed, which consist of power module, camera module, human-computer interaction module, steering machine cradle module and Cortex-M3 based control module. On the one hand, the system has strong stability. Through PID control algorithm, it can quickly and accurately identify objects of different colors and realize dynamic tracking, meeting the requirements of identifying objects of different colors. On the other hand, the system has a high degree of visualization, and the tracking laser display mode and LCD display coordinate function can directly observe the tracking of the system.

articleTitle: Regulation control for a class of stochastic nonlinear cascaded systems
abstract: This paper studies the regulation control problem for a class of stochastic nonlinear cascaded systems. A new exponentially practical stability criterion in the moment sense is firstly proposed for stochastic nonlinear systems. Based on the given stability criterion, a regulation controller is constructed to regulate the system output to an arbitrarily small neighborhood of the origin and the closed-loop system is exponentially practically stable in fourth moment sense. A simulation example verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed controller design scheme.

articleTitle: A Pre-calibration Method for Concrete Distributor
abstract: In the production process of precast concrete components, to solve the problem that concrete distributor cannot automatically determine the pre-calibration point, the automatic pre-calibration method for concrete distributor is proposed based on the marking of bottom-mold-tray and the proximity switch in this paper. The above method is achieved through marking the placement position of the magnetic-side-molds at the comer on the bottom-mold-tray and using the positioning equipment of the bottom-mold-tray. Then, the pre-calibration point of the concrete distributor is indirectly determined with relevant position information. The designed automatic pre-calibration method not only reduces the pre-calibration time, improves the accuracy and efficiency of the pre-calibration point of the concrete distributor, but also has the advantages of good compatibility with the original control system of the concrete distributor, easy development and low transformation cost.

articleTitle: Wind Estimation with UAVs Using Improved Adaptive Kalman Filter
abstract: This paper presents an improved adaptive Kalman filter algorithm for wind estimation with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The wind measurement values with UAVs always include large continuous outlier. At the same time, the noise statistical prior knowledge for wind is insufficient. Firstly, the wind state equation including mean wind and turbulence is established by accurate wind model. Then the three-dimensional measurement equation of wind is established based on the principle of the wind measurement by UAVs. Finally, the wind data measured by the UAVs is processed using improved adaptive Kalman filter. Simulation results demonstrate the feasibility of the approach. And compared with the traditional Kalman filter and the adaptive Kalman filter, the proposed algorithm can reduce the influence of large continuous outliers and ensure the accuracy of wind field estimation.

articleTitle: Covariance Matrix adaptation based on Opposition learning for multimodal optimization
abstract: Although CMA-ES is effective in locating a single global optimum, it cannot perform well on multi-optima problems. In order to improve the performance of CMA-ES, this paper proposed Covariance Matrix adaptation based on Opposition learning (CMA-OL). In CMA-OL, an improved dynamic peak identification method is introduced in CMA-OL to identify the various peaks dynamically. Opposition learning method is employed in CMA-OL to improve the probability of visiting unproductive regions of the search space. To verify the effectiveness of CMA-OL, numerical experiments are carried on six benchmark problems from CEC2013. The experimental results show that CMA-OL is competitive with respect to other compared algorithms for solving multi-optima problems.

articleTitle: Connotation Analysis and Simulation Research of PQ Decomposition Method
abstract: The PQ decomposition method is a classical method for solving the power flow equation. It is widely used in online calculation of power systems because of its simple program, memory saving and fast calculation. The PQ decomposition method (sometimes referred to as the fast decoupling method[1]) is an important calculation method that became widely known as it was introduced in the 1970s, Because it was derived from the Newton-Raphson method and made a series of reasonable simplifications based on the Newton-Raphson method[2]. Therefore, it has a huge advantage in convergence speed and memory usage. Based on the relevant content of Newton's Lawson method, this paper simplifies and corrects it based on it, and finally obtains a simple PQ decomposition method to modify the equation, and conducts analysis and simulation research[3].

articleTitle: An adaptive Compensation Circuitry Design for a Class of Disturbed Systems
abstract: This paper presents a compensation circuitry design method for a class of linear time-invariant systems with bounded time-varying disturbances. An adaptive compensation control strategy is constructed to eliminate the effects of disturbances based on signals from an adaption mechanism. Through Lyapunov stability theory, asymptotic/exponential stability results are obtained for the closed-loop systems under the influence of time-varying disturbances. Furthermore, the proposed adaptive control strategy is physically implemented by circuits based on circuit theory. A numerical example and its Multisim simulation results are given to support the theoretical findings.

articleTitle: An improved image fusion approach via wavelet and whale optimization algorithm
abstract: Image fusion technology can effectively improve the utilization ratio of image information, the accuracy of target recognition and the ability of image interpretation. In this paper, Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) based on the fusion techniques with multiscale geometric analysis is applied into image fusion. We use wavelet decomposition for image preprocessing, and then present an approach of image fusion based on wavelet with WOA. Experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method has advantages in subjectively qualitative analysis and objectively quantitative evaluation compared with the other state of the art methods.

articleTitle: High-precision Planar Positioning System Test Platform
