abstract: Various types of errors in the inertial navigation measurement module are ubiquitous. Based on the development of the new inertial navigation positioning module, this paper conducts an overall research on the positioning sensor that detects the attitude of the omnidirectional plane motion mechanism and analyzes the error of the gyroscope in the IMU and the mechanical structure error of the positioning system. At the same time, the temperature drift, constant error of the gyroscope, the scale factor characteristics of the gyroscope, the wheel diameter error of the driven wheel in the mechanical structure, the non-orthogonal error of the orthogonal encoder wheel are studied, and the error compensation model is established. The above errors are fully measured and compensated.

articleTitle: A Multilateral Fair Negotiation Embedded Matching Method under the Fourth Party Logistics
abstract: The research on the fourth party logistics is more and more popular. Under the fourth party logistics platform, there exists the matching problem between logistics providers and customers which is a key problem. In this paper, a multilateral fair negotiation embedded matching model is constructed to find maximum profit. The Hungarian algorithm is applied to solve the proposed model. Through numerical experiments and comparison with sorting method, it indicates that our result can obtain higher profit and matching number as many as possible, which has more significance in practical application.

articleTitle: Fast Convergent Lyapunov Vector Field Guidance for Standoff Target Tracking
abstract: To address the problem of long convergence time of the conventional Lyapunov vector field guidance (LVFG), a fast convergent LVFG using guidance function is proposed. The necessary properties of fast convergent vector field is illustrated based on analysis of curvature. Then, two guidance functions about distance between UAV and target are constructed to replace guidance parameter. Simulation results indicate the proposed vector field guidance converges faster to the standoff circle no matter UAV initial position is inside or outside the circular orbit. In addition, selection of parameter in the guidance function is discussed to guide design of vector field.

articleTitle: Data Mining and Forecast Analysis of Business Entrepreneurial Behavior in College Students' WeChat Friend Circle
abstract: Data mining refers to the process of searching hidden information from large amounts of data through algorithms. Business entrepreneurship in WeChat Friends Circle has gained more and more popularity among college students because of its advantages of less investment capital, rapid and wide information dissemination, low risk, stable customer base and good marketing channels. This paper constructed the data mining and evaluation index system of Wechat business entrepreneurship behavior on an account of WeChat friend circle and determined the index weight by hap. Taking shenyang city of Liaoning province of China as an example, this paper uses data mining and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to carry out case study, and puts forward countermeasures and Suggestions according to the evaluation results.

articleTitle: The stability of fractional singular systems with time delay under state feedback
abstract: We discuss the stability of fractional singular systems with time delay under the state feedback. Considering the singularity of the system, we decomposed the system into two subsystems. Through fractional Laplacian transformation and inverse Laplacian transformation on the subsystems, the expression of the state variables in time domain is obtained. According to the characteristics of Mittag-Leffler function, some inequalities that have important influence on stability are derived. Finally, we find a new sufficient condition to make the fractional singular systems with time delay stable when the fractional order belongs to 1 <; α <; 2. Correspondingly, we can also select the appropriate state feedback matrix under the condition that make system stable. All processes are proved and numerical examples are provided to show the validity and feasibility of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Fractional Laplacian transform Fractional Laplacian inverse transform.

articleTitle: Gas Pressure Regulator Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Support Vector Machine
abstract: The fault diagnosis of gas regulator is very important to the safe operation of urban gas pipeline network. It is very necessary to provide reliable basis for its normal operation through fault diagnosis of gas regulator. In view of this, the application of support vector machine (SVM) based fault diagnosis model in gas regulator fault diagnosis is introduced. The SVM is used to diagnose four different states include high shut off pressure, low peak pressure, surge fault and normal state of the same gas regulator. The simulation results show that compared with the existing gas regulator fault diagnosis algorithms such as the Radial basis function (RBF), the SVM has obvious advantages in the fault diagnosis rate and the time required for fault diagnosis. It is effective and practical to be applied to practical engineering problems.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimization with Multiple Linear Equality Constraints and Convex Inequality Constraints
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed discrete-time algorithm for optimization problem with global multiple constraints. Based on the projected primal-dual method, a fully distributed algorithm is proposed, and is proved to converge to the optimal solution of the optimization problem under certain sufficient condition with respect to the step-size. Numerical example is given to verify the efficacy of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: New Iterative Guidance for Launch Vehicle with Quadratic Optimization
abstract: This paper investigates the iterative guidance mode for launch vehicle. In order to improve the precision of the guidance system and minimize the flight time, the iterative guidance mode derived from quadratic optimization method, to obtain minimal energy control for launch vehicle. At the same time, the optimal control vector of the guidance command is obtained based on the Hamiltonian equation, and the analytical solutions and the initial value of the adjoint variables are obtained by double integration. Finally, numerical simulation is demonstrated that the performance of the new iterative guidance mode for launch vehicle can achieve the desired performance. In addition, 500 times Monte-Carlo simulation results show the performance of the iterative guidance mode is better than the traditional iterative guidance.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm of the Supplier Determination Problem in E-Business Open Tendering Based on Rules of Supplier Quota Restraint
abstract: A common model is formulated for solving the winner determination problem of reverse combinatorial auction in open tendering. A rule of supplier quota restraint is designed, the impact of which on the number of feasible solutions is analyzed. A PRIM (Preprocessing Rules-Based Improved MMAS) algorithm is adopted for solving the winner determination problem of reverse combinatorial auction in open tendering based on rules of supplier quota restraint. It is shown in the simulation results that a reasonable rule of supplier quota restraint can effectively ensure the number of feasible solutions, reduce the risks of pricing control or a monopoly forming, and improve efficiency of tendering.

articleTitle: Research on Extraction Method of Time-Frequency Feature of Human Motion
abstract: For the problem of motion feature extraction, a method of time-frequency analysis and eigenvalue extraction by fractional Fourier transform is proposed. Collect inertial data in the process of motion by wearing 15 IMU. Analyze and compare its characteristics after the multiorder fractional Fourier transform. The results of the same motion with same order and the different motion with same order and the single motion with different order are compared. Mean value, quartile difference and extreme value difference were extracted after the multiorder fractional Fourier transform to identify and classify the motion.

articleTitle: The Study of Modified ADRC Algorithm for Six Degrees of Freedom Shipboard Stabilized Platform
abstract: The shipboard stabilized system is subject to the large angular disturbance due to the disturbance of the wave. Therefore, it is necessary to study its compensation control method. In this article, the control strategy based on fuzzy active disturbance rejection controller (fuzzy ADRC) is proposed to optimize the control effect of this platform. The rules of fuzzy control are used to automatically adjust some parameters of ADRC. Besides, in order to adjust the parameters within a reasonable range, an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is designed, which introduces the probability of mutation to jump out of local optimum. Finally, the results of simulation show that the control strategy for the platform has good performance and strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Recognition and Rapid Ranging Method of Night Based on Monocular Vision
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional pedestrian recognition and ranging are not satisfactory, a monocular visual nighttime pedestrian recognition and fast ranging method suitable for vehicle infrared night vision images is proposed. Based on the non-contact thermal imaging principle of far-infrared night vision goggles and mathematical morphology method, an improved pedestrian detection and recognition method for three-frame differential monocular vision and geometric motion rate is established. On the basis of pedestrian recognition, monocular camera fast ranging algorithm is used for fast ranging pedestrians. The experimental results show that this method has the characteristics of high pedestrian recognition accuracy and high real-time ranging accuracy.

articleTitle: Internal traffic congestion: A new application of Kruskal’s Theorem
abstract: New technologies offer new possibilities to fight against internal traffic congestion in seaports. Only few researches have exploited this subject so far. Our study focuses on the internal traffic of vehicles. Indeed, congestion results in many little actions which lead to bigger consequences. In order to optimize the internal network, a reflexion on traffic in the stock zone will be done under schemes of Kruskal's Theorem, which will provide us the information needed about the potential effect of autonomous vehicles on the traffic as well as their potential power in reducing the risk of congestion. With this theorem, it is essential to consider a good ponderation of unexpected events that might be encountered on roads. Moreover, a new theory of management helping to limit congestions from social problems will be highlighted.

articleTitle: Study on Ship Dynamic Positioning with Stochastic Backstepping Nonlinear Controller
abstract: Stochastic stability algorithm is designed using Backstepping method on dynamic positioning system model. The dynamic positioning system is modeled as a stochastic differential equation. The design process and numerical solution are given. Simulation shows that the method is effective.

articleTitle: An Improved Traffic Flow Prediction Algorithm Based on TLBO and BP
abstract: BP has been shown to be effective in predicting traffic flow. However, BP neural net may reach the uncertainty of global minimum point. In this paper, an improved optimization algorithm is proposed to predict traffic flow, which is based on teaching-learning-based optimization and BP. The topological structure of BP is optimized by TLBO to search the minimum value of the objective function. In addition, a novel feedback phrase is proposed for convergence and accuracy. The simulation results show that the presented algorithm has a better predictive ability for traffic flow compared with some state-of-the-art approaches, and it has strong robustness and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Performance Trend Prediction Analysis of Key Component of Aircraft Hydraulic System
abstract: As one of the key components of the aircraft hydraulic system, the aircraft hydraulic pump plays an important role in providing mechanical power to the aircraft hydraulic system and even the entire aircraft. Aiming at the problem that the complex structure and harsh working environment make it difficult to accurately analyze its performance trend, a performance trend prediction analysis method based on particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed to analysis of the trend of aircraft hydraulic pump performance changes Firstly, the performance characterization parameter of a certain type of aircraft hydraulic pump(the raw data of oil return flow)is analyzed and the ELM trend prediction model of aircraft hydraulic pump oil return flow is designed. In order to further improve the ELM trend prediction accuracy of hydraulic pump oil return flow, particle swarm is adopted. The Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize the ELM trend prediction model of oil return flow of the aircraft hydraulic pump, and the PSO-ELM prediction model of the aircraft hydraulic pump performance trend is obtained. The PSO-ELM prediction model is used to predict the oil return flow value of aircraft hydraulic pump. The results show that the prediction accuracy of PSO-ELM prediction model of aircraft hydraulic pump performance is better than that of ELM prediction model, which verifies the effectiveness of particle swarm optimization algorithm and provides theoretical guidance for predicting and analyzing the performance trend of key components of aircraft hydraulic system.

articleTitle: Weighted Group Consensus Analysis of Multi-agent Networks with Different Time Delays
abstract: For first-order multi-agent systems with connected bipartite topology, this paper investigates the weighted group consensus problem of the systems with different time delays. By applying the frequency domain control theory, we analyze and obtain the sufficient condition such that the systems can reach weighted group consensus. The obtained conclusions show that the achievement of the systems' group consensus relates to the weights between the agents and the input time delays of the agents, while communication time delays between the agents are irrelevant to it. However, communication time delays will affect the dynamic performance of the systems. When the communication time delays of the systems satisfy the assumption proposed in this paper, the weighted group consensus of the system can be reached. Finally, several simulations show the correctness of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Correlations between generation output of two different photovoltaic power stations——based on the field data of Xinjiang
abstract: Correlations in the power generation of photovoltaic (PV) power stations could help the electric power system operator to understand the character of PV power and avoid curtail in PV power generation. In this study, the correlations of the generation output of two different PV power stations, i.e., the HanergyXinhe and the Schumann PV power station located in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, is investigated, with the viewpoint of geographical location. First, the basic description of correlation with time delay is introduced, and then, the impact of the factors to the correlations between generation output of PV power station is analysed. Furthermore, the PV output curves of the power station in typical weather conditions, i.e., the sunny and non-sunny day, are analysed. Moreover, the correlation between the generation output of two different PV power stations with different weather is investigate. The conclusion that "the locations of the two PV stations are strongly related to the time delay associated with the correction in the sunny day" is verified with the field data results.

articleTitle: Saturated delayed stabilization design: assigning the controllers that include multiplicative coefficients
abstract: This paper presents saturated stabilization design for the chain of integrators that is subject to input delay. The controller includes multiplicative coefficients that appear before saturation functions. In the stage of saturation reduction analysis, the coordinate change is not needed, and the parameter condition for guaranteeing the reduction of saturated terms is not correlated to delay. In the stage of asymptotic stability analysis of the reduced system, we make the suitable coordinate change and use the M-matrix based comparison principle. As a result, we can easily obtain a concise parameter condition in which the allowed delay value is expressed by multiplicative coefficients.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Control in Raw Meal Quality Control
abstract: The raw meal quality control of cement is an important link in cement production. The pass rate of raw meal quality control has a crucial impact on clinker calcination. Cement production is a complex large-scale system control process, the production process has randomness, hysteresis and uncertainty., the quality control of raw meal has a certain degree of control difficulties. Most cement production enterprises adopt manual control to control. Intelligent control can make up for the defects caused by manual control, and the intelligent control system can take effective detection means and control methods according to the situation in the field. This paper will elaborate on the process and control difficulties of raw meal production from the perspective of intelligent control. First, classify intelligent devices that detect raw meal. Then, fuzzy identification of work condition. Third, control by trend control and deviation control. Finally, the intelligent control results are analyzed and verified.

articleTitle: Global existence and blow-up solutions for a class of nonlinear reaction diffusion equations under nonlinear boundary flux
abstract: The positive classical solutions of nonlinear reaction diffusion equations is given under nonlinear boundary flux in bounded domain. By constructing auxiliary functions and applying the maximum principle, the sufficient conditions for the existence of global and blow-up solutions are guaranteed. Meanwhile, the estimate of the global solution, the upper bound for "blow-up time", and the upper estimate of "blow-up rate" are specified.

articleTitle: An Improved Model for Image Selective Segmentation Based on Local and Global Statistics
abstract: In this paper, an improved selective model is proposed for image segmentation, which is built based on local and global statistics of the image. Firstly, by utilizing the advantage of CV model which is less sensitive to original location of initial contour and can segment noisy images, and taking advantage of LCV which can efficiently solve intensity inhomogeneity, the new model integrate the local image information from local Chan-Vese (LCV) model and global statistics from CV model into selective segmentation. In addition, a weight coefficient is added to balance the relationship between global energy and local energy. Then extending the improved model to the color images. Finally, simulation experiment results show that our model can efficiently segment noisy and intensity inhomogeneity images, and is less sensitive to the initialization. New model has stronger robustness and is more efficient.

articleTitle: The Gröbner Bases Algorithm and its Application in Polynomial Ideal Theory
abstract: Due to the huge computations in the mathematics and engineering, it is necessary to reduce the computational complexity in advance. A Gröbner bases is a set of multivariate nonlinear polynomials, which can treat a unit of many problems as a basis, and then take advantage of these bases to simplify the objective polynomial such that a simple multivariate polynomial system can be obtained. This paper first reviews the original algorithm of Gröbner bases and the improvement of the original algorithm by N. K. Bose, then gives two applications of Gröbner bases algorithm to the practical problems. The results show that Gröbner bases algorithm can greatly reduce the computation complexity and improve the execution efficiency to some extent.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Cement Clinker Composition Change Based on Locality Preserving Projections and K-medoids
abstract: The accurate identification of the change of cement clinker composition has great significance for improving the quality of cement clinker. In this paper, a method for identifying changes in cement clinker composition based on locality preserving projections and K-medoids algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the main features used to identify changes in the composition of cement clinker were determined according to the cement process. Then, the locality preserving projections algorithm was used to reduce high-dimensional features to low-dimensional ones. The K-medoids algorithm was used to cluster low-dimensional features to achieve the identification of changes in cement clinker composition. Finally, taking a cement company as an example, the method proposed in this paper has been verified. The verified results showed that the identification method of cement clinker composition change based on locality preserving projections and K-medoids was feasible. This paper provides a feasible method for the identification of cement clinker composition change.

articleTitle: Robust Filtering for Nonlinear Stochastic Delay Systems with Multiplicative Noise and Jumps
abstract: In this paper, the robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filtering problem of nonlinear stochastic systems with delay and infinite Markov jumps was studied. Based on a nonlinear stochastic bounded real lemma and the filtering equation, we constructed the asymptotically mean square H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filtering and the exponentially mean square H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filtering via solving Hamilton-Jacobi inequalities. A numerical example was given to show the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis for Attitude Sensors based on Analytical Redundancy and EMD
abstract: This paper proposes a fault diagnosis approach for the satellite attitude determination subsystem based on analytical redundancy and empirical mode decomposition (EMD). Based on the analytical redundancy, a steady-state Kalman filter is proposed to detect the faults in the gyroscopes and the earth sensors. To further locate the fault source, EMD algorithm is used to detect the fault in the gyroscopes. Final decision is based on the results provided these two methods. The proposed method combines the model-based approach and the signal processing technique. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On-board Rapid Planning for Booster Trajectory of Multistage Rocket Based on SQP and Surrogate Model
abstract: Based on the Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP), this paper proposes an on-board rapid planning guidance for the boost phase of multistage rockets. Considering the time-consuming of the SQP algorithm, a surrogate model is built in order to reduce the times of iteration. Firstly, according to the multistage rocket model and traditional SQP algorithm, an initial trajectory is achieved by flight trajectory optimization. Secondly, considering the varieties of constraints and aerodynamics deviation, a polynomial surrogate model is built for calculating the approximate guidance command in every planning period. Finally, improved SQP algorithm is used for on-board trajectory planning with the approximate guidance command. Numerical simulation results show that surrogate model can effectively reduce the time consuming of SQP algorithm and on-board trajectory planning problems with multiple constraints and uncertain aerodynamic coefficient can be solved by the improved SQP effectively.

articleTitle: Approaches to Modeling and Optimization of Warship Testability Indicators Based on Mission Process Analysis
abstract: With reference to the requirements for quantitative indicators of warship equipment testability, total testability indicator of warship is proposed as a new concept to cope with the disconnection of warship development and design from its actual service in operations. By analyzing the mission cycle and operational process of warship, a model for quantifying the total testability indicators of warship is constructed under the constraints of total indicators and the restrictions from indicators at the same level. A specific approach is introduced to calculate each type of testability indicators, so as to provide the methodological support and theoretical basis for the design of optimized testability and the overall demonstration and development of warship equipment.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a Slung-load System for the Helicopter
abstract: This paper investigates the dynamic modeling and the simulation of a slung-load system for a helicopter. A slinging-flight model, a flexible suspension cable model, a takeoff and landing model and an underwater towed model are established respectively according to the separated modeling method, which can meet the requirement of multi-task simulation for the helicopter with a slung-load. The simulation of the slung-load system is completed through the interaction with a helicopter flight simulation system, and it proves the rationality of the model.

articleTitle: Study on Tracing Algorithm of TDOA-based AIEKF
abstract: This paper studies the TDOA location tracing algorithm based on extended Kalman filter in UWB. A kind of Adaptive Iteration Extended Kalman Filter (AIEKF) is proposed based on the disadvantage that the EKF algorithm's positioning accuracy reduces with the increase of measurement error and the simulation results show that this algorithm can maintain good positioning accuracy and convergence speed during the increase of the distance-measuring error.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Asymmetric Three-phase Grid Voltage Phase-locking Method Based on Improved Extended Kalman Filter
abstract: Under the asymmetric condition of the three-phase grid voltage, the traditional phase-locking method can not accurately and quickly lock the phase due to the existence of harmonics. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a three-phase grid voltage phase-locking method under asymmetric conditions. Based on the establishment of grid voltage fault model, the basic principle of the extended Kalman filter is given. In view of the problem that the signal cannot be quickly reacted to the abrupt signal during phase locking, the hysteresis comparator and the root mean square method are added to the extended Kalman filter. According to the two states of grid voltage balance sag and unbalanced sag, the simulation results and analysis of the extended Kalman filter and improved extended Kalman filter are given respectively. The results show that the improved algorithm can quickly and accurately realize the phase locking of the three-phase grid voltage under asymmetric conditions, and compensate the phase tracking error caused by various grid faults during the phase-locking process. It not only applies to ideal grid conditions, but also enables rapid detection of voltage signals under various asymmetric conditions such as voltage drop, three-phase unbalance and low-voltage harmonics, which can effectively compensate for the shortcomings of traditional methods.

articleTitle: Adaptive stabilization of uncertain cascade nonlinear systems via output feedback
abstract: In this paper, the problem of stabilization is studied by output feedback, for a class of uncertain nonlinear cascade systems under weaker conditions. A high-gain observer based controller has been proposed to solve the problem of global output feedback stabilization for more general uncertain systems. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the usefulness of our results.

articleTitle: Networked H∞Fault-tolerant Control of Valve Opening in Multi-machine Power System
abstract: For networked interconnected power systems, a T-S fuzzy model is presented, considering the coupling caused by interconnection between regions, time-delay and the problem of actuator failure. The asymptotic stability conditions for the closed-loop systems are obtained, and a fuzzy controller is designed. The algorithm for solving the gain matrix is given. Finally, the effectiveness of the designed controller is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: Event-triggered pinning synchronization of stochastic complex dynamical networks
abstract: This article mainly investigates the synchronization of stochastic complex dynamical networks. In order to attain required synchronization behavior of the complex dynamical networks, this paper designs a pinning control strategy controlling a part of nodes. Furthermore, combined with the event-triggered mechanism, the frequency of the communication is reduced. A framework of complex dynamical network is established, which reflects the nonlinearity and randomness of the numerous nodes of complex networks. By employing the Lyapunov-Krasovskii method, the stability criteria which guarantees the required synchronization of complex dynamical network is derived. The numerical example is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Trajectory tracking control of surface vessel with environmental disturbances
abstract: The trajectory tracking problem for surface vessel with random disturbances and unknown parameters is considered in this paper. The dynamic model with three degrees of freedom in form of quasi-Lagrange equation is obtained by regarding waves, winds, and currents as second moment processes. By the aid of quasi lower triangular structure, the random adaptive vectorial backstepping is designed by selecting augmented energy as Lyapunov function. We can get a surface vessel system which is noise-to-state-practically stable in probability Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Axial Switched Reluctance Wheel Motor Control System with the Direct Torque Based on Fractional Order Sliding Mode
abstract: In this paper, a new fractional order sliding mode controller is proposed to improve the torque ripple and system chattering of axial SRM when it is used in the taxiing operation of aircraft. Respectively different approaches are adopted to design the approaching rate in the former and later period of sliding mode control algorithm. Thus improving the high frequency and system chattering problem of traditional sliding mode controller. Finally, the optimized sliding model control system model of axial switch reluctance wheel motor is established, the simulation shows that the proposed method can effectively improve the system response time, reduce the torque ripple, meeting the application of axial switched reluctance motor on the necessary conditions.

articleTitle: Design of Repetitive Control with a Novel Structure Based on Sensitivity Analysis
abstract: Investigated on a testing table system, an improved repetitive controller with a novel structure is introduced to the periodic disturbance rejection in this paper. Based on sensitivity analysis, a controller design scheme with two portions is derived for a better disturbance rejection performance. One portion is adopting a novel structure for a sensitivity optimization, and meanwhile the design can do help to the bandwidth extension of the low-pass filter so that the phase lag caused by the filter is reduced. The other portion is to reject the phase loss by reducing the delay time. Subsequently, an empirical formula is proposed to compensate the phase lag of the filter for a further modification of the controller. Simulation and comparison results are disclosed to validate the effectiveness of the control design.

articleTitle: Design of Attitude and Heading Reference System Based on DSP and STM32
abstract: This paper based on the DSP and STM32 single-chip microcomputer, adopting multi-sensor data fusion to carry out the Kalman filter as the aerial pose solution unit, the core part of a posture reference system is designed in this paper. A three-axis multifunctional turntable SGT320E is selected to analyze and verify the data in static and dynamic environment. The results show that the navigation-attitude reference system can meet the requirements of navigation attitude system and is suitable for civil applications where the requirements for precision are not very high.

articleTitle: Average-consensus Tracking of Ramp Inputs via Second-order Multi-agent Systems
abstract: Average-consensus tracking problem of ramp reference inputs is investigated for the second-order multi-agent systems, and the proportional-integral (PI) consensus algorithms are constructed. By using matrix theory and frequency- domain analysis, sufficient and necessary consensus convergence conditions are obtained for second-order multi-agent systems with all agents getting the reference inputs firstly. In addition, sufficient consensus conditions are gained for second-order multi-agent systems with some additional interconnecting agents that do not have the reference inputs. Numerical simulations illustrate the correctness of theoretical results.

articleTitle: Global Dynamic Path Planning Based on Fusion of Improved A* Algorithm and Morphin Algorithm
abstract: To meet the requirements of global optimal and real-time obstacle avoidance in mobile robot path planning, A novel method based on the fusion of improved A* algorithm and Morphin search tree algorithm is proposed. Firstly, A more appropriate heuristic function is designed for A* algorithm; Then a key node culling scheme is introduced into the traditional A* algorithm to remove the redundant nodes; Finally, the Morphin algorithm is integrated to perform real-time dynamic path planning on the global path based on the local information collected by the mobile robot sensor. On the basis of ensuring the better global path, the smoothness and local obstacle avoidance ability of path planning are improved. MATLAB simulation tests show that the mixed algorithm with A* and Morphin search tree algorithm can effectively shorten the path length and improve the efficiency to reach the target in the autonomous mobile robot path planning, efficiently complete path planning.

articleTitle: Faults Prediction and Diagnoses of Shield Machine Based on LSTM
abstract: Because the environment where shield machine is running is full of complexity and risk, it's possible for some serious faults to occur. And if operators could not find and solve the problems timely, it may lead to accidents. This paper applies long short-term network to predict and diagnose some common faults including the formation of mud cake, the wear of cutters, the blockage of slurry pipe and the subsidence of land by time series sensor data from shield machine. The simulation verifies the feasibility of our method. In this paper, a LSTM network is improved and we demonstrate that compared with LSTM model and GRU(Gated Recurrent Unit) model, the loss function of the improved model converge faster in the same epoch and achieve higher accuracy. The results show that our method to predict and diagnose the faults is satisfying.

articleTitle: License Plate Location Algorithm Based on Grayscale Stretching and Maximum Variance Threshold Segmentation
abstract: Aiming at the problem that traditional license plate location algorithm is not ideal in positioning effect, a method of applying grayscale stretching and maximum variance threshold segmentation method to the preprocessing of image preprocessing is proposed. The structure and color features of the license plate are used to identify whether the location is the license plate and to remove the area of the mischecked license plate. By improving the image contrast and automatically determining the binarization threshold, an improved preprocessing algorithm for complex background images of high-speed toll gate and bayonet is established. Based on this method, the license plate can be located quickly. Experimental result shows that the method has the characteristics of high accuracy and rapidity of license plate positioning.

articleTitle: Absolute Stability for a Class of Switched Delay System with Stable and Unstable Subsystems
abstract: The problem of absolute exponential stability of a class of switched delay system with stable and unstable subsystems is studied. Consideration is given to two cases of time-varying delays, one being continuous and uniformly bounded and the other being differential and the derivative of the delay bounded. A less conservative Lypunov function with the integral of state differential and a switching law are designed to obtain some new delay-dependent criteria in LMIs. Besides, an example is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Prediction Strategy of the Maximum Thinning Rate of Cylindrical Part with Flange during Sheet Metal Drawing Process
abstract: In this study, an intelligent strategy of predicting the maximum thinning rate is proposed. Prediction strategy is based on Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN). Because Blank Holder Force (BHF) can effectively reflect the thinning rate of cylindrical part with flange, the nodes of which are served as the inputs of BPNN in this research. The prediction objective is to obtain corresponding the maximum thinning rate of cylindrical part, which is served as the output of BPNN. The inputs data are derived from designed several critical types of Variable Blank Holder Force (VBHF). In addition, the output data is originated from corresponding simulation results of cylindrical part drawing. The mathematical expressions of prediction process have also been given in this paper. The advantage of this novel prediction strategy is that it can rapidly and accurately obtain the thickness reduction rate of cylindrical part with flange. Eventually, the validation of the created prediction method is proved by corresponding simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: The Application of Harmonic Suppression Method Based on Ripple Prediction Model in Underwater Propulsion System
abstract: The fixed switching frequency method in space vector pulse width modulation strategy has been widely used in the motor speed control system. The three-phase current of the motor under this control method will generate harmonics with higher amplitude at integer multiples of the switching frequency. It is the main source of electromagnetic noise generated by the motor. Therefore, in order to suppress the current harmonics of the driver output and improve the current waveform quality, first of all, the three-phase current ripple generation mechanism based on the common topology of the three-phase motor driver is deduced theoretically and the current ripple prediction model is obtained. The results of the prediction model are then used to specifically modify the switching frequency of motor driver to reduce the amount of current harmonics during motor rotation. The experimental results show that the harmonic suppression control method based on ripple prediction model is more effective than the traditional fixed switching frequency method in reducing the motor current harmonics and improving current quality. The method in this paper has been applied in an underwater propulsion system.

articleTitle: The Weld Extraction Algorithm for Robotic Arc Welding Based on 3D Laser Sensor
abstract: A weld extraction algorithm combining 2D image and 3D point cloud data is proposed in this paper, based on 3D laser sensor and a six-DOF industrial robot. Firstly, 3D point cloud data and 2D depth image can be obtained through the 3D laser sensor. Secondly, the weld feature points can be extracted while the weld can be accurately positioned, using 2D image processing method. Thirdly, the 3D weld information can be extracted by 2D weld mapping to 3D space through certain rules. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed algorithm is verified by experiments. The results strongly prove that the algorithm can be used to obtain the 3D weld information of type 1 weld in the bicycle frame, which completely meets the needs of industrial production.

articleTitle: Customer Value Analysis Based on Python Crawler
abstract: Customer value analysis is an important work in customer relationship management. In this paper, we use ABC classification, RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) model and K-means clustering method to analyze the customer value. First, we use python language to compile a crawler program to collect the data of transaction records from an enterprise's customer information management system. Then, by using different methods, we obtain different classifications of the customers. The test results demonstrate that the proposed methods can provide constructive suggestions to manage the customer value in practice, although they are easy and basic.

articleTitle: Target Recognition Based on SIFT Algorithm for a Train Uncoupling Robot
abstract: The train uncoupling robot is a 4-DOF robot which can complete the uncoupling work efficiently and accurately in the process of disassembly or marshalling of freight trains or passenger trains without the help of workers. The uncoupling work should be completed when the train and the uncoupling robot are both in motion. However, this increases the difficulty of recognizing the hook of trains and finishing the uncoupling work automatically. Therefore, the visual system of the robot plays a vital role during the uncoupling process so that it can be able to recognize the target hook by analyzing images and data from cameras and sensors. Furthermore, it should also have the ability to predict the motion planning of the object. In this paper, a visual control scheme is developed by using the Scale-invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) algorithm to recognize the hook of train in motion. It searches the extreme points as the key-points, and extracts the features such as position, scale and direction to match between the two images. The results indicate that the target hook can be recognized accurately and the recognition speed can meet the working requirements of the system by using the proposed visual control scheme even if the size of the target is varying or the target rotates moderately.

articleTitle: Decentralized Guaranteed Cost Control for Reconfigurable Manipulators with Environmental Constraints Based on Adaptive Dynamic Programming
abstract: In this paper, a decentralized guaranteed cost control method based on adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) is proposed to address the optimal control problem of reconfigurable manipulators with environmental constraints. The designed control policy is adopted to deal with the effect of joint friction, interconnection dynamic coupling (IDC) and uncertain external environmental constraints. Based on the ADP algorithm, an online policy iteration algorithm is used to solve the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation with a modified cost function, and the approximate optimal control strategy is obtained by constructing a critic neural network that is used to approximate optimal cost function. The closed-loop robotic system is proved to be asymptotic stability by using the Lyapunov theory. Finally, the simulations of the manipulators with two different configurations are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: H∞ Functional Observer Design for One-Sided Lipschitz Nonlinear Systems with Time-Delay
abstract: H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> functional observer design for one-sided Lipschitz nonlinear systems with time-delay is investigated. The existence conditions of the gain matrices of the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> functional observer are derived based on the linear matrix inequality, and the gain matrices of the functional observer is obtained. The error dynamics asymptotically converges to zero when systems in the absence of noises. The proposed functional observer can effectively suppress disturbances in the presence of noises. Finally, simulation results are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: Adaptive sliding mode decentralized control for modular and reconfigurable robots with torque sensor
abstract: The main technical challenge in decentralized control of modular and reconfigurable robots (MRRs) with torque sensor is related to the treatment of interconnection terms and friction terms. This paper proposed a modified adaptive sliding mode decentralized control strategy for trajectory tracking control of the MRRs. The radial basis function (RBF) neural network is used as an effective learning method to approximate the interconnect terms and friction terms, eliminating the effect of model uncertainty and reducing the controller gain. In addition, in order to provide faster convergence and higher precision control, the terminal sliding mode (TSM) algorithm is introduced to the controller design. Based on the Lyapunov method, the stability of the MRRs is proved. Finally, experiments are performed to confirm the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Demand Estimation of Water Resources based on Coupling Algorithm
abstract: Demand estimation of water resources is an important basic content in the process of urban water resources planning. To predict water resource demand accurately, a coupling algorithm based on bacterial foraging optimization algorithm (BFOA) and glowworm swarm optimization (GSO) is employed to estimate the demand of water resources in this paper. The historical data (2003-2015) is divided into two parts for convenience in the simulation experiments, one (2003-2012) is trained to gain the weighting factors of the estimation and the other (2013-2015) is used for predicting and evaluating water resources. In addition, the simulation results show that the coupling algorithm achieves a higher accuracy compare with BFOA and GSO on prediction.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization in Formation Reconfiguration Problem for Multi-UAV
abstract: Formation reconfiguration problem for multi-UAV plays a crucial role in the implementation of complex tasks for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, which attracted more and more attention in the past decade. However, the previous researches rarely consider the effect of wind, which will limit the formation quality and result in the position deviation for UAVs. In this paper, the continuous inputs of each flight in formation reconfiguration process are dispersed by using Control Parameterization and Time Discretization (CPTD) method, based on that the robust optimization model taking into account wind is established. It can be concluded from the experiment, the optimization result calculated from the robust optimization model for formation reconfiguration problem will lead to less position deviation and higher formation quality under the circumstance of wind.

articleTitle: Event-triggered adaptive control for networked control systems under two stochastic cyber-attacks
abstract: This paper studies an improved event-triggered control for networked control systems (NCSs) under two kinds of cyber-attacks with limited communication bandwidth. In order to reduce the unnecessary transmissions, a novel adaptive event-triggered scheme is employed to determine whether the sensor measurements should be transmitted or not. It is assumed that the network transmissions may be attacked by two randomly occurring cyber-attacks, then a mathematical model is obtained and a sufficient condition is derived to guarantee the asymptotical stability of closed-loop system, which is expressed in terms of linear matrix inequality (LMI). Especially, an augmented Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) is constructed and an improved reciprocal convex technique is proposed to reduce the conservatism. Finally, a numerical example is presented to show our obtained results.

articleTitle: The carbon-constrained EOQ model under the cap-and-trade regulation considering the consumers’ low-carbon awareness
abstract: Under the background of low-carbon economy, firms worldwide have to adjust their operations, including inventory operation, to adapt to the carbon emission regulation. The carbon emission regulation policies have marked influences on inventory systems. In addition, as an exogenous variable, the customers' low-carbon awareness can also affect the inventory optimization through emission-sensitive demand. This paper incorporates the cap-and-trade regulation and the consumers' low-carbon awareness into the classical (Economic Order Quantity) EOQ model and investigates their influences on the optimal order size, the emission level and total cost. These influences are presented by a serial of theorems. Numerical examples provide more support for these analytical conclusions. Some managerial insights can be derived from the analytical results and numerical examples.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Data Acquisition and Processing Algorithm Based on Improved FFT
abstract: From the aspects of energy saving and emission reduction, data monitoring and analysis, the monitoring requirements of distribution system and equipment are emphatically analyzed, a set of power energy efficiency monitoring terminal which can collect and process various electrical data is put forward, and the core algorithm of data acquisition and processing system of this terminal is studied and designed in this paper. The main contents of this paper include the detailed design of the FFT algorithm for harmonic analysis of devices, and the FFT algorithm using rectangular window, Hanning window, Hamming window, single-peak spectral line interpolation, bimodal spectral line interpolation and other interpolation methods is compared and analyzed, finally, the improved FFT algorithm is proposed. A large number of experiments on the system show that the improved FFT algorithm can effectively improve the calculation accuracy of harmonic analysis when asynchronous sampling, and fully meet the actual needs of the power industry, so the research and design of this paper has a high theoretical reference value and practical value.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Switching Control Strategy for Aero-engines Considering Sensor Dynamic
abstract: This paper investigates the thrust tracking problem with safety constraints for aero-engines. A new switching control strategy is proposed to pursue the tradeoff between tracking performance and safety. A switching controller consisting of three sub-controllers and a switching logic is designed. Since the sensor dynamic is taken into account, the control input cannot influence derivative of the constrained output directly. So safety protection controller must be activated before the system trajectory reaches the safety boundary. A locally monotonic tracking controller is designed for the safety protection mode. The proposed switching logic is based on the monitoring of the tracking performance and the safety requirement. Control discontinuity which is bad for transient performance is eliminated through the integral reset technique. The proposed strategy is designed based on the equilibrium manifold expansion (EME) model. This nonlinear model can describe aero-engine's dynamic behavior more accurately. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified through the nonlinear component-level (NCL) model of a two-spool turbofan engine. Simulation indicates the better performance by using the proposed switching control strategy than the single control strategy.

articleTitle: A manner to assess the energy consumption of business hotel buildings
abstract: This paper studies the problem of evaluating the energy consumption of business star hotels at a particular time. According to the collected data we put forward the STIRPAT model, the results show it can fit the constant relationship well between hotel energy consumption and influence indexes. In order to get the contribution rate of each influence factor and track abnormal factors, we use the LMDI method to decompose energy consumption. The ultimate goal of the study is to establish a reasonable amount of energy consumption, so comparable indicator EUI<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub> is confirmed after coefficient of EUI is modified. Further, it is important for government to grade the annual energy consumption about equal star hotels according to reasonable value f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>,⋯, x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>) and advanced value f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> (x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>,⋯, x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>) , which are realized by quartile method. For more applicable, time is refined, year is converted to quarterly and monthly by using the integral mean value theorem, so the quota is granulated. Simulation estimations of per month energy consumption of A hotel, the average error rate is 1.683%, then we decompose the influencing factors and get the contribution rate by the LMDI method, the final result is realistic that proves that the model can find the cause of the exception, which is able to provide operational basis for hotel management.

articleTitle: System Design and Clinical Simulation of A Robotic System for Endoscopic Sinus Surgery
abstract: Endoscopic sinus surgery is of essential clinical significance. Nevertheless, the surgery demands very high skills, as the doctor has to hold the endoscope with one hand and perform dexterous operation in the constrained space inside the nose with the other hand. A robotic system can be of help. In this paper, we designed a robotic system to assist endoscopic sinus surgery, and established a virtual surgery platform for clinical simulation. Firstly, the clinical requirements for the surgical robot, such as degrees of freedom, workspace, etc., were analyzed. Then, the mechanism configuration was determined after comparison and study of possible types. Further, the mechanism parameters were specified according to the clinical requirements. Afterwards, a virtual prototype of the surgical robot was developed. Finally, a virtual surgery platform was built up, in which the the user can use a haptic interface to teleoperate the virtual robot and perform virtual endoscopic sinus surgery.

articleTitle: Self-Adaption FOPID Controller Design for Internal Temperature in Roller System Based on Data-Driven Technique
abstract: In this paper, we desire to update the traditional PID controller of vertical roller mill PID controller to have a better performance in temperature adjustment. The open extent of cold blast sliding valve is our controlled device, and we design a fractional order proportion integration differentiation (FOPID) controller with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to control it. This algorithm is an assistant tool to achieve online updating the parameters of the FOPID controller. For starters, the pseudo-partial derivative (PPD) parameters are estimated dynamically by the state observer. Secondly, three parameters of integer order PID controller,K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>,K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> and K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>, are determined by PPD parameter observer and gradient descent algorithm. Afterwards, PSO algorithm is used to adjust and correct μ, λ and online update them. Finally, the simulation results show that the controller has a good impact for the outlet temperature control, which is better than the traditional PID controller.

articleTitle: UAV Attitude Synchronization Based on Event-triggered without Angular Velocity Measurement
abstract: The cyclic sampling in the process of UAV information transmission usually causes the network communication pressure to increase sharply, information delay and packet loss because the limited communication resources. In order to reduce communication pressure, an event-trigged communication scheme is proposed for UAV attitude synchronization where there is no angular velocity measurement. A virtual system is designed for each UAV to estimate the angular velocity so that the attitude synchronization controller can he constructed by using the angular velocity feedback. The information transmitted among the virtual systems is sent on the basis of event-triggered scheme. Thus the synchronization controllers and communication scheme are co-designed such that the communication load is less than the time-triggered communication. In the fixed undirected topology, the numerical simulation results show that under the event-triggered communication mechanism, the UAV can realize the leadless and leader-follower attitude synchronization without angular velocity measurement.

articleTitle: Alarm Root-Cause Identification for Petrochemical Process System Based on Fluctuation Correlation Analysis
abstract: Current alarm system for the chemical plant mainly concerns the single variable alarm. However, in the actual operation, operators hope to obtain information of other variables that affect the alarm variable so as to judge the problems of the device timely. In order to solve this demand, this paper proposes a new method for root-cause analysis Fluctuation Correlation Analysis FCA. By effectively using operating data of devices this method accurately depicts correlation between independent variables, and has low computation complexity, which just meets the need of alarm system for computing speed. We applied FCA to the on-line monitoring system, and it can provide alarm information and operation instruction in time.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Petri Net Model of Distributed RFID Reader Network
abstract: Radio Frequency IDentification (RFID) is an emerging wireless communication technology that enables us to automatically sense the data information attached on the target object. Generally, an RFID system has two types of components: reader and tag. To improve the RFID system efficiency, multiple readers are required to be deployed in a single working area, which excites the reader-to-reader collision problem. This paper proposes a hierarchical Petri net model of the distributed RFID reader network, which illustrates the structure of the reader network as well as the operation flow of the reader. Theoretical and application analysis results demonstrate that the proposed hierarchical Petri net model is reasonable and effective for the distributed RFID reader network.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of 3D Printing Equipment for Removable Site Buildings
abstract: 3D printing is a layered superposition process based on the manufacturing technology of additional materials. With the continuous progress of 3D printing technology, it has gradually been applied in the construction industry. This article introduces a movable field 3D printing device for larger buildings(such as bridges).. Firstly, the design principle of the equipment is explained, and then the whole structure, functions, system control methods and workflow of the equipment are introduced from its chassis device, printing device, cleaning device, etc., to provide reference for the research of large-scale cement 3D printing equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Speed Measurement Algorithm Based on LMS Adaptive Filtering and d-Step Prediction
abstract: In this paper, for the non-contact speed measurement technology of maglev train, the speed resolution is limited, the speed measurement accuracy needs to be further improved, and the sensor signal is easily disturbed, which leads to speed oscillation. Firstly, the speed system error and random error are analyzed. Secondly, a speed measurement algorithm based on LMS adaptive filtering and d-step prediction is proposed to improve the speed measurement accuracy and anti-interference performance of the speed measurement system.

articleTitle: Construction of the Lyapunov function for a class of H∞ norm problem
abstract: This paper focuses on how to directly get the accurate solution for the system H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> norm problem. A Lyapunov function construction method is presented. The presented method constructs the Lyapunov function according to the structure parameters of the second-order system, and gives the analytical expression for the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> norm. Different from the conventional linear matrix inequality (LMI) approaches which need the complex optimization process to get the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> norm, the presented method gives the analytical expression for the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> norm. Thus, this paper provides an alternative way to directly get the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> norm by properly constructing the Lyapunov function. The effectiveness of the presented method is verified by some examples.

articleTitle: Automated Segmentation of the Optic Disc from Retinal Image Using Modified Local Intensity Clustering Model
abstract: Accurate optic disc (OD) segmentation plays an essential role in retinal disease diagnosis. In the paper, a novel method for segmenting OD boundary without manpower named automatic double boundary extraction is designed. It has two unique advantage. First, considering evolved contour always using imprecise initial contour which is manual or fixed, we propose a robust adaptive method for initializing the level set applying unsupervised machine learning theory. Second, in order to overcome complex OD appearance caused by some anomalies, the modified Local Intensity Clustering (MLIC) method by combining the multi-feature was proposed. Experimental results testing on publicly available DIARETDB0 database demonstrate that our approach outperforms well known approaches.

articleTitle: Design of Capacitive Sensor for Phase Concentration Measurement in Two-phase Flow
abstract: Concave capacitive sensors are widely applied for phase concentration measurement in two-phase flow. Fringing electric fields exist between any two concave capacitance electrodes of finite length and the additional capacitance these fields add is not easily accounted for. It is important to account for fringe effect in many capacitive sensing applications in order to ensure accurate measurement results. In this paper, a capacitive sensor with axis and radial grounded guard electrodes is proposed. The performance of the sensor with and without guard electrodes in term of fringe effect and output linearity is investigated. For the determination of the optimal structure of the capacitive sensor, numerical simulation and response surface method are adopted. Numerical simulation and static phantom experiments show the effectiveness of the proposed capacitive sensor which allowed a significant reduction of the fringe effect and good linearity and good sensing field homogeneity.

articleTitle: Power Quality Disturbance Detection based on Improved Lifting Wavelet
abstract: A new power quality disturbance detection algorithm based on improved lifting wavelet is proposed to solve the problem of power quality disturbance detection in power system. The algorithm combines the weighted average filtering algorithm to optimize the prediction of lifting wavelet decomposition. After the disturbance signal is decomposed by lifting wavelet, the disturbance mutation point is detected by the principle of modulus maximum. The simulation and test waveform analysis of power quality disturbance show that the algorithm has higher accuracy and stronger noise resistance compared with the existing detection algorithm based on lifting wavelet.

Author Keywords: Lifting Wavelet and Weighted Average Filtering Algorithm

articleTitle: Improved BACF Tracker Based on Multi-Peak Detection in Visual Tracking
abstract: Correlation Filter(CF) based trackers are currently ranked top in terms of their performances on different benchmark datasets, while maintaining high frame rates. A significant amount of recent research focus on the application of strong features or discriminative model to improve comprehensive performance of the algorithm. However, lack of pertinence in some particular scenarios, especially occlusion in which most tracking algorithms can hardly well handle. The proposed tracker deals with the key causes behind the drift of tracking model under occlusion with the aim of improving performance in this scenario. By introducing Multi-Peak Detection into BACF to determine the moment of the target reappearance, the actual target can be re-detected at two positions with similar response values. In addition, this paper proposed a confidence criterion to determine the real position of the target. The proposed tracker is extensively evaluated on OTB Benchmarks: OTB-2013 and OTB-2015, and achieves an absolute improvement of 3.4% and 4.6% respectively compared to the BACF in overlap. The experimental results show the excellent performance against the state-of-the-art CF based trackers under occlusion.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-approximation-based decentralized adaptive control for nonlinear large-scale systems with unknown interconnections by output feedback
abstract: The decentralized adaptive control method is proposed for a class of large-scale uncertain nonlinear systems with unknown interconnections, unavailable states and input saturations. The observer is used to reconstruct the system states. The unknown nonlinearities can be identified by the fuzzy logical systems (FLSs). By applying a separation technique, the restrictions coming from unknown interconnections are relaxed. Combing adaptive method, Lyapunov stability theory and backstepping technique, decentralized output feedback controllers are proposed to stabilize the resulting interconnected systems. Finally, simulation results are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the presented approach.

articleTitle: Iterative learning consensus tracking control for distributed parameter models multi-agent with disturbance
abstract: In this paper, we study the consensus tracking for a class of distributed parameter models multi-agent systems. Taking into account the presence of disturbance in the system, using knowledge between neighboring agents, the virtual leader technology is introduced. A distributed P-type iterative learning control protocol is proposed. When the ILC law is applied to the system, the consensus tracking error between any two agents under the sense of L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> norm can converge to zero after a sufficient number of iterations in a finite time interval. Finally, simulation examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Fast Collision Avoidance Method Based on Velocity Resolution for Unmanned Surface Vehicle
abstract: The Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) have the characteristics of small volume, fast speed, and its application field is often in unknown complex ocean environment. Therefore, it is necessary to solve the fast collision avoidance problem of USV in unknown ocean environment. To solve this problem, a fast collision avoidance method based on velocity resolution is proposed. The motion constraint of the USV in the method is mainly based on the Lanxin USV of Dalian Maritime University. Finally, the safety and rapidity of the method are verified in the complex static and dynamic environments, which can provide a reference for the research of collision avoidance technology about USV.

articleTitle: Path Tracking Control of Omnidirectional Mobile Robot Based on Bidirectional Visual Navigation
abstract: A Mecanum-wheeled omnidirectional mobile robot with path tracking control system based on linear CCD camera is designed. According to the structural characteristics of the designed omnidirectional mobile robot, the kinematics equation of the robot is analyzed, and the trajectory deviation adjustment model of the robot is established based on the kinematics equation of the robot. The control system of the robot is designed. Two cameras are used to constraint the robot body posture. The principle of path tracking using cameras is analyzed. The following strategies are adopted in the image process: dynamic threshold method, adaptive exposure method, mean filter processing, binary processing method. Finally, the effect of the control system is investigated experimentally. The deviation of the robot can be measured stably and the robot path tracking control is realized.

articleTitle: Improvement of multi-objective differential evolutionary algorithm and its application for Hybrid electric vehicles
abstract: Differential evolutionary algorithm (DE) is a practical and simple intelligent algorithm. Its improvement and application in multi objective problem is the main research of this paper. To improve the convergence speed and stability of DE, and use it to solve multi-objective problems, the mixed mutation strategy, self-adaptive parameters and minimum neighbor distance are used in this paper, aimed for better performance of the algorithm. Combining with these ideals, the multi-objective self-adaptive differential evolution (MOSDE) proposed in this paper is used so solve benchmark test functions and be compared with the SPEA2. The optimization of hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) is a nonlinear and constrained multi-objective optimization problem. For low consumption of fuel and emission load, we use the MOSDE to optimize some components' parameters and control strategy variables, and provide the best compromise solution from the Pareto solution set.

articleTitle: The synchronization of the different dimensional Rabinovich systems using passive control and sliding mode control methods
abstract: This paper discusses the finite-time synchronization for different dimensional Rabinovich systems by two types, namely reduced-order synchronization and increased-order synchronization. The passive control and sliding mode control techniques are discussed in this study to achieve the chaos synchronization. Both of the techniques realize the synchronization by constructing controllers. But, the controllers of the two ways are respectively based on the Lyapunov stability theory and Routh-Hurwitz criterion which are utilized to ensure the global asymptotic stability of the error state system. Under the controllers, the error status system can be adjusted to zero equilibrium point. Numerical simulations have compared and demonstrated the results of the two introduced approaches.

articleTitle: The Research of Handheld Stabilization System Based on Active Disturbance Rejection Control Strategy
abstract: The handheld stabilization system is a strong-coupling, nonlinear and time-varying system and its model parameters are not accurate enough. Under the control of traditional control methods, the anti-interference performance of the three-axis handheld stabilizer is often insufficient. In order to solve this problem a control strategy based on the active disturbance rejection control has been proposed. The results of simulation and experiment show that the active disturbance rejection controller has the characteristics of high robustness, low model dependence and simple operation. It can control system stability in a high speed when parameters of the system changed rapidly.

articleTitle: Research on SCARA robot sorting system based on CoDeSys
abstract: This article intends to build the SCARA robot sorting system. We analyzed the kinematics characteristics of the SCARA robot. The link coordinate system is established by D-H method, the forward and inverse kinematics equations are derived and solved. Then we developed the motion control program of SCARA robot through CoDeSys platform. The off-line simulation is realized by combining the forward and inverse kinematics with WPF 3D simulation technology. The data transmission and real-time simulation are realized by OPC DA communication technology. Finally, the camera calibration is completed by computer vision, the core, area, perimeter and contour of the workpiece are obtained by image processing.

articleTitle: A Speed Estimation Method with Stator Resistance Online Identification based on MRAS
abstract: A speed estimation method with stator resistance online identification based on model reference adaptive system is designed for speed sensorless control of induction motor in order to improve the poor control accuracy caused by stator resistance variation under the long-running conditions. For the stator resistance identification, the error between the measured value of stator current and the estimated value of current model is back propagated to adjust the weights of the neural network. In model reference adaptive system, PI control is replaced with signal neuron control to enhance the robustness of system. Simulation results have shown that the improved speed estimation with stator resistance identification has better accuracy and stronger stability compared with general MRAS sensorless control.

articleTitle: Fourth Party Logistics Collaborative Routing Problem Considering Earliness and Tardiness
abstract: With the development of logistics industry, more and more people begin to pay attention to the delivery time of logistics transportation. Logistics transportation time that is too long or too short will have a certain impact on customer satisfaction. If the time of logistics transportation is too short, there will be the cost of goods arriving in advance; if the time of logistics transportation is too long, there will be the cost of goods arriving late. In this paper, a problem that considering transportation time for earliness or tardiness and Fourth Party Logistics (4PL) collaborate with Third Party Logistics (3PL) problem is proposed, and a non-linear mathematical model is established with the objective of minimizing the transportation cost and the time of customer's allowable service as constraints. The experimental results obtained by enumeration algorithm show that when the penalty coefficient for tardiness is fixed, with the increase of the penalty coefficient for earliness, the transportation cost of route increases gradually and remains unchanged at last. The corresponding route is transported from advance to no longer ahead of schedule. When the penalty coefficient for earliness is fixed, with the increase of the penalty coefficient for tardiness, the transportation cost increases gradually and remains unchanged at last. The corresponding route is transported from tardiness to no longer tardiness. By adjusting the penalty coefficient for earliness and tardiness, earliness and tardiness of logistics transportation time can be effectively controlled.

articleTitle: Coordinated Damping Control for Power System Dynamic Stability based on Wide-area Expert System
abstract: This paper proposed a novel coordinated control technique among multiple FACTS damping controllers based on the wide-area collaborative expert control system theory. The grid operation status and interaction of multiple FACTS controllers was monitored in real time based on the advanced experience of control experts, and efficient extraction of the feature quantity of multiple FACTS coordinated control was achieved. In what follows, real-time coordination control decisions were automatic generated through sub-expert systems which ensured the coordinated control of multiple FACTSs within the regional grid. The sub-expert systems were supervised and coordinated by the primary coordinated system, and the coordinated control of multiple FACTS controllers within the system was realized in real time, which provided a new solution to multiple FACTS devices coordinated control in complex power systems. Time domain simulation results validated the conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on the game scheduling optimization of heterogeneous integrated energy system with wind power uncertainties
abstract: In many types of heterogeneous integrated energy system, energy hub of optimal to ensure energy security, stable and economic operation system is important. However, numerous energy hub device, and there is serious uncertainty of wind power access, the hub connected coupling between serious at the same time , makes it hard for the use of traditional optimization scheduling method to solve many kinds of heterogeneous integrated energy hub of mutual influence and mutual restriction between problem. To this end, the Nash equilibrium theory to solve many kinds of heterogeneous integrated energy system optimization scheduling problem. According to the coupling relationship of different energy carrier based on power flow, set up many kinds of heterogeneous energy line set in the system. The game model between the players can effectively and accurately realize the optimal dispatch through a robust optimization technology and overcome the uncertainty caused by wind power integration of the energy hub. The results show the applicability and robustness of the game model in dealing with the optimization scheduling problem.

articleTitle: A Classification Method for Small Sample Multi-label Images
abstract: This paper studies the classification problem of the small sample multi-label image scene recognition. Combining convolutional neural network (CNN) and multi-label K neighborhood algorithm (MLKNN), the CNN-MLKNN classification method is proposed. The method uses CNN to automatically extract the features of small sample images, and combines transfer learning to optimize the model structure and weight to reduce the risk of over-fitting. MLKNN algorithm is used to replace the sigmoid function of CNN, and the output features of the FC layer are used as input features of MLKNN for image classifier training. Based on the classification experiments of two small sample multi-label image sets, seven multi-label evaluation indicators are used for testing.
