The experimental results show that the CNN-MLKNN method proposed in this paper has a better classification effect.

articleTitle: Gear ratio optimization of two-speed transmission in electric off-road vehicle
abstract: This paper presents the optimization gear ratio for an electric off-road vehicle equipped with two-speed Transmission, aiming at improving the fuel economy and dynamic performances. The power of the electric off-road vehicle is taken as the constraint condition, and the optimization goal is to achieve the lowest energy consumption of the entire vehicle by optimizing the transmission ratio of the transmission while satisfying the constraints of the power. According to the overall optimization, the optimal two-speed transmission gear ratio is obtained. It will also compare the energy consumption of the electric engineering vehicle with fixed gear ratio retarder under the same driving cycle.

articleTitle: Human Behavior Recognition Based on IC3D
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy of human behavior in videos, this paper proposes a method based on IC3D to identify human behavior in 3D-CNN neural network. A continuous 7-frame video images as input, using the gray level of video image, x-directional gradient, y-direction gradient, x-directional optical flow, y-directional optical flow, multichannel processing, after the 3D convolution and 3D pooling to extract the feature information with space and time dimensions. At the end of the network structure, the average pooling is processed to replace a layer of fully connected layer in the network structure, and the whole network is made regularization to prevent over-fitting, also because of the reduction of a layer of fully connected layer, so that the parameters required for training model are reduced greatly and the algorithm runs faster. Finally the action classification results are gotten through the fully connection layer and softmax classifier. Compared with the C3D, C3D+SVM and C3D+IDT+SVM three algorithms in UCF101 dataset, it is proved that the IC3D network framework has higher recognition accuracy and faster operation speed in the video human behavior recognition problem.

articleTitle: Switch Controlled Charge Recovery Technique for Piezoelectric Fan
abstract: Due to excellent thermal performance parameter, piezoelectric fan has received much attention in heat dissipation applications, particularly, in the field of electronic cooling. This paper presents a charge recovery method to minimize power consumption and aims to improve the energy efficiency of the piezoelectric fan. A simplified inductor-based circuit will be illustrated, which is capable of voltage inversion across the piezoelectric actuator and contributes to restore the charge stored within the actuator. Finally, the eminent cooling performance of piezoelectric fan driven by the proposed simplified inductor-based circuit is validated by experiments. With our design, we have been able to achieve more than 40% reduction in power consumption and have less cost, compared to the conventional driver.

articleTitle: Target Search via Feature Cutting Strategy of Visual Attention Mechanism
abstract: Only part of the information and specific goals need to be paid attention to in the real image processing. Based on this a method using top-down visual attention mechanism is proposed in this paper to find a significant part and the given target with the learning of different features in different scales of sample images. The weights of the extracted features in different scales are calculated. Only the important features and optimal scales are selected in the real processing, that is the features and scales are cut when the relative weights are lower than the given threshold. The experimental results show that the presented method can localize the target accurately and quickly.

articleTitle: Co-simulation of Electromagnetic Field for Solenoid Control System Using Three Kinds of Software
abstract: For electromagnetic control system simulation of solenoid, a method of co-simulation using three kinds of software named Maxwell, Simplorer and Simulink is proposed in this paper. The explanation of method is detailed, and results show that the method is efficient. Firstly, the solenoid model is established by Maxwell software for finite element calculation of transient and steady state operation analysis. Then, the power supply circuit of solenoid is established by Simplorer software. Finally, the control system is constructed using Matlab/Simulink software. The key technology of their co-simulation is the connection of variables between different software. The effectiveness of the proposed model and method is verified by simulation experiments. This co-simulation method can provide an effective way for future research and design of similar solenoid electromagnetic field control systems. It has high practical value.

articleTitle: The Stability Analysis of DC-DC Conversion Systems Based on Monodromy Matrix
abstract: The stability analysis for the dc-dc conversion system which can be used in dc distributed power systems (DPS) is discussed in this paper. In this paper, the methods of monodromy matrix and small-signal analysis are proposed for the stability analysis of the dc-dc conversion system. Firstly, the methods of stability analysis for the whole system are generalized which can be used in any dc-dc conversion system as loon as the periodic orbit exists. Then, the efficiency of the propose methods can be verified though the dc-dc conversion system, which can minimize the ripple of the voltages, and altered radio of intermediate bus and output voltages for applying in pulse-width-modulated (PWM) voltage source converters for many industrial applications. Finally, stability of the systems can be verified by the experimental prototypes.

articleTitle: Finite-Horizon Adaptive Dynamic Programming for Collaborative Target Tracking in Energy Harvesting Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: Collaborative target tracking is a typical application of wireless sensor networks (WSNs), in which sensors shall be scheduled for trading off between the tracking performance and the energy utilization. Energy harvesting in wireless sensor networks is attractive for the continuous operation of the network, but poses new challenges for collaborative target tracking due to the limited energy harvesting capabilities of the nodes. In this paper, we will propose a novel finite-horizon adaptive dynamic programming (FHADP) based sensor scheduling for collaborative target tracking in an energy harvesting WSN. Unscented Kalman filter (UKF) is used for prediction and estimation of the tracking performance, and multiple-step sensor scheduling is performed using ADP based on the predictive harvested energy of the nodes and tracking performance. Simulation results show that FHADP based sensor scheduling scheme can obtain superior tracking performance compared with ADP.

articleTitle: Shared bicycle dynamic distribution model based on Boosting algorithm
abstract: The number of shared bicycles is large and the parking is not standardized. Accurate position prediction of the bicycle can effectively prevent the collision between the number of vehicles and the parking position. The traditional machine learning algorithm is slowly to process and can not meet the accuracy requirements. Therefore, the Boosting algorithm which promote the weak learner to a strong learner is adopted to enhance running speed and accuracy. At the same time, the way of constructing feature groups is proposed, and the importance of features is evaluated. The comparison experiment compares the prediction capabilities of the three Boosting algorithms, XGboost, LightGBM and Catboost. The example verification shows that the LightGBM algorithm has the highest test accuracy, and then this algorithm is used to predict the dynamic distribution of the Mobike in Beijing throughout the day. And show the heat distribution map of the prediction results of Mobike in different time periods.

articleTitle: Design and Research on Supersonic Film Pressure Control System Based on Fuzzy PID Control
abstract: The aerothermal environment of a hypersonic flight vehicle can distort the infrared signal of the optical window, which under extreme conditions could even be ablated. Therefore, a cooling system is necessary to be utilized to protect the optical window, and meanwhile optimize the optical quality passing through the window. In this paper, a supersonic film cooling pressure control system based on fuzzy PID control is designed to achieve this goal. The system can form a static pressure matching supersonic low temperature cooling film between the external high temperature flow and the optical window, which isolates the heating effect of the flow to satisfy the requirements of the infrared imaging. The simulation of this system verifies the effectiveness of the fuzzy PID control method.

articleTitle: Quadrilateral Weighted Localization for Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Bayesian Filtering
abstract: In this paper, an improved weighted centroid location algorithm for quadrilateral ranging based on received signal strength indication (RSSI) is used to reduce the measurement error of RSSI effectively. Furthermore, this paper puts forward the localization algorithm of indoor optimization RSSI based on Bayesian probability model and combines the least squares curve fitting to estimate the location of unknown nodes, which further improves the accuracy of the algorithm. In addition, the simulation results show that the improved centroid localization algorithm not only improves the accuracy greatly, and the robustness is also relatively high.

articleTitle: Uniformly Quantized ILC with Encoding and Decoding Mechanism under Random Data Dropouts
abstract: In this paper, iterative learning control is applied to linear systems with limited capable channels that the data should be quantized before transmission and data dropouts arise randomly. To ensure a zero-error tracking performance, we add an encoding and decoding mechanism to the system. In particular, the system output is first encoded and transformed. Then, the received information is decoded and used in the learning algorithm to generate input signals for the next iteration. The convergence of the proposed scheme is proved under the circumstances of random data dropouts. An illustrative example is presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of this scheme.

articleTitle: Line-of-Sight Rate Estimation Based on Attitude Dynamics for Strap-down Seeker
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the strap-down seeker can not directly get the guidance information such as line-of-sight (LOS) angular rate, a novel LOS angular rate estimation algorithm based on attitude dynamics is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the LOS decoupling formula is derived based on the relationship of coordinate transformation. Then the state equation and observation equation are established by employing the attitude dynamics. Finally, the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) is utilized to estimate the LOS angular rate. Compared with the algorithm without using the attitude dynamics, simulation results imply that the estimation error of LOS elevation angle and azimuth angle is reduced to 74.8% and 75.8%, respectively, while the estimation error of LOS elevation angular rate and azimuth angular rate is reduced to 92% and 94%, respectively, which prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Expectation Minimax Algorithm for the Two-Player Military Chess Game
abstract: The two-player military chess is a typical incomplete information computer game. This paper proposes an expectation minimax algorithm for the two-player military chess. The principle structure of expectation minimax algorithm is given based on the traditional model, a chessman's priority probability evaluation algorithm and a situation evaluation function for two-player military chess game are used for the implementation of the two-payer military chess game. Experiments show that the proposed expectation minimax algorithm is verified effective which can improve the performance of two-payer military chess game.

articleTitle: Sliding mode Control for Quad-rotor Based on Super-twisting Algorithm Disturbance Observation and Compensation
abstract: To solve the problem that quad-rotor is easy to be disturbed by external disturbances during flight because it is small in size and light in weight, a sliding mode control with sliding mode observation compensation based on super twisting algorithm is proposed to enhance the anti-disturbance ability of the controller. The controller makes the sliding mode control curve smoother and weaken the chattering phenomenon of the normal sliding mode control. Simulation and experimental results show that the above method can control the performance better.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network Global Sliding Mode Control Based on Fractional-order for Active Power Filter
abstract: In this study, a recurrent neural network global sliding mode control scheme based on fractional-order (RNNFGSMC) is introduced to achieve better performance for a three-phase active power filter (APF). The proposed RNNFGSMC scheme combines a fractional-order control method, a global sliding mode control method and a recurrent neural network structure. The primary objective of the proposed RNNFGSMC scheme is to construct a fractional-order global sliding mode controller. The RNN estimator is employed to approximate the unknown nonlinear function of the APF online. Simulation results are presented to show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: The Design of Integrated Guidance and Control Law Considering Rudder Angle Saturation
abstract: The hypersonic vehicle doesn't satisfy separation design condition of guidance and control law in the terminal guidance process. Moreover, the rudder angle of system is easy to be long time saturated because the state of guidance and control system changes rapidly. If the guidance and control law is designed without considering above two points, the closed-loop system performance will be influenced and the system may be instability. So, an integrated guidance and control law is designed with considering rudder saturation in this paper. Taking the anti-saturation control method into the integrated design of guidance and control law, an anti-saturation compensator is designed to compensate the state changes caused by input bias. The integrated guidance and control law with rudder saturation is deduced and the closed-loop system's stabilization is proved. The numerical simulation shows that the closed-loop system has better performance when the designed anti-saturated guidance and control law is used. It has shorter saturation time and higher control efficiency than traditional guidance and control law.

Author Keywords: Design of integrated guidance and control law

articleTitle: Household User Behavior Analysis based on Power Data
abstract: With the popularization of smart grid application and the rapid development of big data technology, a large amount of user power consumption data is recorded and stored, making user power consumption behavior analysis the key content of demand side management. The user behavior state is identified by the variation of power amplitude of power load based on hidden Markov model. Users are mapped to potential feature space by means of price elasticity information regularization matrix decomposition. Further, K-means clustering algorithm is adopted to segment users. The strategy can improve the rationality of user power consumption behavior clustering, more effectively grasp the form of user power consumption load, reduce the peak load of power and balance power supply and demand, which is of great significance to the demand side management of smart grid.

articleTitle: Brand Satisfaction Analysis of New Retail Catering Industry Based on Brand Experience
abstract: Traditional rational consumption is gradually replaced by the Omni-directional experience model in the new retail Era. Brand experience is the integration of brand and experience. Good brand experience can enhance customer brand satisfaction and create value for customers and enterprises. This paper takes the new retail catering industry as the research object to explore the impact of brand experience on brand satisfaction and to propose corresponding brand satisfaction strategies from five dimensions: sensory experience, emotional experience, thinking experience, action experience and associated experience.

articleTitle: SSIM-based Weak Zero-forcing Precoder Design for Multiuser MIMO System
abstract: The optimization of zero-forcing precoders is studied for the structural similarity (SSIM) index in this paper. When the input signal is an image for the multi-user multi-input multi-output (MIMO) downlink communication channels, the traditional precoders design with maximizing signal to noise ratio(SNR) or mean squared error(MSE) may not retain the structural information of transmitted signal. In this paper, we consider the problem of linear precoding design with SSIM index under the weak zero-forcing condition. A general solution for zero-forcing precoder is provided to guarantee the quality of the received image, under total power constraint or per-antenna power constraint. The precoder design with SSIM is a non-convex problem. We use the polynomial fitting method to convert it into convex problem, and then use the convex optimization toolbox to solve it. Experiment results have shown the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed precoder.

articleTitle: The Complementary Effect of Commercial Credit on Bank Credit Based on Panel Data Model: From the Perspective of Supply Chain Finance
abstract: Unlike traditional bank credit, commercial credit can not only optimize capital flow, but also affect the time interval in supply chain. In order to test the relationship between different financing modes of SMEs in supply chain. This paper takes the SMEs as research samples, from the perspective of supply chain, to test the relationship between commercial credit and bank credit. We find that the commercial credit can supplement bank credit. From the perspective of supply chain, we also validate the impact of supply chain concentration on the complementary relationship between commercial credit and bank credit. By building panel data model, we find that supplier concentration weakens the complementary relationship between commercial credit and bank credit, while customer concentration will promote the complementary relationship between commercial credit and bank credit.

articleTitle: Design of Amazon Chess Evaluation Function Based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: The computer chess is an important research direction of artificial intelligence. Amazon chess game is an extremely complicated strategy game and the search algorithm relies heavily on the evaluation function. The design of evaluation function faces great challenges. This process requires a comprehensive consideration of the characteristics of the board and build up a series of complex formulas, which requires a lot of human experience to support. The author tries to apply the reinforcement learning method to the design process of Game of the Amazons evaluation function. Using the self-game generated data sets and reward signals to stimulates network, it could learn how to evaluate the situation of chess board without human experience. Then this neural network can be used as an evaluation function. Finally, through battling with the game of Amazon chess game using traditional evaluation function, it is verified that the evaluation function design method proposed in this paper can reduce the human experience requirement in the design process of Game of the Amazons evaluation function and effectively evaluate the situation.

articleTitle: Finite-Time H∞ Analysis and Application on the Design of Sliding Mode and Consensus Protocol of Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: This paper focuses on the finite-time H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> property and its applications on the finite-time sliding mode and consensus of linear multi-agent systems. Finite-time H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> property this paper concerns means that the closed-loop system can achieve convergence or consensus in finite time without disturbance, and on the other hand, satisfy H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> property with bounded disturbance. Through the linear matrix inequality (LMI) method, the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> property in the framework of finite-time sliding mode with bounded disturbance is satisfied. What is more, the protocol is proposed to achieve finite-time H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> consensus for linear multi-agent systems with undirected networks, subject to bounded disturbance. The simulation result also shows the satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Heating Temperature Control System Based on LADRC
abstract: Electromagnetic heating technology, or induction heating technology, is an important application of ferrari electromagnetic induction technology, which is a process of energy conversion from electrical energy to thermal energy using the principle of electromagnetic induction. Compared with traditional heating technology, electromagnetic heating has high energy efficiency, high safety, energy saving and environmental protection. Aiming at the problem that the temperature control accuracy of electromagnetic heating equipment in the current market is not high, LADRC control method is applied to the system in this paper to overcome the deficiency of the original algorithm. In the Matlab/Simulink environment, the traditional PID and LADRC are simulated and studied. The research shows that LADRC control makes the system overshoot smaller, the adjustment time is shorter, the control precision is high and the system is more stable.

articleTitle: Research on EMC Improvement of Digital-display Joystick
abstract: The general structure of the digital display joystick and the EMC radiation test requirements specified by GJB151B-2013 are introduced in this paper, the disturbance source and over-limits principle of electromagnetic mission are analyzed. Based on the analysis of the products, the general methods for improving the radiation disturbance of RE102 are summarized, and the effectiveness of the rectification method is proved by experiments. This paper provides an application for the EMC design of products, which also has a certain engineering significance of solving EMC problem.

articleTitle: Research on Self-adaptive Fuzzy Speed Control Strategy of Brushless DC Motor for Stronger Robustness
abstract: The Brushless DC Motor (BLDCM) control system is non-linear, multivariable, tightly coupled. Via analyzing the operational principle and mathematical model of the BLDCM, a double closed-loop servo control system is established in Matlab/Simulink environment. However, the traditional PI controller is usually adopted in current and speed loop, thus resulting in shortcomings of setting parameter difficultly, large overshoots, etc. Therefore, a self-adaptive fuzzy PI control scheme is proposed in speed loop to overcome these shortcomings. Then, several simulation experiments are conducted to verify validity, feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy. Finally, the simulation experiment results show that the improved scheme had faster dynamic response and anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Decentralized Robot Network Coordination
abstract: Synchronization and desynchronization in networks is a highly studied topic in many electrical systems, but there is a distinct lack of research on this topic with respect to robotics. Creating an effective decentralized synchronization algorithm for a robotic network would allow multiple robots to work together to achieve a task and would be able to adapt to the addition or loss of robots in real-time. The purpose of this study is to improve algorithms developed by the authors for this purpose and experimentally evaluate these methods. The most effective algorithm for synchronization and desynchronization found in a former study were modified to improve testing and vary its methods of calculation. A multi-robot platform composed of multiple Roomba robots was used in the experimental study. Observation of data showed how adjusting parameters of the algorithms affected both the time to reach a desired state of synchronization or desynchronization and how the network maintained this state. Testing three different methods on each algorithm showed differing results. Future work in cooperative robotics will likely see success using these algorithms to accomplish a variety of tasks.

articleTitle: Designing and Implementing a Model for a Semi-autonomous Blind-guiding System
abstract: At present, the technology of blind guiding systems has occurred polarizations. On the one hand, traditional blind canes have gradually failed to meet the needs of the blinds; on the other hand, blind guiding equipment based on deep learning and vision algorithms is in the ascendant, however with their technical difficulties and high price, they are hard to put into use in a short period of time. Therefore, there is an urgent need for a transition product. This paper will propose a semi-autonomous blind-guiding cane based on the technology in robot controlling field. The paper will introduce the electromechanical system of the cane, the PMSM driving algorithm, how the ultrasonic sensor acquires the information, and how to use the information for obstacle-avoidance path planning. In this paper, a guiding model will be established based on the STM32L4 microcontroller, and the effects of its implementation will be displayed.

articleTitle: Applications of Time-Series Hesitation Fuzzy Soft Sets in Group Decision Making
abstract: Time-series hesitation fuzzy soft sets had been fully applied to decision making problems. In the decision-making with time change, the growth trend was more important than the initial amount. The trend increment method could only consider the data of the time slice closest to the current time segment, and could not consider more historical data. The time weight method couldn't reflect the increase or decrease of each time period. This paper proposed a new decision-making method for processing time-series hesitation fuzzy soft sets. Therefore, the time-weighted trend increment method proposed in this paper avoided these shortcomings. This method can show the importance of the increase and decrease, while taking into account the impact of time attributes on decision making. And it was applied in group decision making, and the practicability of the method was verified by an example.

articleTitle: Relative Pose Estimation Method for Unmanned Helicopter Landing Based on Vision
abstract: In the process of unmanned helicopter landing based on vision, a new pose estimation algorithm based on orthogonal iteration was proposed to solve the problem of relative pose estimation by selecting the angular feature of the landing image. Aiming at the requirements of accuracy, robustness and efficiency of pose estimation results, the objective space error was used as the error function. The initial value of iteration which affected the orthogonal iteration algorithm greatly was given based on the perspective projection model. Compared with the initial value which was random given, the number of iterations was reduced and the convergence speed was improved. The optimal value of spatial collinearity error was solved by absolute orientation method in the iterative process. The simulation results showed that the method has a good real-time performance, high precision and global convergence.

articleTitle: Formation Deployment of Cooperative Source Seeking by Multiple Robots: Algorithms and Experiments
abstract: In order to deploy multi-robot into a 2-D desired formation during the seeking process, this paper proposes a hybrid seeking algorithm with the formation deployment. Firstly, a reaction-advection-diffusion equation is quoted to describe the movement of multiple mobile robots, 1-D formation deployment algorithm is introduced and expended to 2-D application. And then combines with the extreme seeking algorithm to obtain the hybrid seeking algorithm. Based on the improved extremum seeking algorithm and the 2-D formation deployment algorithm, a multi-robot hybrid seeking algorithm with formation deployment is proposed. To simplify other robots' following, a virtual trajectory of the leader robot is obtained according to its searching features. The robots' behavior is decomposed into searching behavior and formation deployment behavior. The condition and the method of changing these behaviors' weights online are provided. With the algorithm, multi-robot can deploy into a desired 2-D formation during seeking procesśSimulation results with different initial positions and different platforms are analyzed to verify the convergence of the multi-robot's hybrid seeking algorithm, and the convergence is independent of the multi-robot's initial positions.

articleTitle: A Game Model based Distributed Power Dispatch for Wind Generators in Wind Farm with Variable Communication
abstract: The optimal operation of wind generations(WGs) are generally posed great challenge because of the wake effect in wind farm, especially for wind farm with unreliable and variable communication conditions. In order to regulate the power output of multiple WGs in an efficient way, a game theory based distributed power dispatch method is investigated. The power flow within wind farm can be regulated by coordinating the power production of WGs, which are modeled as players in game environment. In addition, the unpredictable and intermittent information exchange among WGs, which may be caused by unreliable communication in wind farm, will be modeled by matrix theory and, the developed game model is to ensure a group of mutually affected but self-interested WGs converge and operate at the desired equilibrium, i.e. the same utilization level of available power output for each WG. It is noted that the proposed method only requires local and intermittent information from neighboring WGs, and the minimum information requirement on communication topologies is also discussed. Moreover, the proposed method will accommodate the changing information topologies among WGs and ensure WGs operating at the desired operation point of the designed game. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Research on Marine Refrigeration Simulation and Its Application
abstract: A marine refrigeration simulation and training system is studied and developed in this paper. The mathematical model and two-dimensional visual simulation interface of the system are developed by using MCF of VC++. The three-dimensional physical models of the system are established based on 3ds Max and the optimized models are imported into the OGRE scene engine to realize synchronous rendering. Finally, the simulation results show that the three-dimensional virtual roaming and interactive function of the marine refrigeration simulation and training system are realized, which can be used for targeted learning and training of marine refrigeration system for crew.

articleTitle: Command Behavior Evaluation Based on Statistical Learning Modeling
abstract: According to the characteristics of command behavior, a command behavior evaluation model based on statistical learning modeling is established, and Gaussian process prediction method is used to evaluate the command behavior. Compared with machine learning methods such as neural network and Support Vector Machine, the output results of Gaussian process have probability meanings and can evaluate the validity and confidence of the predicted results. The algorithm is proved to be effective by comparing it with Support Vector Machine (SVM).

articleTitle: Design of Stereo Bicycle Library System Based on STM32
abstract: With the rapid development of shared bicycles, large-scale bicycles have flooded into the streets, traditional parking racks have been unable to meet the demand, and stereo garages have become more and more widely used. The intelligent of the three-dimensional garage puts forward higher requirements on the computing power and logic processing capability of the microprocessor of its control system. By analyzing the characteristics and structural characteristics of the lifting and traversing mechanism, this paper designs a stereo bicycle library system based on STM32. Through the STM32 main control chip and RFID high-frequency reader module and corresponding hardware structure, the bicycle garage smart card access function is realized; Through the touch screen and the voice module, the user is prompted to use the password or swipe to access the vehicle, and the garage storage vehicle is displayed in real time, so that the user can conveniently and quickly access the vehicle through various ways under the voice prompt. The system can stably and efficiently control the normal operation of the stereo garage, and has the characteristics of space saving, low cost and convenient operation.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Customer Routing Problem Considering Delivery Effectiveness
abstract: Unpunctual delivery is a common problem in the execution of customer orders in the e-commerce of B2C. To address the challenge of logistic routing decision in e-commerce business, this paper studies a customer routing problem considering delivery effectiveness (CRPDE). Firstly, the concerned optimization problem is formulated as a 0-1 integer programming model to find a routing plan minimizing the operational costs, subject to constraints of transportation capacity, departure time and due date. Second, the proposed model is solved by using CPLEX. Finally, computational experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model. The results indicate that the tighter slackness on the customer due dates may incur extra transportation costs, and reasonable departure waves will significantly reduce the costs.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Distributed Adaptive Guidance Laws for Simultaneous Attack
abstract: In this paper, a distributed adaptive guidance law for multiple missiles simultaneous attack problem is investigated. The new guidance law consists of two parts. The first part focuses on consensus achieving of the system states, and the second part optimizes the objective function to get the optimal value. Adaptive parameters consisting of local state errors terms are utilized in the first part of the guidance law, while the first derivative terms, partial derivative terms and second derivative terms of the objective function are employed in the second part of the guidance law. The simulation results validated the practicability of the proposed improved guidance law.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Fixed-Time Nonsingular Sliding Mode Control of a Fractional Hydro-Turbine Governing System
abstract: The fixed-time nonsingular sliding mode control of fractional-order hydro-turbine governing system (HTGS) is studied. First, a fractional-order HTGS model with better stability is presented. Next, it is found that the system has chaotic oscillation by dynamics analysis and numerical simulation. Then, a novel fractional order terminal sliding mode control method is applied to guarantee the fixed-time convergence of HTGS states. Moreover, there is no chattering phenomenon on the control curve and the sliding surface. Furthermore, the fixed-time stability and the robustness of the control scheme are proved using the fractional Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the control method in this paper.

Author Keywords: Fixed-time control and Nonsingular sliding mode

articleTitle: Solving Nash Equilibrium for Non-cooperative Game Based on the Particle Swarm Optimization Integrating Multiply Strategies
abstract: In order to solve Nash equilibrium problem of n-person finite non-cooperative game, this paper involved adaptive adjustment of inertia weight, dynamic reverse learning and local mutation search strategy into the basic particle swarm optimization (PSO), and proposed a particle swarm optimization integrating multiply strategies algorithm(IMSPSO). This algorithm introduces the state information of individual particles into the inertial weight strategy, independently adjusts the inertial weight of each particle, and reflects the difference of individual particles' weight requirements. When the algorithm is detected to be in the local optimum, a dynamic reverse learning strategy is introduced to expand the search area and enhance the algorithm's global exploration ability. At the same time, the small-scale mutation search operation of individual local neighborhood is used to guide the local learning and search of particles, so as to enhance the mining ability of particles in local space. The algorithm is used to solve two Nash equilibrium problems of non-cooperative games. The experimental results show that the algorithm can achieve good results and its performance is better than the basic particle swarm optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Landing Path Planning for General Aircraft Based on Legendre Pseudo Spectral Method
abstract: The emphasis of this paper is to propose a method based on Legendre pseudo spectral method to solve the optimal landing path planning problem for navigable aircraft. By establishing the mathematical model of the aircraft, the mathematical model of the aircraft is decomposed into transverse and longitudinal dynamic equations, and the flight restriction is set for the longitudinal motion law of the aircraft and the characteristics of the aircraft in combination with the actual situation. By using the pseudo-spectral method of Legendre pseudo-spectral method, OCP is transformed into NLP through global interpolation polynomial discrete state variables and control variables, and the solution process is solved by using MATLAB/TOMLAB toolbox. The simulation results show that the application of NLP solution to flight path planning by Legendre pseudo spectral method is feasible and meets the control constraints in flight process.

articleTitle: Intelligent Space-Based Radio Telescope and Communication System
abstract: In order to improve the resolution and sensitivity of present radio telescopes, an advanced system based on the distributed cooperative control is proposed here. As a space-based communication station, the system deployed in GEO is consisted of a feed source satellite, a central satellite and 4450 unit satellites in the form of precise and independent assembling. The central satellite can manage the system and diagnose the dysfunctions automatically, therefore keep the entire satellite group running correctly. Without the interference from atmosphere, cloud and ground electromagnetic wave, the system proposed can raise the quality of resolution and sensitivity by 1-2 order and greatly improve the available distance of deep-space detection and the rate of data communication.

articleTitle: Design and Control of Movable Cement 3D Printing System
abstract: This paper briefly describes the design and control method of a movable cement 3D printing system, which is composed of a mobile platform, a printing arm fixed on the platform and a cement conveying system. Compared with the traditional gantry 3D printer for buildings, this system has the characteristics of wide printing range and flexible use of equipment. Considering the structure characteristics of the equipment, the fuzzy PID control mode is adopted to realize the coordination of each subsystem and realize the high-precision printing of the product.

articleTitle: Design of A Completely Decoupled 3-Degree-of-Freedom Micromachined Vibratory Gyroscope
abstract: This paper presents a novel 3-degree-of-freedom (DOF) micromachined vibratory gyroscope with completely decoupled structural design. A single-DOF drive mode and a complete 2-DOF vibratory structure, including proof mass, proof frame and detection mass, are applied in designed structure. The drive mode and sense mode are linked by proof mass and proof frame, which also isolate driving element (driving frame) and sensing element(detection mass) to achieve structural decouple. Meanwhile, the 2-DOF sense mode could provide a flat region between two resonant frequencies, which improves the robustness of micromachined vibratory gyroscope. The finite element analysis(FEA) illustrated the resonant frequency of drive mode is between two resonant frequencies of sense mode, showing the feasibility of the proposed gyroscope structure. The simulation results demonstrated a 3-dB bandwidth of 400Hz from 4.8 kHz to 5.2 kHz in sense mode, which improves the inherent robustness to structural parameters and environmental variations. In addition, the structure decoupling is verified through the simulation and the driving elements and sensing elements are immune to vibration of sense mode and drive mode respectively.

articleTitle: Research of Fuzzy Control System Simulation Based on Internet
abstract: In this paper, JSP/javascript is used. By using it, the communication between the client and matlab simulation Server can be realized. From this we can realize the platform of fuzzy control system simulation on Internet. Then fuzzy control system simulation on Internet can be realized on this platform. In this article, the way of relative analysis is used to design the fuzzy controller and put it into the platform so that we can realize the fuzzy control system simulation on Internet. The fuzzy control system simulation on Internet is easy to realize. It can also be used easily. With the development of scientific technology and the process of the Internet globalization, fuzzy control system simulation on Internet will be widely used in industry and scientific research project.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Aircraft Post-Stall Turning Maneuver Operation Command
abstract: To provide the pilots with a practical reference for the aircraft post-stall turning maneuver flight, the optimization of discrete operation commands forwarded to the aircraft in the three-dimensional post-stall turning maneuver is studied. The aircraft time-optimal turning maneuver trajectory optimization model that considers various path constraints is developed. A practical discrete command sequence model is proposed and it parameterizes the controls piecewise in constant parameters. With the Radau Pseudo-spectral (PS) knotting method, the optimal operation commands for the post-stall turning maneuver are obtained and the dynamic motion of the aircraft is investigated. These results are verified by the feasibility simulation and the optimality condition. From this study, it is shown that the Angle-of-attack (AoA) and thrust utilizing a three-phase structure and the velocity bank angle rate utilizing a four-phase structure may well perform the aircraft post-stall turning maneuver.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis in Unknown Discrete Event Systems via Critical Tree
abstract: In this paper, we propose an approach based on the critical tree to solve the fault diagnosis problem under the circumstances that the system model is unknown but its previous running-logs are available. First of all, we introduce the critical tree and explain its structure in detail. Secondly, we present the construction algorithm of the critical tree, and prove that it has a polynomial-time complexity both over time and space. Moreover, we show how to use the critical tree to diagnose the faults of the system. Finally, a comparative experiment is performed, and the results show that our approach has advantages both in efficiency and accuracy over Christopher's approach.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling and identification of electric power plant on agile UAVs
abstract: The dynamic mathematical model of electric power plant is critical for accurate thrust controlling and online troubleshooting. A practical method of dynamic modeling and identification is proposed. In consideration of agile UAVs’ typical flight modes, the electric power plant was modeled by component characteristics based deduction, which shows to be a nonlinear differential system formed by a linear term and a nonlinear term. Firstly by avoiding the nonlinear term from aerodynamics, the propeller was replaced by a specialized disc-shaped coder with equivalent inertial of moment, and the linear parameters were identified directly through output response. Afterwards, the nonlinear parameter was identified by static in-and output signals. Finally the method of dynamic modeling and identification is proved to be effective on a ground test unit.

Author Keywords: equivalent replacement on inertial of moment

articleTitle: A KCF-Based Tracker with Faster Scale Estimation and Effective Occlusion Detection
abstract: In visual object tracking, designing a robust and fast tracking algorithm is always a challenging task. KCF is exactly one of those trackers which have fast computational speed and well tracking accuracy. However, when the object's scale variates, the tracking accuracy of KCF will greatly decrease due to the lack of scale estimation approach. For this reason, DSST has proposed a KCF-based robust scale estimation approach to tackle the problem of scale variation. But in order to meet the need of practical application, computational efficiency is always the highest priority of a tracking algorithm. Besides, partial occlusion often happens in an object tracking mission and significantly affect the tracking performances in the real situations. In this paper, an approach that estimate the scale variation faster is proposed based on KCF and DSST. Meanwhile, an approach which is designed for effective occlusion detection is also proposed, which improves the tracking accuracy of KCF in the situations of object occlusion. Finally, the improved tracker based on KCF and DSST has about 7% increase on tracking accuracy and perform faster in most cases. It turns out that the proposed approaches perform better on scale estimation and occlusion detection in the real situations.

articleTitle: Path Tracking Control of Mobile Robot Based on the Motion Compensation Method
abstract: The path tracking control system is a multi-constraint system, and traditional control methods are easy to cause problems such as actuator saturation. This paper introduces the model predictive control method to solve the path tracking problem of mobile robots. Aiming at the problem that the model predictive control method leads to control hysteresis due to the long calculation period, the motion compensation method proposed to improve the accuracy and control stability of the path tracking of mobile robots. Simulation results show that the model predictive control method can solve the multi-constrained system path tracking problem; the improved controller's maximum displacement error is reduced by 27.59% compared with the original controller, and the maximum heading angle error is reduced by 83.14%, which proves the improved controller has better control performance.

Author Keywords: model predictive control and motion compensation method

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of An SIQ Model in Networks
abstract: We analyzed a discrete-time SIQ virus propagation system, which represents the computer virus propagation model in network. Firstly, we derive two kinds of equilibriums for the model. Secondly, we obtain sufficient stability conditions for the free-disease equilibrium using the first Lyapunov stability method. Lastly, we obtain stability conditions for the disease equilibrium using disc theory.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Cruise Control of Heterogeneous Vehicle Systems
abstract: In this paper, a new robust model predictive control (MPC) approach is proposed for Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control (CACC) of heterogeneous connected vehicle systems. Firstly, considering the limited range of vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication, a new state space model of CACC heterogeneous vehicle system is established, which includes uncertainties, input constraints, and time-varying delays. Then, a robust model predictive cruise controller is designed based on an optimization with linear matrix inequality (LMI), and the stability of the closed-loop system is analyzed by using the Lyapunov-Krasovskii approach. The simulation result shows that the proposed controller has good performance.

articleTitle: A novel Image Fusion Framework based on Non-Subsampled Shearlet Transform (NSST) Domain
abstract: As an effective means to integrate the information contained in multiple images in different ways, multi-model image fusion provides more comprehensive and sophisticated information for modern medical diagnosis, remote sensing, video surveillance and other fields. Based on non-subsampled shearlet transform (NSST) domain, this paper proposed an general image fusion framework to well preserve image energy and detail. It can well solve the problem of limited direction in image decomposition. This fusion method applies NSST to decomposition source images into high-pass and low-pass subbands. Sum Modified-laplacian(SML) is employed to fused high-pass bands. A weighted sum of weighted local energy (WLE) and a modified Laplacian (WSEML) based on eight neighborhoods are used as a fusion strategy to fuse low-frequency components. Finally, employing NSST inverse transform to reconstruct the fused high frequency and low frequency components. The experimental results indicate that the framework can save more image details and improve the quality of fused images.

articleTitle: Design of LPV Control System Based on Intelligent Optimization
abstract: Aiming at the flight control system with typical nonlinear time-varying characteristics, a design method of Linear Parameter Varying (LPV) control system based on intelligent optimization is proposed. Through the intelligent optimization method, a constant PID robust controller is sought to control the slowly varying time-varying system model with the largest possible operating range, which makes the system robust with both global stability. Firstly, based on the kinematics modeling of the aircraft, the LPV description is carried out. Then the PID controller is designed for the three channels of the aircraft, and the parameters of the PID controller are optimized by the fireworks algorithm. Finally, the stability of the system is proved by Kharitonov theorem. The performance robustness of the system was verified by applying random variation within ±10% to the static gain of the system with the original controller parameters unchanged. Compared with the traditional gain scheduling control (GSC) method, this method adopted the idea of intelligent optimization, used a constant PID robust controller to control the time-varying system model, the design process is simple. Secondly, the global stability can be proved. On the basis of ensuring the global stability, the system has both performance robustness. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the design method.

Author Keywords: guidance and control of aircraft navigation

articleTitle: Multi-criteria project selection using fuzzy preference relations based AHP and TOPSIS
abstract: Project selection is a strategic problem and can be a critical factor to the outcome of project management. Meanwhile, it is often a multiple criteria decision making (MCDM) problem with so many factors to be considered simultaneously. Further, the experts in the field must make judgments on a given set of alternatives based on conflicting criteria, and it is often hard for them to assign crisp judgments in most situations. To solve this problem, a hybrid approach based on fuzzy analytical hierarchy process (AHP) which uses fuzzy preference relations and fuzzy technique for order performance by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) to rank different alternatives is proposed. The fuzzy AHP is used to analyze the problem and meanwhile to determine the criteria weights. Fuzzy TOPSIS is applied in ranking all the given set of alternatives and determining the most appropriate one. The hybrid approach can help provide suggestions under conditions of incomplete information. An illustrative example on project selection is studied to verify the effectiveness of the foregoing proposed approach. Moreover, comparable results show that the calculation of the criteria weights can influence the ranking orders. The application could provide us more insight into the project selection process.

articleTitle: LADRC based TEC Temperature Control System
abstract: Thermoelectric cooler (TEC) is widely applied in temperature control areas. Traditional PID based temperature controller cannot reach a stable operation status. In this paper, a LADRC based TEC temperature control system is designed. Comparing with the PID based control process, the LADRC based one has a significant better dynamic tracking capacity to the external and internal disturbances. Moreover, since LADRC algorithm ignores the complex thermal conduction process of the system, the LADRC based control has a potential applicability in practical applications.

articleTitle: Optimization of the randomness in Einstein which based on Monte Carlo Algorithms
abstract: As an incomplete information game, Einstein's unique process of rolling the dice brings great randomness. The randomness of its chess moving makes it difficult to apply direct reference to other relatively mature chess algorithms. With the accumulation and development of competition, the existing Einstein program has already had preliminary intelligence. The existing Einstein algorithm is mainly based on Minimax algorithm with static evaluation and Monte Carlo with pruning algorithm. However, its large randomness and limitation of pruning constrain improving. This paper which based on Monte Carlo analyses the evaluation and its corresponding simulation. From the perspective of the data, we can explore the advantages and disadvantages of Monte Carlo and improve the algorithm to judge the current situation and choose the best move, so that providing different ideas of pruning to optimize Monte Carlo program.

articleTitle: Prediction of NOx Generation Process Based on A Nonlinear MA model
abstract: In the process of a thermal power generation, the prediction of the amount of NOx in contaminant has a positive effect on the elimination of NOx. In this paper, the nonlinear moving average (MA) model with time-delays is used as the prediction model to predict the process of NOx generation. Firstly, the correlation coefficient method is used to divide all variables affecting the NOx generation into several categories, and the variable whose correlation coefficient with NOx is the biggest in each category is selected as a main variable. Then BP neural network method is used to select the three variables with the greatest influence among the main variables as the input variables in the prediction model. Next, the correlation coefficient method is used to determine the time-delay parameters of the three input variables in the prediction model. What's more, the least square method is used to estimate other parameters of the MA model to obtain a prediction model of a NOx generation process. Finally, the practical data from the generation process of a power plant are used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed prediction method.

articleTitle: Distributed consensus protocol for general third-order multi-agent systems with communication delay
abstract: This paper investigates consensus problem of a class of general third-order multi-agent systems with communication delay. Firstly, we proposed a more practical third-order model. Then we designed a appropriate control algorithm of each agent according to its states and those of its neighbor agents. In addition, based on matrix theory and Gerschgorin Disc Theorem, we show that the control protocol with communication delay is sufficient and necessary for directed topology. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the theoretical are tested by numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: Kinematic Optimization of Redundant Manipulators to Improve the Fault-Tolerant Control
abstract: To improve the fault-tolerant control of redundant manipulators, a kinematic optimization algorithm is proposed with an index based on reduced manipulability. Firstly, augmented Jacobian is derived with an arm angle to solve the inverse kinematics of redundant manipulator. The arm angle is defined to parameterize the redundancy of redundant manipulators. By changing the arm angle, different inverse kinematic solutions are obtained without changing the end-effector position and it is called "self-motion". The self-motion is used for kinematic optimization. The reduced manipulability is relative to kinematic solutions. With different arm angle, the reduced manipulability is different. Thus, the kinematic optimization is accomplished to maximize the reduced manipulability by choosing the proper arm angle. The kinematic optimization algorithm is verified with Yaskawa VA1400II manipulator. The results of simulations and experiment strongly prove the validity and efficiency of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Parallel Computing of PVS Algorithm Based on Amazon Human-Machine Game
abstract: Because Amazon chess is very complicated, so it is very suitable for the study of machine games. For the Amazon chess human-machine game system, incorporating transposition tables and historical heuristics based on traditional PVS algorithms, optimized the traditional PVS algorithm, improve its pruning efficiency. After that, using the OpenMP standard, parallel design of the above game algorithm. Through experiments, Parallel computing greatly increases CPU utilization, effectively improve the efficiency of the PVS algorithm, enable the algorithm to search for deeper layers at the same time, thus a substantial increase in playing strength.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzing Test Case Generation Method Based on Gaussian Mixture Model
abstract: Using fuzzing test technology to mine vulnerabilities in industrial control networks is one of the important means to ensure the safety of industrial control networks. It is the key for fuzzing test to generate appropriate test case. The traditional fuzzing test framework based on vulnerability library requires a lot of manual participation with low level of automation. In this paper, a fuzzing test case generation method based on Gaussian mixture model is proposed. By learning the characteristics of exception data, the method mixes multiple Gaussian distributions to approximate the actual complex probability distribution function of exception data and uses random sampling to generate new test case. This method can generate data that meets the characteristics of exception data, and the automation level is higher. Through the experimental analysis of Modbus/TCP protocol, it is found that the exception data generation rate of this method is higher than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Design of Communication Module of Vehicle Controller Based on ISO26262 Standard
abstract: Aiming at the potential hazards and risks of the current pure electric vehicle controller module, a communication controller module based on ISO26262 is proposed to improve the safety and reliability of the vehicle controller. According to the specifications and requirements in the functional safety standard, this paper evaluates the potential hazards and risks of the CAN communication function of the vehicle controller, determines its functional safety objectives and functional safety requirements, and uses the dual-core principle to design the CAN communication module. The fault injection test is carried out by simulating the communication fault of the whole vehicle controller. It is verified that the CAN communication module of the vehicle controller designed in this paper meets certain functional safety objectives and improves the safety and reliability of the vehicle controller.

articleTitle: On Stability and Stabilization of Continuous-Time Cross-Dimensional Linear Systems
abstract: This paper investigates the stability and stabilization of continuous-time cross-dimensional linear systems (CCDLSs) with dimension-bounded. Firstly, by V-product and V-addition of matrices and vectors, a new approach is proposed for calculating the solution of CCDLSs. Secondly, using this solution, one necessary and sufficient condition is established for determining whether a CCDLS is asymptotically stable with a given initial state, based on which, all initial states that make the CCDLS asymptotically stable can be found. Thirdly, all initial states that can be stabilized are discussed and an algorithm for designing the corresponding controller is given. At last, two examples are given to show the feasibility of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Study on Sliding Mode Control for Anti-Reverse Overshoot of Electronic Throttle Valve
abstract: Aiming at the problems of nonlinear characteristics based on friction and reset spring torque discontinuity of the electronic throttle system and the uncertainties of external disturbance, and combining with Lyapunov’s stability theory, the paper proposes a sliding mode control(SMC) for anti-reverse overshoot of electronic throttle valve based on variable exponential reaching law. Compared with general sliding mode control, the opening control results of the electronic throttle system show that the proposed sliding mode control based on variable exponential reaching law can not only meet the requirements of fast arriving at the expected throttle opening with high precision and effectively reduce reverse overshoot phenomenon generated during the sharp change of working conditions of the electronic throttle system, but also has stronger robustness to external disturbances.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis based on Convolutional Neural Network learning of time-domain vibration signal imaging
abstract: Mechanical fault diagnosis and analysis is of paramount importance to ensure reliable and safe operation of various industrial systems. As the massive field data becomes more available, data-driven fault diagnosis becomes feasible and prevalent. But the traditional methods have its limitations in feature extraction and most related research focus on improving the classification method for higher precision. However the feature information of the time signals is still an important part of the diagnosis which has been neglected. This paper proposed a novel method which makes use of the message in the raw time signals. Firstly, a conversion method is used to convert time signals into two-dimensional images. Then the convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed to extract the features of the 2-D images. Finally, the problem of signal processing is transformed into the problem of image processing. Five typical faults are examined in the experiment using the Case Western Reserve University bearing dataset. The numerical result clearly confirms the effectiveness of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Modeling and Bullwhip Effects Control of Internet+ Supply Chain
abstract: This paper exploits the modeling and bullwhip effect control problem of two-layered supply chain with the impact of internet to flow direction of consumer demand. For uncertainty and randomness of demand is one of the cause of bullwhip effect, this paper aims to give the model of two-layered supply chain with the flow direction of consumer demand suffered the affection of internet, and study the bullwhip effect control problem from the perspective of controlling fluctuation of inventory and derivation of demand order. First, stochastic variable satisfying Bernoulli distribution are introduced to characterize the internet impact to demand, then nominal system is used to deduce the corresponding inventory deviation system, with its bullwhip effect problem formulated as a linear quadratic control problem according to the corresponding inventory deviation system. The supply chain system which highlights the stochastic impact of internet to demand on the bullwhip effect, can he considered as the main contribution of this paper. By separation principle, the feedback controller is given by Riccati equations and classical Kalman filter approach, the impact of internet to bullwhip effect control problem is analyzed. Numerical simulation illustrates the effectiveness of the control law to eliminate the bullwhip effect.

articleTitle: An Automatic Reading Recognition Method for Pointer Spring Tube Pressure Instrument
abstract: In order to realize automatic reading recognition of spring tube pressure gauge pointer instrument, a method based on threshold segmentation, Hough circle detection, morphology and pixel normalization is proposed. Aiming at the special characteristics of this kind of instrument, this method only relies on the image information of the instrument to detect, and the experimental accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Design of a smart socket for smart home energy management systems
abstract: As the world sees a transition away from fossil fuel technologies, there has been a driving market for the safe and smart consumption of electricity. Effective energy usage at the residential side is a huge potential for energy saving and power load balancing. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the Home Energy Management System (HEMS) and a low-cost smart socket for the applications of HEMS. This paper also introduces household electrical devices modelling and HEMS scheduling strategies. Case studies showed a satisfying performance on the real time electricity price prediction and HEMS optimal scheduling models. Finally, the proposed smart socket system was fabricated, and experimental results showed the designed smart socket can be fully utilized for monitoring and controlling home electrical devices.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Reconstruction of Conductivity and Permittivity in Electrical Impedance Tomography
abstract: As a visual detection technology, Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) can reconstruct the distribution of two types of electric property information (conductivity and permittivity) in target region theoretically. This characteristic of EIT can better compensate for the shortcomings of traditional ERT/ECT dual-modal systems. However, as a technology with great development potential, complex-value EIT has not been investigated systematically. This paper introduces how to establish EIT circular field simulation model, and probes into reconstruction methods of dual-modal information preliminarily. By analyzing the experimental results, it is verified that the data processing method that take complex data as a whole can obtain dual-modal information with complementarity. Complex-value EIT technology can improve system resolution and expand system measuring range.

articleTitle: Cooperative Mission Planning for Heterogeneous UAVs with the Improved Multi-objective Quantum-behaved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
abstract: The cooperative operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is the trend of the application of UAVs. Mission planning is the application basis of UAV formation. The appropriate mission planning can fully utilize the technical potential and increase the application effectiveness. Mission planning should consider several criteria, like the completion time, expected benefit, energy consumption or equipment loss. Hence, it should be treated as a Multi-objective Optimization Problem. Aiming to mission characteristics of heterogeneous UAV formation in anti-radar operations, a mission planning model based on multi-objective optimization is proposed. The appropriate collaborative constraint between UAVs and mission execution is established through multi-layer coding and penalty function. The model is solved by an improved Multi-objective Quantum-Behaved Particle Swarm Optimization. The crossover and mutation of Genetic Algorithm are introduced to enhance the diversity of solutions. Finally, the proposed model and algorithm are verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A High Priority Random Task Fuzzy Scheduling Algorithm for CPS
abstract: In the real-time task scheduling of Cyber Physical System (CPS), the existing scheduling algorithms can't effectively differentiate the importance level of random tasks, resulting in poor real-time scheduling of important random tasks and insufficient submission rate. This paper comprehensively considers the factors of recent available time, criticality and execution time, and then proposes a fuzzy scheduling algorithm of high priority random tasks (FSA-HPRT) for CPS. The algorithm first obtains the applicable time slice by maximizing delayed the execution time of the periodic task, and calculates the difference between the end time of the periodic task and the deadline time as the error time slice. Then use the fuzzy set to process the latest available time, criticality and execution time of the random task to decide the random task priority. Finally, the task-scheduling queue is established for the system to perform scheduling according to the priority of the random task by using the applicable time slice and the error time slice. The simulation results show that compared with the ISS algorithm, the proposed algorithm can significantly improve the submission rate of important random tasks. At the same time, high-priority random tasks can get responses preferentially.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Partial Discharge Anti Disturbance System for Switch Cabinet
abstract: In the process of partial discharge detection of high voltage switchgear, the partial discharge detection accuracy of high-voltage switchgear is affected by the external electromagnetic interference in the working field of high voltage switchgear.Research and development of partial discharge anti disturbance system based on switch cabinet,firstly, the causes of four kinds of partial discharge defects in high voltage switchgear and their respective characteristics are analyzed[1][2].Secondly, the advantages, disadvantages and principles of partial discharge defect model detection in switchgear are introduced.Through the experiment of TEV and receiving electromagnetic wave receiver double sensor effectively switch cabinet surface from interference noise and substation switch cabinet on the outer surface of the corona interference based on development[3], realize the effective recognition and separation of switchgear partial discharge and external interference.

articleTitle: Stability in distribution and optimal control in an impulsive toxin input bioeconomic system with stochastic fluctuations and time delays
abstract: In this paper, authors established a hybrid stochastic prey predator bioeconomic system with impulses and stochastic fluctuations. The dynamic effects of commercial harvesting and impulsive toxin input are taken into account. By constructing appropriate functional, the asymptotical stability in distribution in the hybrid stochastic bioeconomic system is investigated. By ergodic and optimal control theorem of stochastic impulsive system, optimal price control strategy and maximum of expectation of sustainable yield are discussed. Numerical simulations are supported to illustrate theoretical findings in this paper.

articleTitle: An ATO Multi-objective Optimization Control Strategy Based on Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the multi-objective optimization of punctuality, precise parking, comfort and energy consumption in the train operation, an ATO control strategy based on genetic algorithm optimization is proposed. Because the train operation process is multi-objective, complex and non-linear, and there are internal contradictions in the evaluation index, there is no optimal control strategy for all indicators. This paper establishes an evaluation index model based on the performance evaluation system of automatic train operation curve. Design an optimization algorithm of velocity-displacement curve (V-S curve) based on genetic algorithm. The algorithm enables the train to automatically give the optimal curve which is most suitable for the given operating environment. While ensuring the safe and smooth operation of the train, it also meets the requirements of punctuality, parking accuracy, energy saving and comfort. The simulation results show that the algorithm is effective, under the designed optimal train operation sequence, the punctuality error is 0 and the position error is 0.09 meters for 33.769 kilometers.

articleTitle: A Neural Conversational Model Using MMI-WMD Decoder Based on the Seq2Seq with Attention Mechanism
abstract: Sequence-to-sequence neural conversational model generates responses tend to be safe and common-place(e.g., I don't know, I'm not sure, I'm sorry), meanwhile the more diversity-promoting and conform responses to queries are not scored higher probably in the N-best lists. We suggest the Maximum Mutual Information(MMI) for diversifying the responses combing with Word Mover's Distances(WMD) for relating the responses to queries as the objective function to rerank N-best lists based on the Seq2Seq with attention mechanism. Experimental results prove that the MMI-WMD model generates more diverse, meaningful, relevant and appropriate responses to queries. The model performs well in human evaluations and BLEU scores in cornell movie dialogue datasets.

articleTitle: Optimal Feedback Guidance for Powered Landing of Reusable Rockets
abstract: During atmospheric entry, winds and atmospheric uncertainties may result in large dispersions at the beginning of powered landing of reusable rockets. To mitigate the effect of large initial dispersions and uncertainties, an optimal feedback guidance algorithm is presented for the powered landing of reusable rockets. The presented guidance algorithm implements receding-horizon trajectory optimization based on finite-element collocation approaches. The finite-element collocation approach fully discretizes the state and control variables of the powered landing guidance problem, leading to nonlinear programming (NLP) problems addressed by NLP solvers. The optimal trajectory of the powered landing is re-planned in each guidance period using the finite-element collocation approach. Results indicate the proposed optimal feedback guidance algorithm could guide the reusable rocket to land at a specified landing site in the presence of initial dispersion, model uncertainty, and disturbance.

articleTitle: Complete Coverage Path Planning of UUV for Marine Mine Countermeasure Using Grid Division and Spanning Tree
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous improvement of the Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV) systems, naval mine detection missions carried out by UUVs have proliferated and made significant progress. During the process of mine detection, the completeness and efficiency of path planning are critical to the effectiveness of the mission. This paper addresses an off-line and on-line path planning algorithm for UUV in a marine area with obstacles based on the rectangular grid division and spanning tree circumnavigation. In this algorithm, area to detect is equally divided into (2*M)*(2*N) rectangular cell and the UUV circumnavigates the spanning tree of the graph induced from the 2*2 mega cell division while visiting every 1*1 grid with minor backtracking. Simulation results show that the path generated by the algorithm is complete and efficient.

articleTitle: A New LTV-MPC Method for Enhancing the Stability of AFS Vehicles
abstract: This paper proposes a new LTVMPC method for AFS vehicles to enhance the vehicle stability and improve the control performance of traditional LTVMPC when tire force is near saturation. A prediction of tire force is performed in the prediction horizon on the basis of the nonlinear tire model. The control problem is solved by the quadratic programming. Finally, the proposed method is verified based on the CarSim and Matlab simulation environment. Simulation results show that the control performance of the proposed method is obviously improved compared with the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Pneumatic Pressure Control for Regenerative Braking System of Commercial Vehicles
abstract: In this paper, a novel combined control method of electro-pneumatic braking system using fast on-off valves has been proposed, which can improve the precision of pressure tracking and fulfill the requirement of regenerative braking system of electric vehicle. Firstly, the composite mathematical model of the pneumatic braking system was built up and verified by simulation and experimental tests respectively. Secondly, PID controller with PWM and fuzzy controller with cooperative PWM are adopted in this combined control method. Besides, a switching model is designed to ensure the suitable switching states of the valves. By modeling and simulation under various braking condition, the timeliness and accuracy of the braking pressure response is illustrated. All the simulation results prove that the proposed control method has a significant improvement compared with conventional PID control method.

articleTitle: Practical Parameter Estimator for Dynamometer Card of Rod Pumping Systems by Measuring Terminal Data of Drive Motor
abstract: Diagnosis for rod pumping systems usually requires special instruments used on the surface and the bottom of the well. The need for these external instrumentation increases the cost and complexity of rod pumping system and reduces system reliability. To solve this problem, since significant information about properties of rod pumping system is hidden in instantaneous terminal parameters of the induction motor, this paper establishes a practical parameter estimator that combines the T-type equivalent circuit model of an induction motor and the "four bar linkage" model of beam pumping unit. With this practical model, by measuring the terminal characteristics of the induction motor driving beam pumping unit, the surface dynamometer card is acquired in order to identify oil well properties. The practical application in oil fields proved the effectiveness and practicability of the parameter estimator in this paper.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Control of Actuator Additive Fault for Quadrotor Based on Sliding Mode Observer
abstract: The quadrotor flies for a long time so that its actuator is prone to have faults and it will be affected by the external disturbance. In order to obtain better flight performance, the author of this paper conducts a fault tolerant control design based on sliding mode observer to solve the problem of quadrotor's actuator fault under external disturbance, the results of which is of great significance for the quadrotor's safe flight.
