First, the model of quadrotor with the effects of disturbances and faults is built. Then, a kind of sliding mode observer is designed not only to reconstruct the fault information, but also to estimate the external disturbances in real time. Finally, based on the obtained observation signals, backstepping algorithm is used to design attitude controllers for the inner ring and the position controller for the outer ring to tolerate faults and compensate for disturbances, so that the quadrotor can track the desired trajectory stably. Simulation results prove the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Tracking the Maximum Power Point of Photovoltaic Power Generation Based on Self-coding Neural Network
abstract: The current and voltage of photovoltaic power generation system constantly are changed by the external temperature and radiation, which can lead to the constant change in the maximum power point of photovoltaic power generation. To resolve this problem, we propose a novel method based on the self-encoding neural network technology which is applied to the maximum power point tracking of photovoltaic power generation. The method is based on the deep learning network training of stacking encoders and fine-tuning the self-coding neural network which utilizes the reverse propagation method with supervised learning. Finally the model analysis of photovoltaic power generation system is carried out by MATLAB/simulink environment. The results show that this method can track the maximum power point of photovoltaic power more quickly and accurately than the conventional conductance increment method and improve the efficiency of photovoltaic power generation.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Control Technology in Helicopter Wind Tunnel Test
abstract: The helicopter wind tunnel test is a dynamic test with high speed, high difficulty and high risk. Traditional test methods often have some shortcomings, such as low efficiency, poor safety and labor intensity, because they rely too much on human subjective judgment. In order to overcome these shortcomings, in this paper, aiming at the key problems of helicopter wind tunnel test, we construct the test management system which is based on network. Furthermore, the intelligent security protection strategy combining hardware and software is designed. On this basis, the automatic trim technology based on fuzzy control for rotor load is realized. At present, these three new technologies have been successfully applied to helicopter wind tunnel test. The results show that the method has the advantages of easy operation, safety and reliability, good data quality and high test efficiency, which greatly improves the safety level of helicopter wind tunnel test and fully meets the requirements of helicopter wind tunnel test.

articleTitle: Overall Conceptual Design for Spacecraft System Based on Knowledge Engineering
abstract: The overall conceptual design of the spacecraft is the top-level design of the spacecraft system and plays a leading and decision-making role in the development of spacecraft products. This paper investigates the overall design problem of spacecraft, and proposed a novel spacecraft overall design method to improve the efficiency and quality of design process. Applying knowledge engineering technology to enhance the automation of overall design, moreover focusing on solving spacecraft design knowledge modeling, knowledge extraction and related issues. Unlike the existing methods, this paper uses ontology technology to build a spacecraft design knowledge base, which achieves a better performance. Finally, simulations for the designed attitude control system based on knowledge base are performed, and the simulation results validate the effectiveness, reliability, of the control method designed by the overall conceptual design.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of a four-dimensional energy demand-supply system under delayed feedback control
abstract: This paper considers stabilization of a four-dimensional energy demand-supply system. By designing the delayed feedback control, the system has been shown to be stable correspondingly according to different cases stated in the theorem. Numerical simulations have been given to illustrate effectiveness of the feedback control.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Microbial Fuel Cell Based on Wavelet Packet and SOM Neural Network
abstract: Aiming at the faults in the process of two-chamber microbial fuel cell system, a fault diagnosis method for microbial fuel cells based on wavelet packet and SOM neural network is proposed. First, the data samples of output voltage in various typical fault states are obtained through experiments and MATLAB simulation. Secondly, these signals are decomposed into three layers of wavelet packets to obtain the frequency range represented by each frequency band after decomposition, and calculate the characteristic values of different frequency bands. Finally, the SOM neural network is used to diagnose the microbial fuel cell. The experiment proved that the algorithm effectively improves the effectiveness and accuracy of microbial fuel cell fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Method of Glue Spreading Quality Database Based on Extreme Learning Machine
abstract: In order to ensure the accuracy of real-time online inspection system in machine vision glue spreading and reduce the deviation caused by the uncertainty of offline database establishment, this paper proposes an algorithm based on extreme learning machine to build a glue spreading quality database. Firstly, the robot position coordinates of the offline glue spreading track and the calibration result of the image processing are combined into the training sample and the test sample. Secondly, in the training stage, the "Sigmoid" function is used to construct the excitation function, and the best model is trained to establish a standard glue spreading quality database. In the best model, the test samples should be predicted and validated. The experimental results show that the algorithm can make the training time less than 0.1s, and the measurement accuracy of the calibration result is less than 0.01mm. Finally, the practice verification is carried out in the online inspection system to realize the intellectualization of the glue application.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Dual-Motor Driving System for Pipe Belt Conveyor Based on Current Tracking Master-Slave Control
abstract: The pipe belt conveyor is usually driven by several motors. The unique viscoelastic property of the belt is prone to cause load imbalance between individual driving motors and imbalance in the output power of the driving motors. This paper focuses on the pipe belt conveyor whose head is driven by two motors. The dynamic mechanical model of the pipe belt conveyor is built based on the Kelvin model. Based on the three-phase asynchronous motor vector control system, the two-motor power balance principles are presented. A master-slave control strategy is proposed, where the speed of the master motor is given and the current of the slave motor is tracked. A joint simulation model of the pipe belt conveyor is built via AMESim and Simulink to simulate the starting process of the conveyor. The simulation and test results demonstrate the validity of proposed dynamic mechanical model the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Real-time implementation of the cerebellum neural network
abstract: The cerebellum is an important regulatory center for motor and learning in the human brain and its role has increasingly attracted attentions of researchers. Realizing a cerebellar model can be working on a biological time scale is very important both for exploration of mechanisms and practical application of the functions. In this study, we implement a cerebellum spiking neural network with an efficient method on field-programmable gate array (FPGA), which can generate the spiking activities in real time. Based on this, we propose an adaptive feedback control system with the cerebellum model. The dynamic error of robotic arm is taken as the system input and by using the learning mechanism of the cerebellum, the corresponding correction signal can be exported. The results show that this system can eliminate the error and control the robotic arm.

articleTitle: Neuro-adaptive Sliding Mode Fault-tolerant Control of Hypersonic Vehicle under Actuator Fault
abstract: This paper proposed a neuro-adaptive sliding mode fault-tolerant control (NASMFTC) method for the problem of actuator control gain loss fault in hypersonic vehicles. Described as the elevator yaw angle and the engine throttle setting valve fault. The controller combines the robust adaptive algorithm with the radial basis function (RBF) based neural network (NN) method for the hypersonic vehicle longitudinal motion model. The proposed fault-tolerant control method has the following advantages: 1. No need to estimate the value of the actuator fault; 2. The designed control algorithm is simple in structure and does not require a large amount of online calculation, can quickly deal with the occurrence of faults; 3. Can ensure that the system still has the ability to stably track in the case of constant or time-varying actuator faults. The final simulation experiment verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Optimizing of Distributed Multi -Factory Production and Transportation Coordinative Scheduling Problem
abstract: A coordinative scheduling problem of distributed multi-factory production and multiple customers delivery with objective of minimizing maximum delivery time and minimizing total delivery time is studied in this paper. A mathematic programming model is presented, and a method based on genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the problem. Extensive computing tests are performed to find optimum strategy and suitable parameters of the algorithms, and the computing results show the effectiveness of proposed algorithm. The problem with different number of transportation vehicles and different vehicles returning situation are also solved and analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of monitoring system based on vibrating wire sensor
abstract: In this paper, the vibrating wire pressure sensor is taken as an example to describe the working principle of the vibrating wire pressure sensor and the hardware design and function algorithm of the lower computer part in the monitoring system. This paper is designed to collect multi-channel pressure information to observe the geological pressure environment, use ARMA algorithm to predict the geological pressure trend, and realize wireless data communication. The main content is to use the vibrating wire sensor to collect pressure information to achieve multi-position force monitoring; the MCU embeds the ARMA algorithm, analyzes the data, and produces the prediction result; and uses the Internet of Things technology to transmit the data to the host computer system. The upper computer part will get the data combined with the actual situation to analyze and get the required information. Complete a monitoring system that meets actual needs. The monitoring system can be extended to monitor the safety conditions under the pit. It has broad application prospects in the fields of mines, subways and bridges[1].

articleTitle: Design of Temperature Monitoring and Data Transmission System for High-voltage Cable Connector
abstract: Herein, aiming at the temperature periodic inspection maintenance mode of traditional high-voltage cable connector, the technology used for temperature monitoring and data transmission of high-voltage cable connector is proposed. The characteristic structure of high-voltage cable connector is introduced and combined with the Ziee communication technology, the corresponding temperature monitoring and data transmission system is designed. At the same time, the DS18B20 temperature sensor, ZigBee network technology and JN5139 wireless receiving module are detailed analyzed. In a consequence, multi-part temperature on-line monitoring and centralized management for multiple high-voltage cable connector are realized.

articleTitle: Study on Crossing Behavior Decision-making Model of Unmanned Vehicles
abstract: Unmanned vehicles will play an extremely important role in the future development of intelligent transportation system. The research background and significance of unmanned vehicles were introduced and the research status of decision-making of unmanned vehicles at home and abroad was summarized in this paper. And the rule-based behavior decision-making methods and machine learning-based behavior decision-making methods were summarized. To solve the problem of unmanned vehicles crossing at the intersection of city, considering the safety and efficiency of the crossing process, the method of finding the optimal traversing strategy based on the reinforcement learning algorithm was proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm was verified by the intersection crossing case. The results show that compared with Q-Learning algorithm, the NQL algorithm proposed in this paper needs fewer training samples and shorter training time when it converges.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing Based on Wavelet Packet Transform and GA-Elman Neural Network
abstract: Aiming at the problem on how to improve the diagnostic rate of rolling bearing fault diagnosis models, the original vibration signal is denoised and feature extracted by wavelet packet decomposition and reconstruction, and the fault pattern recognition is realized by Elman neural network. For the problem that Elman neural network has a slow convergence rate and it is easy to fall into the local optimal value, this paper uses the genetic algorithm (GA) with global search ability to optimize the weight and threshold of the Elman neural network through the steps of selection, crossover and mutation. It is proved by experiments that the Elman neural network optimized by genetic algorithm has high diagnostic precision, and this method can be better applied to fault diagnosis of rolling bearings.

articleTitle: Robust stabilization for networked time-delay systems with nonlinearity
abstract: Under the network environment in which there may be subjected to packet dropouts and communication delays, the robust stabilization problem is solved for a class of nonlinear time-delay systems with both state and control inputs containing nonlinear perturbations. Under the assumption that the plant and the controller are connect through a network channel, we model the time-delay systems with nonlinearities and transform them into nonlinear time delay systems with time-varying input delays. By constructing a Lyapunov function making use of time-delay information, the problem of stabilization by static output-feedback controller is solved within the linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) framework, and better network control strategy can be obtained via our results.

articleTitle: Formation tracking control for multiple surface vessels systems
abstract: In this paper, we study the formation tacking control problems for multiple vessels system by using adaptive techniques. To process the under-actuated dynamics of the vessels, we use a coordinate transformation method to transform the under-actuated system into a linear second-order system. For the transformed multiple vessels system, we design an adaptive formation tacking controller. A non-smooth function term is introduced to deal with the leader vessels' unknown control inputs. Adaptive gain method is introduced to avoid using the global topology information. For the disturbances, we use the adaptive neural networks to estimate them and then design the compensating controller. Finally, we perform a numerical simulation experiment, and the simulation results show the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: A Method for Coloring Low-resolution Black and White Old Movies through Object Understanding
abstract: Coloring black and white old movies through video coloring technology is one of the research hotspots in the field of computer vision. Early old movies generally have problems such as low resolution and obscure objects, resulting in unsatisfactory coloring effects. This paper proposes a method for coloring low-resolution black and white old movies through object understanding. The approach first employs Microsoft's COCO dataset to train Conditional GAN (CGAN). The trained CGAN is not only able to learn color, but also able to understand objects. First, the black and white old movie is framed, and then the framed image is sent to the CGAN for coloring, finally color frames generated by the network are synthesized into a movie. The whole experimental process includes object recognition, object understanding and auto coloring. This paper takes the "Waterloo Bridge" movie as an example for testing. The test results show the coloring effects are satisfactory. Therefore, this paper implements the automatic colorization of black and white old movies by recognizing and understanding color objects of low resolution. This research work not only has some theoretical value, but also has the application value.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Microbial Fuel Cell Electrochemical Model
abstract: Microbial Fuel Cell (MFC) is a device that can directly convert chemical energy into electrical energy. It has great potential in the field of environmental monitoring and new energy development. In this paper, the electrochemical model of MFC was established in the MATLAB environment. The dynamic analysis of the MFC system was carried out to study the effect of acetate feed concentration and current density on cell performance. When the acetate feed concentration changes the same value, the cell voltage will change differently under different current densities, the higher the current density, the more the voltage drop. In the case of different acetate feed concentrations, with the increase of current density, the rate of voltage drop obeys the rule: first increase, then decrease, and finally increase.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Neural Network Control Method for Robotic Manipulators Trajectory Tracking
abstract: In engineering applications, the trajectory tracking control performance of a robotic manipulator is affected by many uncertain factors, such as disturbance and friction. It is difficult to establish an exact model for a robotic manipulator with unknown dynamics. This paper proposes an adaptive control algorithm based on RBF neural network for the manipulator trajectory tracking control. Firstly, a neural network is employed to off-line identify the unknown model of the manipulator system. Then, another RBF neural network is adopted to approximate and compensate the uncertain item in the nonlinear dynamic model respectively. Based on Lyapunov stability theory, the corresponding adaptive adjustment laws of neural network weights are derived, and a robust controller is designed to further reduce the approximation error of the model. At last, experimental results are performed to illustrate the trajectory tracking performance and anti-interference ability of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Research Progress on Joint Operation Modeling Based on Complex Networks
abstract: With the development of joint operations theory, the modeling and analysis of its complex systems has become a research hot point in the military field. As a comprehensive research theory, complex networks not only have a natural similarity with the joint operation system, but also have strong advantages in describing the emergence of the system. Therefore, it has attracted the attention of many scholars in recent years. Based on the establishment of the model of complex networks in joint operations, this paper introduces the concept of joint operations and the theory of complex networks, and focuses on the modeling research results. Finally, we put forward some viewpoints on the existing modeling methods and discusses the possible development prospects in this field.

articleTitle: A multivariate monitoring method based on PCA and Dual Control Chart
abstract: Recently, Dual Control Chart (DCC) has been proposed for mining the changing information of a process inner variable. However, the DCC method does not consider the correlations among the variables. Further more, the G statistic of the DCC method has a cancellation problem. Though the G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> statistic is proposed to overcome the cancellation problem, the changing information of G statistic is lost. In this paper, an improved Dual Control Chart based on PCA and Two-track Statistic for overcoming the two shortcomings of the DCC method. The contributions are as follows: 1) the PCA is introduced to decouple the correlations among the original variables. 2) the Two-track Statistic is explored to overcome the cancellation problem; The proposed method is applied to fault detection of Tennessee Eastman process (TE process). The monitoring results show the effectiveness of the proposed method, compared with DCC method.

articleTitle: Study on the Demand and Requirements of Renewable Energy Primary Frequency Control
abstract: The most wind turbines/PV inverters achieve maximum power tracking through converter control, which results in unable to respond to grid frequency changes, unable to help the grid reduce system frequency change rate, and unable to provide active power backup for power systems and increasing the system's frequency control intensity. Based on the fast control of the inverter, the inertia support and primary frequency control to the wind turbine/PV inverter can be realized through the design of the frequency response control. The grid code has been elaborated and implemented in European countries. However, one question is: "Why do we need a frequency regulation of wind power generationƒ" This paper analyzes the typical cases of renewable energy participation in system frequency control in Europe, and studies the needs of domestic and international renewable energy power to participate in system frequency control. And the frequency control requirements of the Portuguese power grid for grid-connected wind power are given.

articleTitle: A Self-reflection Teaching-Learning-Based Optimization Algorithm and Its Application
abstract: This paper proposes a self-reflection teaching-learning-based (STLBO) algorithm to improve the optimization performance of the TLBO algorithm. A new learning mechanism is employed to enhance the search ability of TLBO algorithm. In the learner phase, a no-best student learns from a random selected outstanding student or an outstanding student learns from teacher again according the fitness of the two mutual learners. After the interaction learning with other students, a self-reflection learning strategy is carried out to realize more detailed search for local information and jump out the local optimal. To evaluate the performance of STLBO algorithm, a comparison with other TLBO variants is presented to address the global optimization problem for robust pole assignment in linear discrete time systems with poles restrict in a circular region, and a robust test with LMI method is carried out. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and merits of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Multiattribute Decision Approach for 4PL Supply Base Design
abstract: As a supply chain integrator, fourth party logistics (4PL) providers could provide high value services for customers by managing experienced consulting firms, third party logistics (3PL) providers and technology companies. Building supply base that consists of a number of qualified 3PLs is desperately needed for 4PL to deliver comprehensive supply chain solutions. This paper provides a decision framework to support the effective operations for 4PL. Combining the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) with fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FEC), a multiattribute decision approach called AHP-FEC is proposed for scoring 3PLs. Based on the derived scores, qualified 3PLs are selected to form the supply base. A case study shows that the proposed framework and AHP-FEC could be useful tools for 4PL to appropriately design the supply base.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Design of Computer Games System Based on Surakarta
abstract: Surakarta is two player strategy boardgame, which is one of the computer games. In computer game system, there always include four key components, which are Game show, Move generator, Evaluation functions and Search algorithm. This paper focuses on the analysis of the key technology of the Surakarta game system, and analyzes the difficulties of the computer game system by combining the designed Surakarta game system. The system won the first prize in the National Undergraduate Computer Game Competition, which verified the completeness of the system and the certain effectiveness of the evaluation algorithm.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Guidance Law for Multiple Missiles with Impact Time and Terminal Angle Constraints
abstract: To solve the problem of multiple missiles attacking a maneuverable target simultaneously, a novel finite-time cooperative guidance law with line-of-sight angle constraint is proposed based on sliding-mode control method. The multiple missiles cooperative guidance model is constructed based on in-plane missiles-target relative motion equations and the process of design including two stages. In the first stage, a distributed finite time cooperative guidance law in the line-of-sight direction is designed based on the adaptive super-twisting and integral sliding mode control theory. Secondly, the acceleration command on the normal direction of the line-of-sight is developed. Mathematical simulation of time cooperation of multiple missiles is carried out for maneuverable target to ensure the missile's line-of-sight angle converges to its desired value in finite time. The proposed guidance law guarantees the attacking of target, and the attack time cooperation of multiple missiles is realized as well.

articleTitle: A Modified Global Harmony Search Algorithm with Random Crossover for Continuous High Dimensional Optimization Problems
abstract: This paper proposes a modified global harmony search (MGHS) algorithm with random crossover algorithm to solve continuous high dimensional optimization problems. For the problem of premature convergence in harmony search algorithm, in the improvisation stage of MGHS algorithm, the new harmony vector is generated dynamically by means of random crossover for the global optimization problems, i.e., the worst harmony learning from the best harmony and the random selected other harmony learning from the best harmony random crossover strategy. Finally, MGHS algorithm is applied in the simulation test of 8 benchmark functions, the simulation results demonstrate the MGHS algorithm has higher convergence precision and convergence rate.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault Tolerant Control of Hypersonic Flight Vehicle with State Constraints using Barrier Lyapunov Function
abstract: For the longitudinal model of hypersonic flight vehicle (HFV) with redundant rudder surface, the paper investigates a fault-tolerant control which focuses on the full state constraints. Firstly, the barrier Lyapunov function (BLF) based on the dynamic surface method is used to ensure that the flight path angle (FPA), the pitch angle, and the pitch rate are always in the constraint interval, and the problem of "differential expansion" of the traditional backstepping method is avoided. Then, aiming at the unknown fault of the rudder surface, the fault-tolerant controller structure is designed, and the matching condition for fault compensation control is given. The controller parameter adaptive law designed according to Lyapunov stability theory guarantees the stability and tracking performance of the system. Finally, the Lyapunov theory proves that the proposed method can ensure the closed-loop stability of the control system, and all signals in the closed-loop system are uniformly bounded. Numerical simulation results verify the effectiveness of the controller design in this paper.

articleTitle: Optimal Deployment of Radar Network based on Chaos Genetic Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, an optimal disposition method based on chaos genetic algorithm (AGA) is presented for radar netting. A mathematical model for radar optimal disposition is established according to the analysis of regional radar netting at the beginning. And then, the solving process of AGA for this optimization problem is discussed. The adaptive crossover probability and adaptive mutation probability are proposed, which consider the influence of every generation to algorithm and the effect individual fitness in every generation. Finally, through analyzing an example, it comes to a conclusion that several optimal deployment of radar networks can be obtained much more quickly by this method with better operability.

articleTitle: Adaptive Trajectory Tracking Control of Wheeled Mobile Robot
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive trajectory tracking control scheme for a wheeled mobile robot in the presence of unknown parameters and uncertainties of dynamics model. The main idea is that an adaptive controller is designed to reduce the influence of unknown dynamics parameters and uncertainties, and a kinematics controller is used to generate a virtual velocity serving as a reference input for the dynamics control system. Through the regulation of virtual control law and adaptive control law, we can finally achieve the control effect of real velocity asymptotically tracking virtual velocity and virtual velocity asymptotically tracking expected velocity. It is proved that this method can make the robot quickly track the desired trajectory. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of Dynamic Evaluation Strategy of Pieces in Military Chess Game System
abstract: In the system of military chess, The accuracy of the evaluation directly affects the function of the system. Because of the military chess game is incomplete information game with high complexity, the accuracy of guessing the enemy chess piece is not high in a limited time. Therefore, this paper uses history heuristic tables to guide the Monte Carlo algorithm to simulate enemy chess pieces, which greatly saves simulation time. And on the evaluation of our chess pieces, Q-learning algorithm based on the idea of exploration and income equalization was proposed to solve the problem of the evaluation based on the multiple kinds of military chess pieces and lack of timely evaluation, Improve the effectiveness of the evaluation. and constructs a complete game system based on dynamic estimation function with four factors by competing with static evaluation system of military chess game the winning rate of our approach reached 60%, And won the first prize in the 2018 National University Computer Game Competition. which verified the effectiveness of dynamic evaluation strategy.

articleTitle: Active disturbance rejection time-varying formation control for multi-agent systems with disturbances
abstract: The current paper investigates the active disturbance rejection time-varying formation control for second-order multi-agent systems subjected to external disturbances. Firstly, a robust time-varying formation control protocol with the disturbance compensation is proposed. Then, an extended state observer is designed to estimate the disturbance compensation by the active disturbance rejection control method. Moreover, sufficient conditions for robust time-varying formation feasibility analysis and protocol design are shown, respectively. Finally, a numerical simulation is presented to verify the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A process monitoring method based on robust collective non-negative matrix factorization
abstract: The complexity and uncertainty of industrial process often lead to the monitoring model of the original process is no longer suitable for monitoring new process. The transfer learning is an effective way to deal with this situation, which can transfer knowledge from source domain (original process) to establish an accurate monitoring model for target domain (new process). However, the effectiveness of this method is usually degraded due to the impact of noise. In this paper, we proposed a robust collective non-negative matrix factorization(RCNMF) method for complex industrial process monitoring. The method handle noise in original process and new process through robust collective non-negative matrix factorization. This method uses common latent factors to build an information transfer channel between the original process and the new process. Significantly, our method provides a simple and effective synchronization implement mechanisms for fault detection and fault classification in complex industrial process. The validity and practicability of the method have been verified by experiments on real ore grinding and grading process data.

articleTitle: Instantaneous Velocity Optimization Strategy of Electric Vehicle Considering Varying Road Slopes
abstract: Economic cruising strategies of vehicles on terrain have been studied for years to reduce energy consumption by optimizing the profile of driving velocity. However, most controllers require prediction of future terrain information, with heavy computing load, which prevent them applying in real-time implementation. This paper presents an instantaneous energy optimization cruising strategy for pure electric vehicles (EVs), named normalized energy consumption minimization strategy (NCMS) to improve its cruising energy efficiency on roads with varying slopes. By converting the vehicle kinetic energy into equivalent energy consumption, the total energy consumption is minimized instantaneously to optimize the traction or braking torques. In addition, a velocity-related factor is designed to regulate the vehicle speed within a given cruising speed range. Since NCMS does not require the knowledge of future road conditions, it calculates the control rule within one millisecond, making it suitable for real-time control. Finally, energy saving potential of NCMS is explored by comparing to constant speed (CS) cruising strategy.

articleTitle: A Distributed ADMM Algorithm for Economic Load Dispatch Considering Demand Response
abstract: This paper formulates a dynamic economic load dispatch (ELD) problem while considering the demand response (DR) in smart grid. To solve the novel ELD problem, an equivalent SWMP is presented first, and then a distributed Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) algorithm utilizing the average consensus protocol is proposed. In particular, the impact of the transmission power losses is also discussed. A sufficient condition that can ensure the convergence of the distributed algorithm is derived along with theoretical analysis. The distributed ADMM algorithm maximizes the social welfare and guarantees the instantaneous power balance. Case studies on the IEEE-39 bus system demonstrate the performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Improve Multi-objective Ant Lion Optimizer Based on Quasi-oppositional and Levy Fly
abstract: In order to solve the problem that classic ant lion algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum, a quasi-opposite Levy fly multi-objective ant lion algorithm is proposed. In this algorithm, Levy fly is used to replace the ant lion random walk mechanism in the original algorithm. The combination of Brownian motion and jumping flight is used to improve the ability of local exploitation and global exploration. At the same time, after each time iterate, the ant population is optimized by quasi-opposite learning strategy. The original population and its quasi-opposite individuals are mixed and the best individuals are selected as the new population. In this way, the diversity of the population is increased, as well as, the computational efficiency of the algorithm is improved. Finally, typical benchmarks are selected to compare the algorithm with the original ant lion algorithm and other swarm intelligence algorithms. Experimental results show that both convergence and distribution of the proposed algorithm are greatly improved. The quasi-opposite Levy fly multi-objective ant lion algorithm has good adaptability and effectiveness in solving the two-objective optimization problem.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for Near-Ground Flying Aircrafts Based On Terrain Tracking
abstract: This paper focuses on the controller design and simulation for Near Ground Flying aircrafts. To fulfill the near ground flying as well as to enhance the penetration ability of the aircrafts, a control strategy is presented. Firstly, a type of digital elevation model is introduced. Secondly, the outline of the digital elevation model is described by choosing the characteristic points. Thirdly, the safe distances of the sensors are considered. Finally, by applying the aircraft's pitch angle and the altitude as reference tracking commands, a tracking controller based on LQR method with integral augmentation is designed. Simulation results are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of this controller.

articleTitle: A Novel Sliding Mode Control Method for Uncertain Nonlinear Second-order Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a novel nonsingular terminal sliding mode control combined with global sliding surface for a class of uncertain nonlinear second-order systems. The suggested control approach is developed based on the Lyapunov theory. The sliding mode reaching the sliding surface in finite time can be guaranteed. Furthermore, chattering phenomenon caused by the switching control action can be eliminated theoretically, and desirable control performance is realized. The simulation results for heave control of an unmanned underwater vehicle are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion with Context Enhancement Based on Human Visual System
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a new infrared and visible image fusion method based on human visual system (HVS), which can enhance the context of images in poor tight conditions in the process of fusion without image preprocessing. First, the original images are converted into adaptive contrast signals by the proposed multiscale model of adaptation and spatial vision. Second, these signals are combined together by our fusion rules. Finally, the fused image is obtained by converting the fused signals inversely. The experimental results show that the fused image is friendly to human vision.

articleTitle: Research on Monitoring Method of Coal Injection Flow Rate in Blast Furnace Tuyere Based on Video
abstract: The flow uniformity of the pulverized coal injection (PCI) is critical to the stable operation of blast furnace. The manual observation is difficult to monitor the flow uniformity of PCI. This paper proposes the intelligent monitoring method based on video, which can accurately monitor the flow uniformity of PCI real-timely. The region of pulverized coal cloud in image is obtained by image processing and computer vision technology. In accordance with the analysis of obtained region characteristics, the region feature extraction algorithm with regard to two-dimensional area information is applied to estimate the mass flow of PCI. In addition, three kinds of volume estimation methods (the super-pixel grey weighted method, the equivalent ellipse method and the multiple linear regression model method) are explored to obtain the three-dimensional optimal information of pulverized coal cloud. Extensive videos captured from the steel factory are used to evaluate the monitoring method. The experiment results show that these methods can accurately monitor the flow uniformity of PCI, and the errors are within ±13.1%.

articleTitle: Ship target detection method based on SRM segmentation and hierarchical line segment features
abstract: in view of the rich and complex texture of high resolution remote sensing images, a method of ship target detection based on SRM segmentation and feature extraction of layered line segments is proposed. The experimental results show that the detection method of this paper can effectively detect the ship target of high resolution remote sensing image, and the performance of the feature extraction method using layered line segment is better than other common methods. At the same time, the ship detection method in this paper does not need too many parameters and training samples.

articleTitle: Container Terminal Overland Collection and Distribution Logistics Generalized Computing Model with Computational Logistics and Case Study
abstract: The overland collection and distribution of container terminal (OCD-CT) is provided with the important significances for the operation of container terminal logistics systems (CTLS), especially in China. However, the related research work is relatively scarce relative to the operational management of quay side, horizontal transferring and storage yard. Thereupon, this paper focuses on the OCD-CT from the perspective of computational logistics to demonstrate the logistics generalized computation among container gate house, external yard trailer and terminal storage yard. The container overland collection and distribution collaborative logistics generalized computing model (OCDC-LGCM) and external yard trailer comprehensive performance perspective (EYT-CPP) both are proposed together by the introduction, migration, localization, modification and fusion of the framework, mechanism and modes in computer operating system and virtual machine. Finally, OCDC-LGCM and EYT-CPP are applied to a typical container terminal to analyze and evaluate the performance of OCD-CT preliminary from the visual angle of the key indicators of external yard trailers. This case study goes further to convey the feasibility and credibility of computational logistics for CTLS.

articleTitle: Industrial APP Design for Data Dynamic Monitoring of Strip Production Process
abstract: Strip is a kind of material which is widely used in many industries. At present, the market demand for high precision and high quality strip is huge. As the bottom equipment of the production process, the running state of the strip production equipment is of great significance to the quality of the strip. In this paper, aiming at the regional limitation of current equipment monitoring system, we design and implement a mobile APP for real-time monitoring the running state of field equipment by using mobile interconnection technology. Using mobile APP can reduce monitoring costs and achieve real time monitoring of device parameters effectively. In this paper, OPC communication protocol, Socket communication and mobile interconnection technology are used to provide a new idea for intelligent monitoring.

articleTitle: Multi-product Distribution Scheduling for Electric Energy Metering Device
abstract: Efficient and safe distribution network is crucial to the economic efficiency and competitiveness of enterprises. Based on current distribution status of the Measurement Center of State Grid Tianjin Electric Power Company, this paper aims to build a multi-product distribution route optimization model with the minimum total cost and maximum vehicle loading rate for different distribution demand characteristics. The model is solved and applied by CPLEX software and verified with actual data. The model can not only meet the existing requirements for distribution services, but also provide a solution on scheduling program for distribution vehicles in case of urgent demands. Our conclusions will help firms to save costs, improve distribution efficiency and meet the customer satisfaction's requirements.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Complexity Meaning and Quantitative Research
abstract: With the trend of globalization and personalization, supply chain is becoming more and more complex, leading to a decline in the flexibility of the supply chain, manifested by slow response, long lead time and high inventory levels, etc. To simplify the complexity of the supply chain, we must understand the complexity of the supply chain. Therefore, this paper summarizes the previous views on the complexity of the supply chain, analyzes the imperfections, and then explains the meaning of the complexity of the supply chain. This paper divides the complexity of the supply chain into three parts: network complexity, process complexity and product complexity, and then proposes corresponding quantitative methods. The complexity of supply chain network is divided into three aspects: hierarchical structure, number of nodes and interaction of nodes. On the basis of previous studies on the hierarchical structure and the number of nodes, the interaction between nodes is quantified by topological analysis taking geographical factors into consideration. Process complexity: at the macro level, operation time is used to measure the complexity of each link of the supply chain business process; at the micro level, information entropy is used to measure the uncertainty of the operation time of a certain link. Product complexity can be divided into single-product production complexity and multi-product category complexity. Since many scholars have studied the production complexity, this paper focuses on the study of multi-product category complexity and calculates the difference of activity-based cost between multi-product and typical single-product to measure the category complexity. By defining and quantifying supply chain complexity, this paper helps enterprises consciously reduce the complexity in the management.

articleTitle: Adaptive sliding Mode Control for Nonholonomic Mobile Robots based on Neural Networks
abstract: To improve the tracking precision of mobile robots with unknown disturbances, an adaptive sliding mode control method with stronger robustness is proposed based on the neural networks. A new control law is designed, in which the equivalent term is replaced by a double power term to improve the convergence rate of sliding mode control. Moreover, the RBF neural network is employed to estimate the upper bound of the uncertainties and to compensate for the unknown parameters and nonparametric disturbances. The precision of trajectory tracking control is improved. This control algorithm is simple and more applicable to mobile robots. The stability is proved, and the simulations demonstrate the superiority and feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Hybrid Fault-tolerant Control System for Multiple Faults of Aeroengines
abstract: In this paper a hybrid fault-tolerant control system is presented to realize the function of fault-tolerant control during the situation of coexisting faults. In this fault-tolerant control system, the fault estimation process and the following fault-tolerant control process is combined into one process, which means the time cost of fault-tolerant control process can be shorten, and the performance of the control system will be improved. The fault-tolerant controller in this system is able to adjust its structure to adopt to different fault situations. The proposed approach is applied to the nonlinear aeroengine model. According to the simulation results, the hybrid fault-tolerant control system is able to locate the faulty ones, estimate the variations of faults and minimize the influence of faults when the sensor faults and actuator faults coexist.

articleTitle: Finite-time Output Feedback Attitude Control for Double Tethered Satellite System in Deep Space
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of finite-time output feedback decentralized control of double tethered satellite system (2-TSS) attitude tracking in the presence of external disturbances in deep space. More specifically, the finite-time attitude tracking control law with the reconstructed information achieving from the pseudo-angular velocity filter is proposed in this paper. The significant feature of proposed strategy is that the whole closed-loop control system can be guaranteed theoretically to be finite-time stable by the development of adding a power integrator method, which indicates that the tracking errors for 2-TSS are confronted into a small residual region around origin within finite time. Finally, numerical simulation analysis is presented to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Information Technology and Internal Controls: A Study of Chinese Commercial High-tech Enterprises
abstract: According to the theories of information technology and internal control, this paper analyses the business operation of China's high-tech enterprises in details. This study shows that high-tech enterprises should strengthen the construction of financial accounting system in internal control. Firstly, a good internal control environment is the basis for the development of high-tech enterprises. Secondly, high-tech enterprises should strengthen the establishment of risk assessment system in the process of development. Thirdly, information communication is particularly important for the development ofhigh-tech enterprises. Finally, high-tech enterprises must also improve the regulatory systems.

articleTitle: Intelligent Groundwater Metering Control System
abstract: This paper introduces an intelligent groundwater metering control system consisting of the lower computer, which takes electromagnetic flowmeter, temperature sensor, power meter as the main data acquisition unit and the development board as the main data processing unit, and the host computer with the corresponding software installed. The development board uses the Modbus Remote Terminal Unit (RTU) protocol as the main data communication format. The digital and analog modules read the data in the acquisition unit in real time, and after recording and analyzing the data, it can independently complete some control and realize some functions, and with the help of General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) Data Transfer Unit's fully transparent transmission mode, relying on GPRS and Internet network, it uploads data and running logs to the management system of the host computer, realizing remote, real-time, wireless processing and recording of data. The actual operation shows that the system can solve the inconvenience of groundwater resource management well and has certain use value and promotion significance.

articleTitle: Self-protective Performance Analysis on DC-based DFIG System
abstract: With the development of dc transmission, dc-based DFIG system consisting of a rotor side converter (RSC), a stator side converter (SSC) and a DFIG, has a promising application prospect in a dc-interfaced wind farms. Self-protective performance of DFIG is a major concern in the dc grid. In this paper, two aspects are improved. First, coordinated MPC scheme is applied to enhance the system steady and transient performance; Stator flux predictive and rotor current predictive method is adopted to keep stator flux stable and track the maximum power curve in a stator flux-oriented frame. Second, self-protective performance of dc-based DFIG system is analyzed and compared with that of traditional DFIG system during voltage sag faults without any auxiliary protective device. At last, simulation and experimental studies are carried out to validate system performance.

articleTitle: Belief-rule-base Model with Attribute Reliability for Multiple Attribute Decision Making
abstract: A new belief-rule-base model with attribute reliability (BRB-r model) is proposed for the multiple attribute decision making (MADM) problem in this paper. The proposed BRB-r model provides a framework for decision makers to describe preference. The introduction of the attribute reliability enables the traditional BRB model to deal with the systematic uncertainty existing in both quantitative and qualitative attributes. Besides, the unreasonable situation about belief rule activation for the BRB-r model is discussed, and a new belief rule activation method is proposed to solve it. The feasibility of the BRB-r model with new belief rule activation method is demonstrated using a MADM case about combat capability generation schemes for fighters. The schemes ranking given by the BRB model and the BRB-r model with different belief rule activation method shows the influence of attribute reliability in the MADM problems.

Author Keywords: Belief-rule-base model with attribute reliability (BRB-r model)

articleTitle: Attitude Tracking Control for a Quadrotor via backstepping and Adaptive Dynamic Programming
abstract: An online-learning control algorithm based on Backstepping control and action-dependent heuristic dynamic programming (ADHDP) is proposed for quadrotors to facilitate a satisfied control performance. In the paper, backstepping controller is used as the main controller and ADHDP controller is worked as the complementary controller. The ADHDP control strategy is designed based on the difference between the real attitude value response from the basic Backstepping control and the desired attitude reference value. An actor-critic neural network is served as the primary structure in ADHDP controller, which has the ability of online adaptive learning. The simulation results in Matlab/Simulink are presented to verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed control technology.

articleTitle: Skin Roughness Evaluation Method Based on gray level co-occurrence matrix
abstract: To evaluate the Skin roughness in the image of human, skin features are based on eigenvalues of the gray level co-occurrence matrix are used, and the Pearson correlation coefficient is used to select the eigenvalues as the evaluation index. In the calculation of new eigenvalue, the normal equation is used to calculate the weight to improve the accuracy of the evaluation. In addition, a rough skin sample library is constructed manually to verify the experimental results of the evaluation method in this paper. In the experiments, the correct rate of the evaluation with the improved eigenvalues are presented by comparison with CON and IDM.

articleTitle: Anti-Interference Compound Controller Design for Semi-Active Suspension Based on Half-Vehicle Model
abstract: This paper proposes a compound controller with composite anti-interference ability for a semi-active suspension system. A half-car semi-active suspension model is established considering both vertical and pitch motion. Then, the model is decoupled into various transfer function form so as to calculate controller transfer function in a more precise way. A compound controller is designed to control active force of front and rear suspension combining mix-type feedback controller and feedforward controller in order to minimize the influence of both road random disturbance and road sudden disturbance as much as possible. Finally, simulation is implemented and results show that comparing with passive-suspension system and conventional parallel PID controller, vehicle ride comfort, suspension controlling force and system anti-interference ability are obviously optimized.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Discriminative Correlation Filter Based Object Tracking
abstract: In this paper, a object tracking method based on spatio-temporal discriminative correlation filter is proposed. Firstly, a correlation filter layer is added into the the Siamese fully convolutional network to achieve end-to-end learning representation; secondly, the semantic feature is combined with the appearance feature to further enhance the discriminative ability of Siamese fully convolutional network; finally, the spatio-temporal regularized correlation filter is utilized to reduce the training time and improve the tracking performance. Extensive experiments conducted on VOT2017 dataset demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed approach over the examined state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Malware Classification System Based on Machine Learning
abstract: The main challenge for malware researchers is the large amount of data and files that need to be evaluated for potential threats. Researchers analyze a large number of new malware daily and classify them in order to extract common features. Therefore, a system that can ensure and improve the efficiency and accuracy of the classification is of great significance for the study of malware characteristics. A high-performance, high-efficiency automatic classification system based on multi-feature selection fusion of machine learning is proposed in this paper. Its performance and efficiency, according to our experiments, have been greatly improved compared to single-featured systems.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault-tolerant Control of Six-rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
abstract: This paper studies the flight dynamics modeling of six-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles and designs an adaptive fault-tolerant controller via state feedback referring to the model. The method enables six-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles to not only land safely, but also to hover and propel normally when the motors are stuck or blocked. Based on the on-line estimation of eventual faults, the adaptive fault-tolerant controller parameters are updating automatically to compensate the fault effects on the system. By using the framework of linear matrix inequality(LMI) approach, the proposed algorithm enhances the security and robustness of the system.

articleTitle: An Improved Method Based on CPG to Achieve Trotting Gait of Quadrupedal Robot
abstract: In this paper, we achieve a trotting gait of quadrupedal robot based on neural oscillator networks in simulation. Through combining the output signals of neural oscillator networks and feedback signals derived from the pose of body of quadrupedal robot, we make the quadruped travel with dynamical stability. Compared with previous researches in this way, we abandon the assumption that, when leg is in stance phase, only the upper limb of leg swings backward and the lower limb still keeps the original state (corresponding to the state that leg just finished the swing phase). Consequently, the amplitude of pitch and roll motions of torso of quadrupedal robot is greatly attenuated. By the modified method, a more steady motion with quadrupedal robot is achieved.

articleTitle: Finger vein recognition based on Hessian-Affine operator
abstract: Finger vein recognition has become a popular biometric technology due to its security and convenience. However, quality degradation of images, especially the arbitrariness of finger placement during acquisition that makes venous areas scaled, translated and rotated, often seriously decrease the rate of the recognition. To solve the problem, a finger vein recognition method based on Hessian-Affine operator is proposed in this paper. First, the region of interest (ROI) is extracted from the raw image followed by a gray scale unevenness correction for image enhancement. All affine invariant feature points extracted by Hessian-Affine operator and described by SIFT descriptor are subject to feature matching. Experiments on MLA data set published by Shandong University and its expansion set show that the Hessian-Affine feature is robust to the translation, scale, rotation and illumination changes of the vein region that helps vein recognition.

articleTitle: Ensemble Interval Network-based Modelling of the Glutamic Acid Fermentation Process
abstract: This paper presents a new architecture for an ensemble interval random vector functional-link network (EIRVFLN) with the learning algorithm, which enables the conventional ensemble neural network (ENN) to have the ability to process uncertain data. As an application case study, the EIRVFLN is used to model the glutamic acid fermentation process under the condition of bounded-error data, and the test results indicate that the accuracy of the model meets the manufacturing requirements.

Author Keywords: Ensemble interval random vector functional-link network

articleTitle: Study on nonlinear car-following model based on opening community's road
abstract: In order to study the influence of the opening community on road traffic capacity, it is necessary to establish a vehicle driving model applicable to the opening community. Based on the spacing derivative model of proportional to velocity, this paper improves the model from driver factor, road factor and environment factor, and proposes nonlinear car-following model which is suitable for opening community. The model parameters are calibrated by using vissim software, and then Lianhuadong community of Shenyang is selected for model verification. The results demonstrate that the model error is basically less than 10%, and the model is feasible and reasonable.

articleTitle: Observer-Based H∞ Fuzzy Control for 1-D Parabolic PDEs Using Point Measurements
abstract: An observer-based H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> fuzzy controller is presented for one-dimensional (1-D) parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs) with bounded external disturbance using discrete point measurements. Sufficient conditions that guarantee internal exponential stability of the closed-loop system and the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance index are derived in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). A numerical simulation example is given to demonstrate the efficiency of the results.

articleTitle: Self-admittance Simulation Analysis for Power Network Stability Research
abstract: The stability of the power system is an important issue in the power system. Stability is the basic requirement of the control system and the basic condition for ensuring the operation of the power system. The unstable system does not have the ability to adjust, nor can it work normally. Stability is one of the system's own characteristics[1]. Whether the system is stable or not depends on the excitation signal, but it is related to the structural parameters of the system. The system structure parameters can be reflected by self-admittance. At present, with the promotion of distributed power sources, distributed power sources are connected to the power network to improve the reliability of power supply[2]. Distributed power access to the power network has a certain impact on the stability of the power network. In this paper, the self-admissive mathematical model of the power network is established based on the concept of network function, and the actual power network stability is simulated and analyzed by MATLAB simulation platform and specific examples.

articleTitle: Stability Investigation of Car-trailer Combinations considering Steering System Stiffness
abstract: The yaw instability of car-trailer combinations (CTCs) is indicated by the body sway of the towing car and/or the trailer. Experimental study shows that the steering system characteristics do have an influence on the stability of CTCs, although this effect is still not clear. The complexity of the dynamic coupling between the towing car and the trailer makes this problem more challenging. The influence of the steering system stiffness on the stability of CTCs is the focus of this paper. In this paper, a theoretical model in horizontal plane with 6 DOFs of CTCs has been established by Lagrange equation. The rotation of the steering column, the movement of the rack and the rotation of the steering wheel around the king pin are three DOFs considered in the steering system model. The tire property is considered as nonlinear. The dynamic stability of CTCs is indicated by the system dynamic critical speed. Through theoretical analysis and the simulation study, the effect chain between the steering system stiffness and the body sway of CTCs could be revealed.

articleTitle: Differential Evolution Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization for Solving Job-shop Scheduling Problem
abstract: Job-shop Scheduling Problem (JSP) has become a hotspot for production management and combinatorial optimization research due to its high computational complexity. For the more complicated condition of JSP, how to achieve a short time to obtain the JSP optimal solution by designing the real-time and efficient strategy is still a problem in recent years. To solve this problem, a particle swarm optimization algorithm based on differential quantum properties is proposed. On the basis of quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization, variation, crossover, and selection operation are utilized by particles, which can better keep the diversity of the particles in the population, avoiding the local optimum in the later phase of the iteration. Multi neighborhood search is used for particles' local search to improve search precision. The operation-based encoding is firstly used to allow the research optimization algorithm for JSP solving. The results show that the research algorithm could achieve a short time to obtain the JSP optimal solution, the search precision and speed are improved obviously comparing with other algorithms such as the classical particle swarm optimization.

articleTitle: The Research on Phase Spectrum Decomposition Mechanism based on One-Side EMD
abstract: Aiming at the problem of Hilbert transformation on mode decomposition for non-Bedrosian signal, this paper proposes a phase spectrum decomposition method based on one-side empirical mode decomposition (EMD) which realizes the straight analysis for non-Bedrosian signal through Hilbert transformation. This paper first proposes the main features of the signal which meets the requirement of EMD, introducing the principle of phase spectrum superposition and one-side EMD to expand EMD application into phase spectrum scope. Then the frequencies relationship between time-amplitude coordinate and phase spectrum are deduced. Finally the process procedures as Hilbert transformation, one-side EMD phase spectrum decomposition and frequency analysis are constructed. From simulation testing, it is proved that one-side EMD phase spectrum decomposition mechanism could conquer the problem of Hilbert transformation for non-Bedrosian signal processing and be higher on stability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Improved Stabilization Method for Time-Delay T-S Fuzzy Systems
abstract: This paper aims to study problem of the delay-dependent stability analysis and stabilization control design for nonlinear systems with time delay in Takagi-Sugeno(T-S) fuzzy model. New membership function dependent Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional(LKF) is proposed in this paper. Wirtinger inequality is employed to estimate the integral term of derivative of the LKF, and switching rules are established to avoid the time derivative of membership functions. Then, improved stability and stabilization criteria are obtained within the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Two numerical examples are given to demonstrate the advantage and effectiveness of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: Global Sliding Mode Control Based on Recurrent Wavelet Fuzzy Neural Network Control for H-type Platform
abstract: A recurrent wavelet fuzzy neural network (RWFNN) control method combined with global sliding mode control (GSMC) is proposed to solve the problem of dual-axis synchronous error of H-type platform system driven by permanent magnet synchronous linear motor. Firstly, global sliding mode controller is designed to eliminate the approaching mode, reduce tracking error and ensure global robustness in the single-axis of H-type platform system. Recurrent wavelet fuzzy neural network compensator is designed for the dual-axis of H-type platform system, to compensate the synchronous error. The simulation results show that the proposed method not only guarantees the global robustness of the system, but also effectively reduces the synchronous error of the system and improves the tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive fuzzy control for a class of nonlinear fractional-order systems
abstract: In this paper, the problem of fuzzy adaptive control of unknown nonlinear fractional-order systems with unknown control direction and external disturbance is investigated. We exploit a decomposition of the control gain matrix into a symmetric positive-definite matrix, a diagonal matrix with diagonal entries +1 or 1 and a unity upper triangular matrix. Fuzzy logic systems are used for estimating the unknown nonlinear functions. Based on the fractional Lyapunov direct method and some proposed Lemmas, a fuzzy adaptive controller is designed. The proposed method can guarantee all the signals in the closed-loop systems remain bounded and the tracking errors converge to an arbitrary small region of the origin. For updating the parameters of the fuzzy system, fractional-order adaptations laws are proposed. Lastly, an illustrative example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Architectural Design and Implementation Method for Joint Operations Simulation System
abstract: An overall architecture of simulation system is designed according to the requirements for simulation system in the joint operations experiment, while the methods for realizing system operation mechanism and constructing a model system are presented in this paper. With the system operation mechanism featured by "centralized simulation and distributed application", an environment for operation is created to support extension and achieve simulation rapidly. Modularized modeling technology is utilized to construct an entity model of forces, and multi-level model architecture is employed in the design of simulation model system. The models of all levels are combined to achieve multi-resolution modeling and variable-resolution simulation. Therefore, this paper provides the feasible technical path and method for realizing the construction and integration of joint operations simulation system.

articleTitle: Exponential Mean Stability Analysis with Given Decay Rate and Resilient Controller Design for Positive Markov Jump Linear Systems
abstract: For continuous-time positive Markov jump linear systems (MJLSs), exponential mean stability analysis and resilient controller design are studied. Necessary conditions of decay-rate-dependent exponential mean stability are proved by applying the available stochastic stability results of positive MJLSs, and the sufficiency is addressed by a linear stochastic co-positive Lyapunov function method. Based on the sufficient stability condition, linear programming conditions are proposed to ensure the existence of a resilient controller such that the closed-loop system is positive and exponentially mean stable. A numerical example for validation is finally provided.

articleTitle: Measurement and Optimization of Spatial Target Position Using Three Monocular CMOS Cameras
abstract: Industrial monocular area CMOS camera is now playing a remarkable role in the fields of the spatial target position and velocity measurement. To overcome the measurement nonlinearities and the process uncertainties, and to improve the precision of target positioning, a set of triangle combination target is employed, the calibration principles of Zhang is utilized, and the idea of combination measurement is proposed by using three focal spots as a cooperative target. The experiment shows the position measuring error can be decreased within 2 magnitudes, and the effectiveness of such methods is verified.

articleTitle: Combined Control based on Passive Dynamic Walking for Variable Slope Walking
abstract: During the walking process with the variable slopes, a control strategy is proposed to keep the bipedal robot with knees walking stably. Concerning the change of slopes, a combined control strategy is designed based on Lyapunov stability and passive dynamic walking. This controller makes the gaits realize the smooth switch between different slopes in the given time. And the bipedal robots can walk stably on the variable slopes, and exhibit more robustness for environmental changes. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: An Improved PSO Approach to Solve the Flight Gate Assignment Problem
abstract: This paper studied a flight gate assignment problem where both the passenger service quality and the flight taxiing distance are considered in the objective function. A more efficient flight gate assignment model is built. Based on this model, we further propose an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve it. A novel "flight-to-gate" coding scheme is designed to convert a particle position vector into the priority sequence of gates for each flight. Some tournament selection comparison rules are employed to update the position vectors of particles where a small part of infeasible individuals are kept in the iterative process of PSO. In order to improve the performance of PSO algorithm, a local search strategy based on swap operation is introduced to exploit more latitude of search space to anchor the global optimum. The algorithm is tested based on the simulated operational data from the actual airport. Experimental results reveal that our algorithm can achieve a good performance.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Rise Inspection Technology of Low-voltage Cable Junction Box Used in Mine
abstract: Combined with the operating environment and fault factors, temperature rise inspection technology of mine low-voltage cable junction box was proposed. Based on the analysis of the existing temperature rise test temperature testing technology and thermocouple temperature measurement principle, we designed the overall structure for mine low voltage cable junction box temperature test system. Moreover, the temperature rise test demand of current deviation and power frequency were put forward, and the current transformer and temperature data recorder for system test were introduced. Meanwhile, the system for mining low voltage cable junction box test was set up test.

articleTitle: Lidar-IMU and Wheel Odometer Based Autonomous Vehicle Localization System
abstract: Localization is a critical issue in autonomous navigation and path planning. The traditional localization method for automatic driving is to use the GPS. But in many cases, such as near the high buildings, under the viaduct, in the basement or the tunnel, GPS signal will disappeared or be weakened, resulting in localization failure. This paper proposed a precise localization method based on Lidar, IMU and wheel odometer combined with point cloud data map matching. In this paper, information in the form of depth point cloud collected by Lidar is matched with the pre-known point cloud map data, and a Point-to-Plane Iterative Closest Point algorithm (PP-ICP) is introduced. In order to avoid the mismatch and localization failure, the start of the autonomous vehicle is set to the initial coordinates of the point cloud map data. Then, the predicted state equation which consists of the throttle control and steering wheel control of the autonomous vehicle is established. The first observation equation consists of the acceleration and angular velocity measured by the IMU. The second observation equation consists of the position and attitude measured by the Lidar matching point cloud, along with speed and distance measured by the wheel odometer. Finally, the extended Kalman filter is used to fuse the information data of the three sensors and thus update and correct the localization. Experiments using multi-sensor fusion were carried out in underground garages and the experimental results showed that the robustness and positioning accuracy can meet the engineering requirements.

articleTitle: A Survey of Three-Dimensional Flight Path Planning for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
abstract: The unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have been widely used in various fields in recent years, where the three-dimensional (3D) flight path planning is very important to realize the autonomous flight and complete the desired missions for the UAVs. Although the 3D flight path planning have become an active topic in the filed of the UAVs, there are still several critical problems to be further investigated to the authors' knowledge. Motivated by the aforementioned considerations, the purpose of this survey is to present several representative approaches already proposed in the literature and provide some problems to be further investigated for the 3D flight path planning of the UAVs.

articleTitle: Wind Turbines Pitch Controller using Constrained Fuzzy-Receding Horizon Control
abstract: This study concentrates on the variable speed/pitch wind-turbines control for the overrated wind-speed. The pitch control is essential in this high wind-speed to adjust the rated output power. The key challenges of designing a pitch control for the wind-turbine are the constraints in the pitch-angle, wind turbine nonlinearities, the wind-speed variations, and the unmeasured states (unstructured model dynamics). From this point of view, this paper proposes constrained fuzzy-receding horizon pitch control to investigate the variable speed wind turbine performance. The proposed controller guarantees the nominal stability and converted to a simple online quadratic optimization problem which required less computational time to be solved. The proposed controller is compared with the gain scheduled-PI controller (which has been used abundantly in the wind-turbine industry) by applying the wind-turbine mathematical model. Additionally, a typical 5MW offshore wind-turbine simulator is employed to verify the results from the mathematical model. The results indicate the effectiveness of the proposed controller over the baseline controller.

articleTitle: A Review of Active Magnetic Bearing Control Technology
abstract: Compared with general magnetic bearings, active magnetic bearings(AMBs) have high efficiency, almost no friction, low consumption. They are widely used in vacuum, ultra-clean, high-speed and other occasions. Firstly, the principle and structure of AMB are introduced. Then the research work of AMB and its control technology is described. The research status of the key control technology of AMB and the tuning method to improve the stability and robustness of the system are summarized. Finally, according to the development direction of AMB with high speed, high precision and low consumption, the development trend of active magnetic bearing control technology research is analyzed.

articleTitle: Small Object Detection Networks Based on Classification-Oriented Super-Resolution GAN for UAV Aerial Imagery
abstract: Small object detection is challenging for lack of discriminative information compared to medium, large objects. In this paper, we proposed small object detection networks based on classification-oriented super-resolution generative adversarial networks (CSRGAN) and validate them on public UAV aerial imagery benchmark.
